examples.zh: 他每天可以起床两小时左右。

get up.usage: 表示从地上或躺着的位置起来

examples.en: I'm afraid that I can't get up.
examples.zh: 恐怕我站不起来了。

get up.usage: /ɡet ʌp/ verb phrase. 起来；起床（指从躺着或坐着的姿势起来）

examples.en: Does he have a temperature, doctor?
examples.zh: 医生，他发烧吗？

examples.en: He has a bad cold, too!
examples.zh: 他也得了重感冒！

examples.en: He mustn't eat rich food.
examples.zh: 他不可以吃油腻的食物。

examples.en: You must keep the room warm.
examples.zh: 你必须保持房间温暖。

examples.en: You must stay in bed for another two days.
examples.zh: 你必须再卧床两天。

what are you going to do.phrase: What are you going to do?
what are you going to do.usage: 用于询问某人打算做什么

examples.en: What are you going to do this evening?
examples.zh: 今晚你打算做什么？

examples.en: What are you going to do tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你明天打算做什么？

examples.en: Can I have the key to the front door, please?
examples.zh: 请问我能拿前门的钥匙吗？

examples.en: Can I have some water?
examples.zh: 我能喝点水吗？

examples.en: Enjoy yourself at the party!
examples.zh: 派对玩得开心！

examples.en: We always enjoy ourselves, Mum.
examples.zh: 我们总是玩得很开心，妈妈。

thats all right.usage: 用于回应别人的感谢，表示不客气

examples.en: Thanks, Mum. That's all right.
examples.zh: 谢谢妈妈。不客气。

examples.en: Thank you very much! That's all right.
examples.zh: 非常感谢！不客气。

you mustnt.usage: 用于表示禁止或不允许

examples.en: You mustn't come home late.
examples.zh: 你不许回家太晚。

examples.en: You mustn't be late for school.
examples.zh: 你不许上学迟到。

examples.en: You must be home at half past ten.
examples.zh: 你必须在十点半之前到家。

examples.en: I will be home at six.
examples.zh: 我六点会在家。

examples.en: You must be home at half past ten.
examples.zh: 你必须在十点半之前到家。

examples.en: The meeting starts at half past ten.
examples.zh: 会议十点半开始。

examples.en: You mustn't come home after a quarter past eleven.
examples.zh: 你不能在十一点一刻之后回家。

examples.en: The train leaves at a quarter past eleven.
examples.zh: 火车十一点一刻出发。

at the butchers.usage: 在肉店，表示在肉店这个地点

examples.en: Were you at the butcher's?
examples.zh: 你在肉店吗？

examples.en: I was at the butcher's yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在肉店。

at the greengrocers.usage: 在蔬菜水果店，表示在蔬果店这个地点

examples.en: I was at the greengrocer's.
examples.zh: 我在蔬菜水果店。

examples.en: She buys vegetables at the greengrocer's.
examples.zh: 她在蔬菜水果店买蔬菜。

how are you keeping.usage: 你身体怎么样？用于询问健康状况

examples.en: How are you keeping?
examples.zh: 你身体怎么样？

examples.en: Very well, thank you. How are you keeping?
examples.zh: 很好，谢谢。你身体怎么样？

be absent from.usage: 缺席；不在，常与学校、工作地点等连用

examples.en: Was he absent from school last week?
examples.zh: 他上周没上学吗？

examples.en: She was absent from work yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天没来上班。

spend the weekend.usage: 过周末，指在周末进行某种活动

examples.en: We're going to spend three days in the country.
examples.zh: 我们将在乡下度过三天。

examples.en: They spent the weekend at the beach.
examples.zh: 他们在海边度过了周末。

stay at my mothers.usage: 住在我妈妈家，表示暂住在亲属家中

examples.en: We're going to stay at my mother's for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我们将在妈妈家过周末。

examples.en: She stayed at her aunt's last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚住在她阿姨家。

in the country.usage: 在乡下/农村，指离开城市到乡村地区

examples.en: Friday, Saturday and Sunday in the country!
examples.zh: 周五、周六和周日都在乡下！

examples.en: They live in the country.
examples.zh: 他们住在乡下。

examples.en: We are now living in the country.
examples.zh: 我们现在住在乡下。

arent you lucky.usage: 你们真幸运！表示羡慕或感叹的语气

examples.en: Aren't you lucky!
examples.zh: 你们真幸运！

examples.en: Aren't we lucky to have such good weather!
examples.zh: 天气这么好，我们真幸运！

very well.usage: 很好，表示状况良好，常用于回答 How are you?

examples.en: He's very well, thank you.
examples.zh: 他很好，谢谢。

examples.en: I'm very well, thanks.
examples.zh: 我很好，谢谢。

examples.en: We were at the race yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们昨天在比赛现场。

examples.en: I bought some food on the way home.
examples.zh: 我在回家的路上买了一些食物。

examples.en: They talked on the way home.
examples.zh: 他们在回家的路上交谈。

examples.en: You can see us in the crowd.
examples.zh: 你可以在人群中看到我们。

examples.en: Five other cars were just behind him.
examples.zh: 其他五辆车紧随其后。

examples.en: There were hundreds of people there.
examples.zh: 那里有数百人。

examples.en: Hundreds of people come from the city every Sunday.
examples.zh: 每周日都有数百人从城市来这里。

drive so quickly.usage: 开得这么快（用于口语叮嘱）

examples.en: Don't drive so quickly!
examples.zh: 别开这么快！

examples.en: It was an exciting finish to the race.
examples.zh: 比赛的结果激动人心。

examples.en: He was in car number fifteen.
examples.zh: 他在15号车里。

there were.usage: 表示某地有某物（过去式）

examples.en: There were twenty cars in the race.
examples.zh: 比赛中有20辆车。

hundreds of.usage: /ˈhʌndrədz əv/ phrase. 数百的，许多的（表示不确定的大数量，后面接可数名词复数）

four times.usage: 表示频率，time的复数形式表示次数

examples.en: He called me four times yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天给我打了四次电话。

the day before yesterday.usage: 前天，表示比昨天更早的一天

examples.en: He called me three times the day before yesterday.
examples.zh: 他前天给我打了三次电话。

answer the telephone.usage: 接听电话，answer可用pick up或answer the phone替换

examples.en: I didn't answer the phone.
examples.zh: 我没有接电话。

type letters.usage: 打信，指在办公室处理文书工作

examples.en: Pauline is typing letters.
examples.zh: 波林正在打信。

arrived home.usage: 到家，home作副词时前面不加介词

examples.en: I arrived home at six o'clock.
examples.zh: 我六点钟到家的。

last night.usage: 昨晚，表示过去的一个夜晚

examples.en: Did he telephone again last night?
examples.zh: 他昨晚又打电话了吗？

examples.en: She can't speak to you now.
examples.zh: 她现在不能和你说话。

examples.en: Please don't telephone my daughter again.
examples.zh: 请不要再给我女儿打电话了。

lose ones way.usage: 迷路，指找不到要去的地方

examples.en: She lost her way in London.
examples.zh: 她在伦敦迷路了。

examples.en: The tourists lost their way in the forest.
examples.zh: 游客们在森林里迷路了。

examples.en: I don't like losing my way.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢迷路。

examples.en: I can ask him the way.
examples.zh: 我可以向他问路。

examples.en: May I ask you the way to the station?
examples.zh: 我可以向你问一下去车站的路吗？

can you tell me the way to.phrase: Can you tell me the way to...?
can you tell me the way to.usage: 你能告诉我去...的路吗？用于礼貌地问路

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我去国王街的路吗？

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to the museum?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我去博物馆的路吗？

excuse me.usage: 打扰一下，用于引起注意或打扰别人前

examples.en: Excuse me, can you help me?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，你能帮帮我吗？

examples.en: Excuse me, is this your pen?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，这是你的钢笔吗？

examples.en: He put his hand into his pocket.
examples.zh: 他把他的手伸进口袋里。

examples.en: She put her hand into the bag.
examples.zh: 她把手伸进包里。

examples.en: He took out a phrasebook.
examples.zh: 他拿出一本短语手册。

examples.en: She took out her keys.
examples.zh: 她拿出钥匙。

examples.en: The lady took out her powder compact.
examples.zh: 那位女士拿出了她的粉盒。

i am sorry.usage: 对不起/很抱歉，用于道歉或表达遗憾

examples.en: I am sorry, I do not speak English.
examples.zh: 对不起，我不会说英语。

examples.en: I am sorry, I am late.
examples.zh: 对不起，我迟到了。

examples.en: I do not speak English.
examples.zh: 我不会说英语。

examples.en: Do you speak French?
examples.zh: 你会说法语吗？

examples.en: She said to herself.
examples.zh: 她自言自语。

examples.en: He thought to himself.
examples.zh: 他心里想。

examples.en: He read the phrase slowly.
examples.zh: 他慢慢地读那个短语。

examples.en: Please read the text slowly.
examples.zh: 请慢慢地读这篇课文。

bus stop.usage: /bʌs stɒp/ noun phrase. 公共汽车站（公交车停靠的地方）

in fashion.usage: 表示某物正在流行或时髦

examples.en: These shoes are in fashion now.
examples.zh: 这些鞋子现在很流行。

in fashion.usage: 意为'流行；时髦'，描述某物当前受欢迎

examples.en: Short skirts are in fashion now.
examples.zh: 短裙现在正流行。

out of fashion.usage: 表示某物已经过时，不再流行

examples.en: They were in fashion last year.
examples.zh: 它们去年很流行。

last month.usage: 表示上个月，过去的时间

examples.en: My sister bought this pair last month.
examples.zh: 我姐姐上个月买了这双。

examples.en: They were in fashion the year before last too.
examples.zh: 前年它们也很流行。

examples.en: She bought them in the U.S.
examples.zh: 她是在美国买的。

can you getfor me.usage: 请求他人帮忙购买某物

examples.en: Can you get a pair for me, please?
examples.zh: 你能帮我弄一双吗？

a pair of.usage: 一双，一对，用于描述成双的物品

examples.en: Can you get a pair for me?
examples.zh: 你能帮我弄一双吗？

examples.en: I have a terrible toothache.
examples.zh: 我牙疼得厉害。

examples.en: I want to see the dentist, please.
examples.zh: 我想看牙医。

examples.en: Do you have an appointment?
examples.zh: 您有预约吗？

examples.en: Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday?
examples.zh: 您能星期一上午10点来吗？

im afraid that.usage: 表示恐怕...（礼貌地表达不好的消息）

examples.en: I'm afraid that he can't.
examples.zh: 恐怕他不能。

im afraid that.usage: 表示遗憾地告诉某人某事，或表示担心

examples.en: I'm afraid that I can't get up.
examples.zh: 恐怕我站不起来了。

examples.en: Can't you wait till this afternoon?
examples.zh: 您不能等到下午吗？

examples.en: I feel awful.
examples.zh: 我感觉很难受。

examples.en: I must go to the grocer's to buy some tea.
examples.zh: 我必须去杂货店买些茶叶。

examples.en: I'm making a shopping list, Tom.
examples.zh: 我正在列购物清单，汤姆。

have got havent got.usage: 相当于have/has，表示拥有（英式英语常用）

examples.en: We haven't got much tea or coffee.
examples.zh: 我们的茶叶和咖啡不多了。

examples.en: We haven't got any meat at all.
examples.zh: 我们一点肉都没有了。

examples.en: We need a lot of things this week.
examples.zh: 这周我们需要很多东西。

how much.usage: 询问数量（用于不可数名词）

examples.en: How much money have you got?
examples.zh: 你有多少钱？

im not going to get any.phrase: I'm not going to get any
im not going to get any.usage: 表示将来不打算做某事

examples.en: And I'm not going to get any!
examples.zh: 而且我不打算买！

shopping list.usage: /ˈʃɒpɪŋ lɪst/ noun. 购物清单（指列出需要购买的物品的单子）

a lot of.usage: /ə lɒt əv/ phrase. 许多；大量（可修饰可数名词复数和不可数名词）

examples.en: I paint a lot of pictures.
examples.zh: 我画很多画。

examples.en: Have a cigarette.
examples.zh: 抽根烟吧。

have a glass of whisky.usage: 用于邀请别人喝一杯威士忌

examples.en: Have a glass of whisky then.
examples.zh: 那就喝杯威士忌吧。

examples.en: We can have dinner at seven o'clock.
examples.zh: 我们可以七点吃晚饭。

examples.en: Sam and I had lunch together today.
examples.zh: 今天我和萨姆一起吃了午饭。

examples.en: I've already had lunch.
examples.zh: 我已经吃过午饭了。

examples.en: Everybody wants to have lunch in the garden.
examples.zh: 大家想在花园里吃午饭。

examples.en: We had lunch at a village pub.
examples.zh: 我们在乡村酒吧吃了午餐。

examples.en: I'm nearly ready.
examples.zh: 我差不多好了。

examples.en: We went to a restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们去了一家餐馆。

examples.en: Have a cup of coffee then.
examples.zh: 那就喝杯咖啡吧。

examples.en: Let's go into the living room.
examples.zh: 我们去客厅吧。

examples.en: He was going into the dining room.
examples.zh: 他正走进餐厅。

examples.en: Excuse the mess, Sam. This room's very untidy.
examples.zh: 抱歉有点乱，萨姆。这个房间很不整洁。

examples.en: We're packing our suitcases.
examples.zh: 我们正在收拾行李箱。

examples.en: Tom and I are going to have a holiday.
examples.zh: 汤姆和我打算去度假。

examples.en: I had one after my lunch.
examples.zh: 我午饭后喝了一杯。

examples.en: When are you going to have a holiday, Sam?
examples.zh: 萨姆，你打算什么时候去度假？

have you just been to.usage: 用来询问对方是否刚去过某个地方

examples.en: Have you just been to the cinema?
examples.zh: 你刚去过电影院吗？

whats on.usage: 用来询问正在上映什么电影或上演什么节目

examples.en: What's on at the cinema tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚电影院上映什么？

ive already seen it.usage: 表示已经完成某事，already常与现在完成时连用

examples.en: I've already finished my homework.
examples.zh: 我已经完成作业了。

examples.en: Flowers bloom in the spring.
examples.zh: 春天花开了。

examples.en: It rained all the time during our trip.
examples.zh: 我们旅行期间一直下雨。

just like.usage: 表示...也一样，用于比较两者相同

examples.en: The weather here is terrible, just like London.
examples.zh: 这里天气很差，就像伦敦一样。

have you ever been there.usage: 用来询问对方是否曾经去过某地

examples.en: Have you ever been to Paris?
examples.zh: 你去过巴黎吗？

in april.usage: 表示在四月，月份前用介词in

examples.en: My birthday is in April.
examples.zh: 我的生日在四月。

an old film.usage: 表示一部老电影，old描述film的特征

examples.en: This is an old film from the 1960s.
examples.zh: 这是一部六十年代的老电影。

examples.en: I was there last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我在那里。

can the mechanics repair.usage: 询问机械师是否能修理某物

examples.en: Can the mechanics repair my car?
examples.zh: 机械师能修好我的车吗？

is my car ready yet.usage: 询问东西是否已经准备好/完成，用于询问等待的事情

examples.en: Is my car ready yet, sir?
examples.zh: 先生，我的车修好了吗？

whats the number of your car.phrase: What's the number of your car?

examples.en: What's the number of your car?
examples.zh: 你的车号是多少？

have your mechanics finished yet.usage: 询问某项工作是否已经完成，yet用于现在完成时疑问句

examples.en: Have your mechanics finished yet?
examples.zh: 你的机械师完成了吗？

theyre still working on it.usage: 表示某项工作仍在进行中，still表示持续

examples.en: No, they're still working on it.
examples.zh: 没有，他们还在修。

examples.en: Let's go into the garage and have a look at it.
examples.zh: 我们去车库看看吧。

examples.en: May I have a look at it, please?
examples.zh: 我可以看一看吗？

examples.en: We went to have a look at him.
examples.zh: 我们走过去看看他。

i drove it into a lamppost.phrase: I drove it into a lamp-post

examples.en: I drove it into a lamp-post.
examples.zh: 我把它撞到了路灯柱上。

thats right.usage: 表示同意或确认某事属实

examples.en: Didn't you have a crash? That's right.
examples.zh: 你不是出了车祸吗？是的。

well it was my car.usage: 表示语气转折，暗示车已经损坏

examples.en: Isn't that your car? Well, it was my car.
examples.zh: 那不是你的车吗？呃，曾经是我的车。

for sale.usage: 表示某物正在出售，待售

examples.en: This house is for sale.
examples.zh: 这所房子待售。

examples.en: That's a lot of money!
examples.zh: 那是一大笔钱！

examples.en: I can't decide yet.
examples.zh: 我还不能决定。

have the last word.usage: 最后说了算，有最终决定权

examples.en: Women always have the last word.
examples.zh: 女人总是最后说了算。

every penny of it.usage: 每一分钱，意思是物有所值

examples.en: It's worth every penny of it.
examples.zh: 它绝对值这个价。

examples.en: I want to buy a small house in the country.
examples.zh: 我想在乡下买一所小房子。

how long have you lived here.phrase: How long have you lived here?
how long have you lived here.usage: 你住在这里多久了？询问持续时间

examples.en: How long have you lived here?
examples.zh: 你住在这里多久了？

sell the house.usage: 卖房子，指将房屋出售给他人

examples.en: He sold his house last week.
examples.zh: 他上周把房子卖了。

move to.usage: 搬到（某地），表示搬迁到新的地点

examples.en: He's going to move to his new house tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他打算明天搬到他的新房子去。

move to.usage: 搬到（某地），搬迁到新地方

examples.en: I have just moved to a house in Bridge Street.
examples.zh: 我刚搬到布里奇街的一栋房子里。

give him my regards.usage: 代我向他问好，请他人转达问候

examples.en: Please give him my regards.
examples.zh: 请代我向他问好。

miss him.usage: 想念他，表示对离开的人有留恋之情

examples.en: I'll miss him.
examples.zh: 我会想念他的。

examples.en: They'll move in the day after tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他们后天会搬进来。

the day after tomorrow.usage: 后天，表示明天的下一天

examples.en: I think that they'll move in the day after tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我认为他们后天会搬进来。

a good neighbour.usage: 一个好邻居，形容邻里关系好

examples.en: He has always been a good neighbour.
examples.zh: 他一直是一个好邻居。

want to leave.usage: 想要离开，表达离开的意愿

examples.en: He didn't want to leave this house.
examples.zh: 他不想离开这所房子。

still here.usage: 还在这里，表示某人仍然停留在原地

examples.en: He's still here.
examples.zh: 他还在这里。

examples.en: Ian is moving out tomorrow.
examples.zh: Ian明天就要搬走了。

examples.en: Our next-door neighbour is very friendly.
examples.zh: 我们的隔壁邻居非常友好。

examples.en: He will fly to New York next month.
examples.zh: 他下个月将飞往纽约。

examples.en: He will fly to Perth from there.
examples.zh: 他从那里飞往珀斯。

the month after next.usage: 再下个月，表示距今两个月后的时间

examples.en: He'll fly to Tokyo the month after next.
examples.zh: 再下个月他将飞往东京。

a week ago.usage: 一周前，用于一般过去时

examples.en: He flew to Spain a week ago.
examples.zh: 他一周前飞往西班牙。

the week after next.usage: 再下周，表示距今两周后的时间

examples.en: He'll return to London the week after next.
examples.zh: 再下周他将返回伦敦。

examples.en: He'll return to London next week.
examples.zh: 他下周将返回伦敦。

examples.en: He has already been to nearly every country.
examples.zh: 他已经几乎去过每个国家。

examples.en: At the moment, he's in Madrid.
examples.zh: 此刻他在马德里。

years old.usage: /jɪəz əʊld/ phrase. 岁；...岁大（用于表示年龄）

put on.usage: 穿上，戴上，表示穿上衣服或戴上帽子等

examples.en: Would you put it on, please?
examples.zh: 请你把它戴上好吗？

i cant remember.usage: 我不记得了，表示遗忘或记不起某事

examples.en: I can't remember his name.
examples.zh: 我不记得他的名字了。

who served you.usage: 谁接待了您？用于询问服务人员

examples.en: Who served you, sir?
examples.zh: 先生，谁接待了您？

i recognize him now.usage: 我现在认出他了，表示辨认出某人

examples.en: I didn't recognize you at first.
examples.zh: 我一开始没认出你。

what a beautiful.usage: 用于表达感叹，赞美某物

examples.en: What a beautiful ship!
examples.zh: 多漂亮的轮船啊！

thats the man i told you about.phrase: That's the man I told you about
thats the man i told you about.usage: 用于介绍或提及之前提到过的人

examples.en: That's the man I told you about.
examples.zh: 这就是我跟你说过的那个男人。

the one who.usage: 用于指代前面提到的人，具有某种特征

examples.en: The one who offered you a job in Australia.
examples.zh: 那个给你在澳大利亚提供工作的人。

examples.en: I grew a beard during the trip.
examples.zh: 我在旅途中留了胡子。

examples.en: I shaved it off when I came home.
examples.zh: 我回家时把它刮掉了。

is it you is it.usage: 用于猜测某人身份时的反问

examples.en: It's not you, is it?
examples.zh: 不是你，对吧？

people i met.usage: 定语从句，修饰前面的人

examples.en: They're people I met during the trip.
examples.zh: 他们是我旅途中遇到的人。

examples.en: This is a photograph I took during my trip to Australia.
examples.zh: 这是我在澳大利亚旅行时拍的照片。

examples.en: The one who offered you a job in Australia.
examples.zh: 那个给你在澳大利亚提供工作的人。

have tea.usage: 喝茶/用茶点，表示喝茶的时间或活动

examples.en: Can't you come in and have tea now?
examples.zh: 你现在不能进来喝茶吗？

examples.en: I'll have tea by myself.
examples.zh: 我要自己喝茶了。

have to must.usage: 必须，不得不。must更强调主观意愿，have to更强调客观需要

examples.en: I must water the garden first.
examples.zh: 我必须先给花园浇水。

examples.en: Do you have to water it now?
examples.zh: 你非得现在浇水吗？

examples.en: Look out of the window. It's raining!
examples.zh: 看窗外！下雨了！

what a nuisance.usage: 多么讨厌的事！用于表达抱怨或烦恼

examples.en: What a nuisance! The garden is dry again.
examples.zh: 真讨厌！花园又干了。

by myself.usage: 独自一人，by oneself 表示某人自己

examples.en: Well, I'll have tea by myself.
examples.zh: 好吧，我一个人喝茶了。

that was quick.usage: 真快！用于惊讶某人完成某事的速度

examples.en: Have you finished already? Yes. That was quick!
examples.zh: 你已经完成了？是的。真快！

it means that.usage: 这意味着...，用于说明前文所述情况的结果或含义

examples.en: It's raining! That means you don't need to water the garden.
examples.zh: 下雨了！这意味着你不需要给花园浇水了。

examples.en: It means I can have tea, instead.
examples.zh: 这意味着我反而可以喝茶了。

dont you remember.usage: 你不记得了吗？用于提醒对方回忆

examples.en: Last summer it was very dry, too. Don't you remember?
examples.zh: 去年夏天也很干旱。你不记得了吗？

a pleasant surprise.usage: 一个惊喜，指令人愉快的意外之事

examples.en: That was a pleasant surprise.
examples.zh: 那真是一个惊喜。

look out of.usage: /lʊk aʊt əv/ phrase. 向...外看（从窗户或门口向外看的动作）

examples.en: I looked out of the window.
examples.zh: 我向窗外望去。

can you recognize.usage: 用于询问对方是否能认出某人或某物

examples.en: Can you recognize that woman, Liz?
examples.zh: 你能认出那个女人吗，莉兹？

it must be.usage: 表示有把握的推测，意为一定是

examples.en: It must be Karen Marsh, the actress.
examples.zh: 那一定是女演员凯伦·马什。

it cant be.usage: 表示否定的推测，意为不可能是

examples.en: It can't be.
examples.zh: 不可能是。

examples.en: Let me have another look.
examples.zh: 让我再看看。

examples.en: She must be at least forty.
examples.zh: 她一定至少四十岁了。

at least.usage: 表示最小数量或程度，意为'不少于'、'至少'

examples.en: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
examples.zh: 她一定有至少三十五岁了。

at least.usage: /ət liːst/ phrase. 至少（表示最小数量或程度）

i read.usage: 表示从阅读中获得信息

examples.en: I read she's twenty-nine.
examples.zh: 我读到她说她二十九岁。

she was when i was.usage: 表示过去某事发生时的情况

examples.en: She was a famous actress when I was still at school.
examples.zh: 当我还在上学时她就是著名演员了。

examples.en: Doesn't Karen Marsh look old!
examples.zh: 凯伦·马什看起来不是很老吗！

examples.en: She does, doesn't she!
examples.zh: 她确实看起来老，不是吗！

im not more than.usage: 表示不超过某个年龄或数量

examples.en: I'm not more than twenty-nine myself.
examples.zh: 我自己不超过二十九岁。

examples.en: The policeman is waving to you.
examples.zh: 那个警察正在向你招手。

wave to someone.usage: 向某人挥手，表示招呼或告别

examples.en: On the way, a young man waved to me.
examples.zh: 在路上，一个年轻人向我挥手。

seventy miles an hour.usage: 每小时七十英里，指车速

examples.en: You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
examples.zh: 你一定是以每小时七十英里的速度在开车。

speed limit.usage: 限速，指法律规定的最高车速

examples.en: Didn't you see the speed limit?
examples.zh: 你没看到限速标志吗？

examples.en: Next time you'd better take my advice!
examples.zh: 下次你最好听我的建议！

examples.en: I'll certainly be more careful.
examples.zh: 我一定会更小心的。

charge someone.usage: 对某人收费或正式指控

examples.en: I won't charge you this time.
examples.zh: 这次我不罚你了。

examples.en: I was telling him to drive slowly.
examples.zh: 我一直在告诉他开慢点。

examples.en: Well, next time you'd better take my advice!
examples.zh: 好吧，下次你最好听我的建议！

must have been doing.usage: 表示对过去正在发生事情的推测

examples.en: You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
examples.zh: 你一定是一直以每小时七十英里的速度在开车。

race track.usage: /reɪs træk/ noun. 赛车跑道；赛道（用于赛车的专用道路）

driving licence.usage: /ˈdraɪvɪŋ ˈlaɪsns/ noun. 驾驶执照（允许驾驶车辆的官方证件）

examples.en: We may go abroad this summer.
examples.zh: 我们今年夏天可能出国。

examples.en: Mr. Lane has gone abroad.
examples.zh: Lane先生已经出国了。

examples.en: We can't make up our minds.
examples.zh: 我们无法做决定。

examples.en: I can't make up my mind.
examples.zh: 我无法做出决定。

examples.en: She has made up her mind to go abroad.
examples.zh: 她已下定决心出国。

examples.en: Will you travel by sea or by air?
examples.zh: 你们乘船还是乘飞机旅行？

examples.en: Who's going to look after the dog?
examples.zh: 谁来照顾这只狗？

look after.usage: /lʊk ˈɑːftər/ verb phrase. 照顾；照看；照料（相当于take care of）

in the end.usage: 表示最后、最终（往往有结果）

examples.en: In the end, we stay at home.
examples.zh: 最后，我们待在家里。

examples.en: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
examples.zh: 最后，他实在无法忍受了。

examples.en: I'm sure you'll enjoy yourselves.
examples.zh: 我相信你们会玩得很开心。

examples.en: She enjoyed herself making the assistant bring almost everything.
examples.zh: 她让店员把几乎所有东西都拿了出来，玩得很开心。

examples.en: We may go abroad. I'm not sure.
examples.zh: 我们可能出国。我不确定。

too much.usage: 表示太多（程度），用于修饰动词

examples.en: My wife always worries too much.
examples.zh: 我妻子总是担心太多。

examples.en: We have this problem every year.
examples.zh: 我们每年都有这个问题。

sensational news.usage: 用于表达令人震惊或轰动的消息

examples.en: Sensational news! The famous actress is retiring!
examples.zh: 爆炸性新闻！这位著名女演员要退休了！

listen to this.usage: 用于引起他人注意，让对方听某事

examples.en: Listen to this! They are getting married!
examples.zh: 听这个！他们要结婚了！

examples.en: Are you going to make another film?
examples.zh: 你打算再拍一部电影吗？

examples.en: I'm going to retire next year.
examples.zh: 我打算明年退休。

examples.en: I feel very tired after work.
examples.zh: 下班后我感觉很累。

dont want to.usage: 表示不愿意或不想做某事

examples.en: I don't want to make another film for a long time.
examples.zh: 我很长一段时间都不想再拍电影了。

examples.en: Let's buy a newspaper.
examples.zh: 我们买份报纸吧。

examples.en: I wonder why she decided to retire.
examples.zh: 我想知道她为什么决定退休。

arrive at.usage: 表示到达某地（较小的地方）

examples.en: Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport.
examples.zh: 凯伦·马什到达了伦敦机场。

arrive at.usage: 除了表示到达某地，还可表示“达成（共识），得出（结论），达到（某种水平）”，后接抽象名词

examples.en: It was necessary first to arrive at that degree of sophistication where we no longer set our own belief against our neighbour's superstition.
examples.zh: 我们首先必须达到这种成熟的认知程度：不再把我们自己的信仰和邻人的迷信对立起来。

examples.en: After hours of discussion, the two sides finally arrived at an agreement.
examples.zh: 经过数小时的讨论，双方最终达成了协议。

examples.en: She told me she had just made a new film.
examples.zh: 她告诉我她刚拍了一部新电影。

by our reporter.usage: /baɪ ˈaʊə rɪˈpɔːtə/ phrase. 本報記者（新闻报道的署名用语）

long time.usage: /lɒŋ taɪm/ phrase. 很长时间（表示一段较长的時间）

examples.en: They're going to get married next week.
examples.zh: 他们打算下周结婚。

examples.en: When did they get married?
examples.zh: 他们什么时候结的婚？

examples.en: Here's the latest report about Karen Marsh.
examples.zh: 这是关于卡伦·马什的最新报道。

let me introduce him to you.phrase: Let me introduce him to you

examples.en: Let me introduce him to you. His name is Carlos.
examples.zh: 让我把他介绍给你。他叫卡洛斯。

examples.en: Are you really going to retire? I may.
examples.zh: 你真的打算退休吗？也许吧。

wont let me.usage: 不让我...（表示禁止或不允许）

examples.en: He won't let me make another film.
examples.zh: 他不会让我再拍电影了。

thatsnews isnt it.usage: 真是...新闻，不是吗？（反意疑问句）

examples.en: That's sensational news, isn't it?
examples.zh: 真是轰动的新闻，不是吗？

i will have to.usage: 我必须...（表示将来必要性）

examples.en: I will have to ask my future husband.
examples.zh: 我必须问问我未来的丈夫。

examples.en: Are you doing the football pools, Brian?
examples.zh: 你在投注足球彩票吗，布莱恩？

win something.usage: 赢得某物；在比赛中获得奖品或奖金

examples.en: I'm sure we'll win something this week.
examples.zh: 我相信这周我们会赢点什么。

examples.en: If I win a lot of money I'll buy you a mink coat.
examples.zh: 如果我赢了很多钱，我会给你买一件貂皮大衣。

examples.en: If we win a lot of money we'll travel round the world.
examples.zh: 如果我们赢了很多钱，我们就去环游世界。

examples.en: We'll stay at the best hotels.
examples.zh: 我们会住在最好的酒店里。

examples.en: Then we'll return home and buy a big house in the country.
examples.zh: 然后我们回家，在乡下买一栋大房子。

examples.en: I usually return home at six o'clock.
examples.zh: 我通常六点回家。

examples.en: We'll buy a big house in the country.
examples.zh: 我们会在乡下买一栋大房子。

examples.en: But if we spend all that money we'll be poor again.
examples.zh: 但如果我们花光所有的钱，我们又会变穷。

examples.en: We'll be poor again.
examples.zh: 我们又会变穷了。

examples.en: Everything depends on 'if'!
examples.zh: 一切都取决于"如果"！

depend on.usage: 动词短语，意为“依赖；依靠；取决于”，后接名词、代词或从句

examples.en: Whether we will go hiking tomorrow depends on the weather.
examples.zh: 我们明天是否去远足取决于天气。

depend on.usage: 表示“取决于，依赖”，后可接名词或从句，可用于说明事物的决定因素或人对他人/物的依赖

examples.en: The shape and dimensions of the skyscrapers depend entirely on the necessity of obtaining the maximum income.
examples.zh: 摩天大楼的形状和规模完全取决于获取最高收入的需求。

examples.en: Whether we will go hiking this weekend depends on the weather.
examples.zh: 我们这周末是否去远足取决于天气情况。

depend on.usage: 表示“取决于，依靠”，后接名词或名词性结构，说明事物的决定因素

examples.en: Its action depends on the surface, water or ground, over which it rides.
examples.zh: 它的运行取决于它所行驶的表面，无论是水面还是地面。

examples.en: The success of the activity depends on the weather and the number of participants.
examples.zh: 这次活动的成功取决于天气和参与人数。

depend on.usage: 表示“取决于；依赖；依靠”，后可接名词、代词或从句

examples.en: The success of the activity depends on the weather.
examples.zh: 活动能否成功取决于天气。

examples.en: You should not always depend on others when you meet problems.
examples.zh: 遇到问题时你不要总依赖别人。

football pools.usage: /ˈfʊtbɔːl puːlz/ noun. 足球赌注；足球博彩（指对足球比赛结果进行投注的博彩活动）

is that you john.usage: 电话用语，用于确认对方身份

examples.en: Is that you, John? This is Mary speaking.
examples.zh: 是你吗，约翰？我是玛丽。

by the way.usage: 用于在对话中顺便提起另一件事

examples.en: By the way, my wife wants to know if Mary needs any help.
examples.zh: 顺便说一下，我妻子想知道玛丽是否需要帮助。

examples.en: I'll have to stay at the office.
examples.zh: 我必须待在办公室。

have to.usage: 不得不，必须，表示必要性

examples.en: You'll have to get off here.
examples.zh: 你得在这里下车。

examples.en: I have to go now.
examples.zh: 我现在得走了。

examples.en: We'll be late for dinner this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚我们晚餐会迟到。

i dont know what youre talking about.phrase: I don't know what you're talking about
i dont know what youre talking about.usage: 表示不明白对方在说什么

examples.en: I don't know what you're talking about.
examples.zh: 我不知道你在说什么。

work for.usage: 表示为某公司或某人工作

examples.en: You work for the Overseas Engineering Company, don't you?
examples.zh: 你在海外工程公司工作，不是吗？

examples.en: I said I would be at your house at six o'clock.
examples.zh: 我说过我会六点到你家。

examples.en: Tell Mary we'll be late for dinner this evening.
examples.zh: 告诉玛丽今晚我们晚餐会迟到。

examples.en: I'm repairing your telephone line.
examples.zh: 我在修理你的电话线路。

be invited to.usage: 被邀请参加（某个活动或聚会）

examples.en: Sally was invited to a children's party.
examples.zh: 莎莉被邀请去参加一个儿童派对。

examples.en: I decided to take her by train.
examples.zh: 我决定带她坐火车去。

examples.en: She sat near the window and asked questions.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗边问了很多问题。

examples.en: A middle-aged lady got on the train.
examples.zh: 一位中年女士上了火车。

examples.en: She sat opposite Sally.
examples.zh: 她坐在莎莉对面。

examples.en: She began to make up her face.
examples.zh: 她开始化妆。

examples.en: She put away her compact.
examples.zh: 她把粉盒收了起来。

examples.en: She asked questions about everything she saw.
examples.zh: 她问关于她看到的一切的问题。

powder compact.usage: /ˈpaʊdə ˈkɒmpækt/ 名词. 粉盒，化妆盒（妇女随身携带的化妆工具）

examples.en: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.
examples.zh: 游客们被要求保持树林干净整洁。

examples.en: People still throw their rubbish everywhere.
examples.zh: 人们仍然到处乱扔垃圾。

examples.en: Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods.
examples.zh: 上周三，我去树林里散步了。

examples.en: The ground was covered with pieces of paper.
examples.zh: 地面上覆盖着纸屑。

examples.en: My hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.
examples.zh: 我的手上很快沾满了黏糊糊的面团。

examples.en: Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted.
examples.zh: 任何在这些树林里乱扔垃圾的人将被起诉。

examples.en: They like to walk through the woods.
examples.zh: 他们喜欢穿过树林。

examples.en: What I saw made me very sad.
examples.zh: 我所看到的一切让我非常伤心。

examples.en: My town is surrounded by beautiful woods.
examples.zh: 我的城镇被美丽的树林环绕着。

examples.en: Litter baskets have been placed under the trees.
examples.zh: 垃圾桶被放在树下。

beauty spot.usage: /ˈbjuːti spɒt/ noun. 风景点；名胜（指风景优美的旅游地点）

get up early.usage: 表示在平常或预期的时间之前起床

examples.en: I never get up early on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我星期天从不在早起。

examples.en: You should get up early to catch the train.
examples.zh: 你应该早起赶火车。

just then.usage: 表示就在那个时候，常用于引出意外事件

examples.en: Just then, the telephone rang.
examples.zh: 就在那时，电话响了。

by train.usage: 表示乘坐火车的交通方式

examples.en: I've just arrived by train.
examples.zh: 我刚乘火车到达。

examples.en: They will be coming by train.
examples.zh: 他们将乘火车来。

examples.en: It is now being sent to his home by train.
examples.zh: 现在正通过火车寄送给他。

examples.en: We often travel by train.
examples.zh: 我们经常坐火车旅行。

examples.en: I'm coming to see you.
examples.zh: 我正要来看你。

what a day.usage: 感叹语，表示某天很糟糕或很艰难

examples.en: What a day! It's raining again.
examples.zh: 多糟糕的一天！又下雨了。

its raining again.usage: 表示天气状况，描述正在下雨

examples.en: It's raining again. We can't go out.
examples.zh: 又下雨了。我们不能出去了。

dear me.usage: 感叹语，表示惊讶或轻微的不满

examples.en: Dear me! Do you always get up so late?
examples.zh: 天哪！你总是这么晚起床吗？

a few words of.usage: 表示会说某种语言的几个词

examples.en: He taught me a few words of Italian.
examples.zh: 他教了我几句意大利语。

thought about.usage: think about的过去式，表示思考、考虑

examples.en: Everyday I thought about postcards.
examples.zh: 每天我都在想着明信片。

examples.en: On the last day I made a big decision.
examples.zh: 在最后一天我做了一个重大决定。

examples.en: I got up early and bought thirty-seven cards.
examples.zh: 我早早起来买了37张明信片。

spent the whole day.usage: 花了一整天时间做某事

examples.en: I spent the whole day in my room.
examples.zh: 我在房间里待了一整天。

nota single.usage: 表示一点都不…，一个也没有

examples.en: I did not write a single card!
examples.zh: 我一张明信片都没写！

lend me a book.usage: 借给我一本书，lend后接双宾语

examples.en: He lent me a book.
examples.zh: 他借给我一本书。

public garden.usage: /ˈpʌblɪk ˈɡɑːdn/ noun phrase. 公共花园（指对公众开放的花园或公园）

examples.en: I have just received a letter from my brother.
examples.zh: 我刚收到哥哥的一封信。

examples.en: He is in Australia now.
examples.zh: 他现在在澳大利亚。

examples.en: He is working for a big firm.
examples.zh: 他在一家大公司工作。

examples.en: He has visited a great number of different places.
examples.zh: 他参观了许多不同的地方。

buy an australian car.usage: 买了一辆澳大利亚汽车

examples.en: He has just bought an Australian car.
examples.zh: 他刚买了一辆澳大利亚汽车。

examples.en: Alice Springs is a small town in the centre of Australia.
examples.zh: 爱丽丝泉是澳大利亚中部的一个小镇。

examples.en: My brother has never been abroad before.
examples.zh: 我哥哥以前从未出过国。

examples.en: He is finding this trip very exciting.
examples.zh: 他觉得这次旅行非常令人兴奋。

examples.en: He has been there for six months.
examples.zh: 他在那里已经六个月了。

up to now.usage: 迄今为止；到现在为止，常与现在完成时连用

examples.en: Up to now, he has sent many messages by pigeon.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，他已经通过鸽子发送了许多信息。

examples.en: Up to now, historians have assumed that calendars came into being with the advent of agriculture.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，历史学家一直认为日历是随着农业的出现而产生的。

a great many.usage: 许多；大量，后接可数名词复数

examples.en: Mr. Scott has received a great many requests.
examples.zh: 斯科特先生收到了许多请求。

a great many.usage: 表示大量的、许多的，用于修饰可数名词

examples.en: A great many people will be visiting the country.
examples.zh: 将有许多人来这个国家参观。

a great many.usage: 许多；大量（修饰可数名词）

examples.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 大量商品被送往展览会展出。

examples.en: Yesterday, a pigeon carried the first message from Pinhurst to Silbury.
examples.zh: 昨天，一只鸽子把第一条消息从平赫斯特送到锡尔伯里。

in this way.usage: 用这种方式；通过这种方法

examples.en: In this way, he has begun his own private telephone service.
examples.zh: 就这样，他开始了自己的私人'电话'服务。

examples.en: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
examples.zh: 就这样，他能够解开这个谜团。

examples.en: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
examples.zh: 塔齐耶夫经常以这种方式冒着生命危险。

examples.en: He sends messages from one garage to the other.
examples.zh: 他从一个车库向另一个车库发送信息。

examples.en: Mr. Scott cannot get a telephone for his new garage.
examples.zh: 斯科特先生无法为他的新车库安装电话。

knock at the door.usage: 敲门，表示有人来访时敲门的动作

examples.en: Yesterday a beggar knocked at my door.
examples.zh: 昨天一个乞丐敲了我的门。

examples.en: Someone knocked at the door.
examples.zh: 有人敲门了。

ask for.usage: 请求；要求，表示向他人要某物或做某事

examples.en: He asked me for a meal and a glass of beer.
examples.zh: 他向我要一顿饭和一杯啤酒。

examples.en: He asked for a bedside telephone.
examples.zh: 他要了一个床边电话。

in return for.usage: 作为（...的）回报，常用于表示交换或报答

examples.en: In return for this, the beggar stood on his head and sang songs.
examples.zh: 作为回报，乞丐倒立并唱歌。

in return for.usage: 表示“作为对……的回报/交换”，后接名词或动名词，引出交换的对象

examples.en: I bought him a drink in return for his help.
examples.zh: 我给他买了一杯饮料，作为对他帮助的回报。

examples.en: The workers get salary in return for their daily work.
examples.zh: 工人们获得薪水，作为日常工作的报酬。

stand on ones head.usage: 倒立，用头撑地倒立的姿势

examples.en: The beggar stood on his head.
examples.zh: 那个乞丐倒立着。

examples.en: He put a piece of cheese in his pocket.
examples.zh: 他把一块奶酪放进了口袋。

go away.usage: 离开，走开，表示离开某个地方

examples.en: Then he put a piece of cheese in his pocket and went away.
examples.zh: 然后他把一块奶酪放进口袋就走了。

call at.usage: 拜访（某地），访问某个具体地点

examples.en: He calls at every house in the street once a month.
examples.zh: 他每月来这条街的每户人家拜访一次。

call at.usage: 表示短暂拜访或停留某地

examples.en: Dan was asked to call at the station.
examples.zh: 丹被要求去警察局一趟。

examples.en: The train calls at every station.
examples.zh: 火车每站都停。

once a month.usage: 每月一次，表示频率的固定搭配

examples.en: He calls at every house once a month.
examples.zh: 他每月拜访每户人家一次。

examples.en: Later a neighbour told me about him.
examples.zh: 后来一个邻居告诉了我关于他的事。

examples.en: Frank was telling me about his experiences.
examples.zh: Frank正在给我讲他的经历。

examples.en: Two detectives were keeping guard at the door.
examples.zh: 两名侦探在门口看守。

examples.en: Two men took the parcel off the plane.
examples.zh: 两个人把包裹从飞机上拿下来。

take off.usage: 表示飞机起飞，也可引申为事业突然成功、脱掉衣物等含义

examples.en: The plane is scheduled to take off at 9 a.m.
examples.zh: 这架飞机计划上午9点起飞。

examples.en: After three years of hard work, his career finally took off.
examples.zh: 经过三年的努力，他的事业终于腾飞了。

examples.en: They carried it into the Customs House.
examples.zh: 他们把它搬进了海关大楼。

examples.en: To their surprise, the parcel was full of stones.
examples.zh: 令他们惊讶的是，包裹里满是石头。

examples.en: Detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.
examples.zh: 侦探们整个上午都在机场等待。

examples.en: A few hours earlier, someone had told the police.
examples.zh: 几个小时前，有人告诉了警察。

examples.en: The precious parcel was full of stones and sand.
examples.zh: 这个珍贵的包裹里装满了石头和沙子。

examples.en: Detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.
examples.zh: 侦探们整个上午都在机场等待。

south africa.usage: /saʊθ ˈæfrɪkə/ noun. 南非（非洲南部的国家）

examples.en: Nearly everybody enters for 'The Nicest Garden Competition' each year.
examples.zh: 几乎每个人都每年报名参加'最佳花园竞赛'。

examples.en: Joe wins every time.
examples.zh: 乔每次都赢。

every time.usage: 作时间连词，意为“每次”。用于描述每一次发生的行为或事件。

examples.en: Every time he wanted to come into the garden he would bark until someone opened the gate.
examples.zh: 每次他想进花园时，他都会叫到有人打开门为止。

examples.en: Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
examples.zh: 比尔·弗里斯的花园比乔的更大。

examples.en: Bill works harder than Joe.
examples.zh: 比尔比乔更努力工作。

examples.en: He has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
examples.zh: 他在池塘上建了一座木桥。

examples.en: He has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
examples.zh: 他在池塘上建了一座木桥。

examples.en: I always win a little prize for the worst garden in the town!
examples.zh: 我总是因为镇上最差的花园而获得一个小奖品！

examples.en: Why is Joe's garden the most beautiful one in the town?
examples.zh: 为什么乔的花园是镇上最美丽的一个？

examples.en: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden in our town.
examples.zh: 乔·桑德斯拥有我们镇上最美丽的花园。

examples.en: Bill grows more flowers and vegetables.
examples.zh: 比尔种了更多的花和蔬菜。

in twenty minutes time.usage: 表示在特定时间之后，'s所有格表示时间长度

examples.en: The train will arrive in twenty minutes' time.
examples.zh: 火车将在20分钟后到达。

in twenty minutes time.usage: 表示从现在起多少时间之后，'s所有格表示时间段

examples.en: The movie will start in twenty minutes' time.
examples.zh: 电影将在20分钟后开始。

wait and wait.usage: 表示持续等待，强调等待时间很长或令人焦急

examples.en: We waited and waited, but the bus never came.
examples.zh: 我们等啊等，但公交车始终没来。

at five to twelve.usage: 表示时间'差5分12点'，即11:55，to表示'差'的意思

examples.en: He left at five to twelve.
examples.zh: 他在12点差5分时离开了。

in that moment.usage: 表示在那一刻，强调某个特定的瞬间

examples.en: In that moment, I understood what he meant.
examples.zh: 在那一刻，我明白了他是什么意思。

begin to do something.usage: 表示开始做某事，to后面接动词原形

examples.en: She began to cry when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 她听到这个消息后开始哭了起来。

gather under.usage: 表示聚集在某个地点或物体下面

examples.en: People gathered under the big tree to avoid the rain.
examples.zh: 人们聚集在大树下避雨。

it was true.usage: 表示确认某事是真实的，true强调符合事实

examples.en: It was true. She really won the lottery.
examples.zh: 是真的，她真的中彩票了。

strike twelve.usage: 专指钟敲响12下，通常用于报时的语境

examples.en: The clock struck twelve at midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜时分时钟敲响了12下。

town hall.usage: /taʊn hɔːl/ noun. 市政厅（指城镇的政府办公大楼，也用于公共集会）

try to do something.usage: 尝试做某事，努力去做但不一定成功

examples.en: She tried to play jazz on it.
examples.zh: 她试着在上面弹爵士乐。

examples.en: Doctors have been trying to find out the cause of death.
examples.zh: 医生们一直在试图找出死因。

examples.en: She tried to open the door but it was locked.
examples.zh: 她试图打开门，但门锁着。

be shocked.usage: 感到震惊，表示对某事感到惊讶

examples.en: My father was shocked when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 我父亲听到这个消息时很震惊。

examples.en: Now we are not allowed to touch it.
examples.zh: 现在我们不被允许碰它。

examples.en: She struck the keys too hard.
examples.zh: 她敲击琴键太用力了。

examples.en: It was made in Germany in 1681.
examples.zh: 它于1681年在德国制造。

many years ago.usage: 很多年前，表示过去的时间

examples.en: The instrument was bought many years ago.
examples.zh: 这件乐器是多年前买的。

be being done.usage: 正在被...，现在进行时的被动语态

examples.en: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.
examples.zh: 它正在被我父亲的一个朋友修理。

a friend of my fathers.usage: 我父亲的...朋友，双重所有格用法

examples.en: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.
examples.zh: 它正在被我父亲的一个朋友修理。

have never borrowed.usage: 用于表达到目前为止从未进行过借入的动作

examples.en: He has never borrowed money from me.
examples.zh: 他从未向我借过钱。

to my surprise.usage: 用于引出令人惊讶的情况

examples.en: To my surprise, he gave me the money immediately.
examples.zh: 令我惊讶的是，他立刻把钱给了我。

pay for my dinner.usage: 指为晚餐付款，承担晚餐费用

examples.en: Now you can pay for my dinner!
examples.zh: 现在你可以为我的晚餐付账了！

lend me twenty pounds.usage: 请求对方借给自己二十英镑

examples.en: I asked him to lend me twenty pounds.
examples.zh: 我请他借给我二十英镑。

come and sit at the same table.phrase: come and sit at the same table
come and sit at the same table.usage: 表示来到并坐在同一张桌子旁

examples.en: Tony saw me and came and sat at the same table.
examples.zh: 托尼看见我后走过来坐在同一张桌子旁。

worked in a lawyers office years ago.phrase: worked in a lawyer's office years ago
worked in a lawyers office years ago.usage: 描述多年前在律师事务所工作

examples.en: He worked in a lawyer's office years ago.
examples.zh: 他多年前在一家律师事务所工作。

examples.en: He gets a good salary, but he always borrows money.
examples.zh: 他薪水不错，但他总是向朋友借钱。

borrows money from his friends and never.phrase: borrows money from his friends and never pays it back
borrows money from his friends and never.usage: 描述向朋友借钱且不归还的行为

examples.en: He always borrows money from his friends and never pays it back.
examples.zh: 他总是向朋友借钱且从不归还。

while he was eating.usage: 表示在进食的同时进行另一动作

examples.en: While he was eating, I asked him to lend me twenty pounds.
examples.zh: 在他吃饭的时候，我请他借给我二十英镑。

so now you can pay for my dinner.phrase: so now you can pay for my dinner
so now you can pay for my dinner.usage: 用于因果关系，得出结论

examples.en: I have never borrowed any money from you, so now you can pay for my dinner!
examples.zh: 我从未向你借过钱，所以现在你可以为我付晚餐了！

years ago.usage: /jɪəz əˈɡəʊ/ phrase. 多年前（指过去的某个时间段，距今较久）

will sail.usage: 表示将来的计划或决定，通常指即刻决定或预测

examples.en: He will sail from Portsmouth tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他明天将从朴茨茅斯起航。

set out.usage: 表示出发、启程，强调开始旅程

examples.en: Captain Alison will set out at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 艾莉森船长将在八点钟出发。

set out.usage: /set aʊt/ phrasal verb. 出发；启程（表示开始一段旅程或出发去做某事）

examples.en: She set out from the coast in a small boat.
examples.zh: 她乘小船从海岸出发了。

examples.en: She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock.
examples.zh: 她将在早上五点从法国海岸出发。

set out.usage: 意为“出发，启程”，侧重开始一段长途旅行，也可表示着手做某事

examples.en: They set out before dawn to climb the mountain.
examples.zh: 他们在黎明前就出发去爬山了。

set out.usage: 出发；启程，指开始一段旅程

examples.en: Both ships set out from Shanghai on June 18th, 1872.
examples.zh: 两艘船于1872年6月18日从上海出发。

set out.usage: 出发；动身，指开始旅程或着手做某事

examples.en: They set out for the station early in the morning.
examples.zh: 他们一大早就出发去车站了。

plenty of time.usage: 表示时间充足，足够做某事

examples.en: We'll have plenty of time.
examples.zh: 我们将会有充足的时间。

be proud of.usage: 表示为某人或某事感到骄傲和自豪

examples.en: We are very proud of him.
examples.zh: 我们为他感到非常骄傲。

be proud of.usage: 表示“为……感到骄傲/得意”，后接名词、代词或动名词

examples.en: She is very proud of her daughter's performance in the competition.
examples.zh: 她为女儿在比赛中的表现感到非常骄傲。

take part in.usage: 表示参加、参与某项活动或比赛

examples.en: He will take part in an important race.
examples.zh: 他将参加一个重要的比赛。

take part in.usage: 表示参加或参与某项活动、会议、比赛等

examples.en: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
examples.zh: 珍妮弗很快必须参加一个新剧本的演出。

take part in.usage: /teɪk pɑːt ɪn/ phrasal verb. 参加；参与（指参与某项活动或事件）

examples.en: It was the oldest car taking part in the race.
examples.zh: 这是参加比赛的最老的汽车。

examples.en: It has sailed across the Atlantic many times.
examples.zh: 它已经多次横渡大西洋。

examples.en: We'll say goodbye to him.
examples.zh: 我们将向他告别。

be away for.usage: 表示离开某地一段时间

examples.en: He will be away for two months.
examples.zh: 他将离开两个月。

examples.en: We'll meet him at the harbour early in the morning.
examples.zh: 我们将在早晨早些时候在港口见他。

take part.usage: /teɪk pɑːt/ phrasal verb. 参加；参与（take part in表示参与某项活动）
/teɪk pɑːt/ phrase. 参加；参与（指参与某项活动）

at present.usage: 表示"目前，现在"，用于描述当前的情况

examples.en: At present, they are visiting all parts of the country.
examples.zh: 目前，他们正在访问全国各地。

all parts of the country.usage: 表示"全国各地"，强调范围广泛

examples.en: They are visiting all parts of the country.
examples.zh: 他们正在访问全国各地。

at the station.usage: 表示"在车站"，指具体地点

examples.en: Most of the young people will be meeting them at the station.
examples.zh: 大多数年轻人会在车站迎接他们。

give performances.usage: 表示"进行表演"，指演出活动

examples.en: During this time, they will give five performances.
examples.zh: 在此期间，他们将进行五场演出。

keep order.usage: 表示"维持秩序"，指管理人群或维护秩序

examples.en: They will be trying to keep order.
examples.zh: 他们将努力维持秩序。

on these occasions.usage: 表示"在这些场合"，指特定情况或时机

examples.en: It is always the same on these occasions.
examples.zh: 在这些场合，情况总是如此。

as usual.usage: 表示"像往常一样"，描述一贯的情况

examples.en: As usual, the police will have a difficult time.
examples.zh: 像往常一样，警察将会有麻烦。

examples.en: I went and sat on the river bank as usual.
examples.zh: 我像往常一样去河边坐着。

stay for five days.usage: 表示"停留五天"，指停留的时长

examples.en: The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days.
examples.zh: 格林伍德男孩们将停留五天。

trying to.usage: 表示"努力做某事"，强调尝试和努力

examples.en: They will be trying to keep order.
examples.zh: 他们将努力维持秩序。

pop singer.usage: /pɒp ˈsɪŋə/ noun phrase. 流行歌手（指唱流行音乐的歌手）

ask for a lift.usage: 请求搭便车，指请求别人让你免费乘车

examples.en: A young man waved to me and asked me for a lift.
examples.zh: 一个年轻人向我挥手，请求搭便车。

as soon as.usage: 一...就...，表示两件事紧接着发生

examples.en: As soon as he had got into the car, I said good morning to him.
examples.zh: 他一上车，我就用法语向他问好。

examples.en: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal.
examples.zh: 这件事一做完，他们就做饭了。

examples.en: As soon as he saw us, he picked up a long pipe.
examples.zh: 他一看到我们，就拿起一根长笛。

as soon as.usage: 作时间连词，意为“一……就……”。强调两件事几乎立即发生。

examples.en: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside, he comes into the garden and waits until the gate shuts.
examples.zh: 他一从外面打开门，就走进花园，等门关上。

examples.en: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky.
examples.zh: 我一走出帐篷，就把贝琳斯基夫人忘得一干二净。

as soon as.usage: 一...就...，表示两个动作紧接着发生

examples.en: As soon as he finished, Jenny left.
examples.zh: 他一结束，Jenny就离开了。

as soon as.usage: 一...就...，表示两个动作紧接着发生

examples.en: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.
examples.zh: 我一敲车窗，你就必须在五英尺内停车。

examples.en: Apart from a few words, I do not know any French at all.
examples.zh: 除了几个词，我根本不会法语。

apart from.usage: /əˈpɑːt frɒm/ phrase. 除了...之外（相当于except for，表示不包括在内）
表示除了…之外，相当于except for或者besides，根据语境可表示排除或者包含关系

examples.en: Apart from a few spelling mistakes, your composition is very good.
examples.zh: 除了几个拼写错误之外，你的作文写得非常好。

apart from.usage: 表示“除了……之外，撇开……不谈”，既可以表示包含也可以表示排除的含义

examples.en: Apart from the cost, the dress is very suitable for you.
examples.zh: 撇开价格不谈，这条裙子非常适合你。

examples.en: Apart from English, he can also speak French and Japanese.
examples.zh: 除了英语之外，他还会说法语和日语。

apart from.usage: 介词短语，可表示“除了……之外（还）”或“除了……之外（都不）”，相当于besides或except for

examples.en: Apart from any moral considerations this is a stupid method of training.
examples.zh: 且不说道德方面的考虑，这种训练方法本身就很愚蠢。

examples.en: Apart from English, he also learns French and Japanese.
examples.zh: 除了英语之外，他还学习法语和日语。

drove on to.usage: 继续驾车前往，后接目的地

examples.en: I drove on to the next town.
examples.zh: 我继续驾车前往下一个城镇。

neither of us.usage: 我们两人都没有，表示两者否定

examples.en: Neither of us spoke during the journey.
examples.zh: 旅途中我们两人都没说话。

in the south of.usage: 在...的南部，表示地理位置

examples.en: I left a small village in the south of France.
examples.zh: 我离开了法国南部的一个小村庄。

learnt learn.usage: 得知；学会，指通过经历获得信息或技能

examples.en: As I soon learnt, he was English himself!
examples.zh: 我很快得知，他自己就是英国人！

had nearly reached.usage: 几乎到达，表示接近目的地

examples.en: I had nearly reached the town when the young man suddenly spoke.
examples.zh: 我几乎到达城镇时，年轻人突然开口说话。

look up from.usage: 从...抬起头/停下手中的事抬头看

examples.en: He did not look up from his desk when I entered.
examples.zh: 我进去时他没有从桌子上抬起头。

examples.en: The firm could not afford to pay such large salaries.
examples.zh: 公司负担不起这么高的工资。

my turn has come.usage: 轮到我了/我的机会来了

examples.en: I knew that my turn had come.
examples.zh: 我知道轮到我了。

in a weak voice.usage: 用微弱的/怯生生的声音

examples.en: I said in a weak voice.
examples.zh: 我用微弱的声音说道。

examples.en: Don't interrupt, he said.
examples.zh: 不要打断，他说。

receive an extra.usage: 收到额外的.../获得额外的...

examples.en: I would receive an extra thousand pounds a year.
examples.zh: 我每年将额外获得一千英镑。

examples.en: The secretary told me that Mr. Harmsworth would see me.
examples.zh: 秘书告诉我哈姆斯沃斯先生要见我。

examples.en: I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
examples.zh: 我能够告诉他他拔错了牙。

examples.en: She told me that she was coming.
examples.zh: 她告诉我她要来了。

tell someone that.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

examples.en: Twenty people had already left.
examples.zh: 已经有二十个人离开了。

examples.en: I felt very nervous when I went into his office.
examples.zh: 我走进他办公室时感到很紧张。

look up.usage: /lʊk ʌp/ phrasal verb. 抬头看；向上看（指将视线从低处移向高处或从正在做的事抬起头）

examples.en: If you park your car in the wrong place, a traffic policeman will find it.
examples.zh: 如果你把车停错地方，交通警察会找到它。

let you go.usage: 表示让某人离开，文中指不罚款

examples.en: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
examples.zh: 如果他不给你开罚单就放你走，那你就太幸运了。

examples.en: You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs.
examples.zh: 如果你注意我们的街道标志，你会很享受这里的停留。

enjoy your stay.usage: 表示祝某人停留愉快，常用于服务业

examples.en: We hope you will enjoy your stay in our hotel.
examples.zh: 我们希望您在我们酒店过得愉快。

cannot fail to do.usage: 双重否定表示必定、不得不

examples.en: If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it!
examples.zh: 如果你收到这样的请求，你一定会遵守！

examples.en: This is a No Parking area.
examples.zh: 这是禁止停车区域。

find a note on.usage: 表示在某物上发现一张纸条

examples.en: I found this note on my car during a holiday in Sweden.
examples.zh: 在瑞典度假期间，我在我的车上发现了这张纸条。

examples.en: This note is only a reminder.
examples.zh: 这张纸条只是一个提醒。

examples.en: During a holiday in Sweden, I found this note.
examples.zh: 在瑞典度假期间，我发现了这张纸条。

examples.en: We welcome you to our city.
examples.zh: 欢迎来到我们的城市。

in spite of.usage: 表示尽管某种情况存在，通常后接名词或动名词

examples.en: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，她仍然经常在舞台上扮演年轻女孩。

in spite of.usage: /ɪn spaɪt əv/ preposition phrase. 尽管；虽然（用于引出让步状语，与though/although同义）
表示尽管、虽然，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: In spite of this, many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，许多人仍然相信'探测仪'可能会发现有价值的东西。

in spite of.usage: 尽管,虽然,用于引出与主句意思相反的内容

examples.en: In spite of all that has been said, the tourists still come.
examples.zh: 尽管说了这么多,游客们仍然来。

examples.en: In spite of the rain, we went out.
examples.zh: 尽管下雨,我们还是出去了。

in spite of.usage: 表示“尽管，不管”，后接名词、代词或动名词，引导让步关系，相当于despite

examples.en: In spite of the heavy rain, he still went to work on time.
examples.zh: 尽管下着大雨，他还是准时去上班了。

examples.en: They kept climbing the mountain in spite of the bad weather.
examples.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，他们还是继续登山。

examples.en: In spite of this, some people were surprised by a recent exhibition.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，一些人仍然对最近的展览感到惊讶。

in spite of.usage: 表示“尽管，虽然”，后接名词/名词短语，用来引导让步关系，等同于despite

examples.en: In spite of the heavy rain, we still arrived at the meeting on time.
examples.zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们还是准时到达了会场。

examples.en: He kept on running in spite of his injured ankle.
examples.zh: 尽管脚踝受伤了，他还是继续跑步。

appear on the stage.usage: 指在舞台上表演或亮相

examples.en: She often appears on the stage as a young girl.
examples.zh: 她经常在舞台上扮演年轻女孩。

it must be terrible to be.phrase: It must be terrible to be...
it must be terrible to be.usage: 用于表达对某种情况的主观感受，认为某事很糟糕

examples.en: Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!
examples.zh: 亲爱的，长大成人一定很可怕！

examples.en: She had to wear short socks.
examples.zh: 她不得不穿短袜。

a bright red dress.usage: 明亮的红色连衣裙，形容词+颜色构成复合形容词

examples.en: She must appear in a bright red dress.
examples.zh: 她必须穿一件鲜红色的连衣裙。

examples.en: She must wear long black stockings.
examples.zh: 她必须穿黑色长筒袜。

examples.en: If anyone ever asks her how old she is, she always answers...
examples.zh: 如果有人问她多大了，她总是回答说...

a girl of seventeen.usage: 十七岁的女孩，of+年龄表示年龄

examples.en: She will be a girl of seventeen.
examples.zh: 她将扮演一个十七岁的女孩。

examples.en: The landlord smiled and immediately went out.
examples.zh: 店主笑了笑马上出去了。

give back.usage: 归还，指把东西还给原主

examples.en: He returned with my bag and gave it back to me.
examples.zh: 他拿着我的包回来并还给了我。

in a few minutes.usage: 几分钟后，表示很短的时间之后

examples.en: In a few minutes he returned with my bag.
examples.zh: 几分钟后他拿着我的包回来了。

pay the bill.usage: 付账，支付用餐或服务的费用

examples.en: I can't pay the bill. I haven't got my bag.
examples.zh: 我付不了账，我没带包。

have a good meal.usage: 吃得好，享用了一顿美餐

examples.en: Did you have a good meal?
examples.zh: 您吃得好吗？

take into.usage: 带进，把某物或某人带到某处

examples.en: My dog had taken it into the garden.
examples.zh: 我的狗把它叼到花园里去了。

leave on.usage: 放在...上（未带走），指将东西留在某处

examples.en: I had left it on a chair beside the door.
examples.zh: 我把它留在门边的椅子上了。

can i return.usage: 询问是否可以退票的句型

examples.en: Can I return these two tickets?
examples.zh: 我可以退这两张票吗？

could i have.usage: 比May I更委婉的请求句型

examples.en: Could I have those two tickets please?
examples.zh: 请问我可以要那两张票吗？

i might as well.usage: 不如；不妨（虽然不太理想但还是接受）

examples.en: I might as well have them.
examples.zh: 我不如就买了吧。

examples.en: We've sold out.
examples.zh: 已经卖完了。

examples.en: They're for next Wednesday's performance.
examples.zh: 它们是下周三的演出票。

sell out.usage: /sel aʊt/ v.. 售完；卖光（指票或商品全部卖出）

examples.en: I often spend hours fishing.
examples.zh: 我经常花几个小时钓鱼。

examples.en: She spends two hours studying English every day.
examples.zh: 她每天花两个小时学习英语。

examples.en: Instead of catching fish, they caught old boots.
examples.zh: 他们没有捕到鱼，而是捕到了旧靴子。

examples.en: I'll go swimming instead of playing tennis.
examples.zh: 我要去游泳而不是打网球。

examples.en: You must give up fishing!
examples.zh: 你必须放弃钓鱼！

examples.en: He decided to give up smoking.
examples.zh: 他决定戒烟。

give up.usage: 表示放弃、停止做某事，后可接名词或动名词

examples.en: No matter how difficult it is, you should never give up your dream.
examples.zh: 无论有多难，你都不应该放弃自己的梦想。

examples.en: My father gave up smoking last year for his health.
examples.zh: 我爸爸为了健康去年戒烟了。

give up.usage: 动词短语，意为“放弃；投降”，可作不及物短语，也可接名词/动名词作宾语。

examples.en: No matter how difficult the task is, we should never give up easily.
examples.zh: 不管任务有多难，我们都不应该轻易放弃。

examples.en: He decided to give up smoking after he had a bad cough last month.
examples.zh: 上个月他咳嗽得很厉害之后，决定戒烟。

examples.en: I'm not really interested in fishing.
examples.zh: 我其实对钓鱼并不感兴趣。

examples.en: Are you interested in music?
examples.zh: 你对音乐感兴趣吗？

examples.en: I never catch anything -- not even old boots.
examples.zh: 我从来什么都抓不到——甚至连旧靴子都抓不到。

examples.en: He can't even read.
examples.zh: 他甚至不会读书。

examples.en: It's a waste of time.
examples.zh: 这是浪费时间。

examples.en: Watching too much TV is a waste of time.
examples.zh: 看太多电视是浪费时间。

a waste of time.usage: 表示认为某件事没有价值、不值得花费时间，常用在regard/consider sth. as a waste of time结构中

examples.en: Many people regard debating this trivial issue as a waste of time.
examples.zh: 很多人认为争论这个无关紧要的问题是浪费时间。

examples.en: I always go home with an empty bag.
examples.zh: 我总是带着空袋子回家。

examples.en: What time do you usually go home?
examples.zh: 你通常几点回家？

after having spent.usage: 在花费...之后（分词完成式）

examples.en: After having spent whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag.
examples.zh: 在整个河上度过早晨之后，我总是带着空袋子回家。

examples.en: I'm only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all!
examples.zh: 我只对坐在船里什么都不做感兴趣！

examples.en: He sat there doing nothing at all.
examples.zh: 他坐在那里什么都不做。

examples.en: But this does not worry me.
examples.zh: 但这并没有让我担心。

examples.en: Don't worry me with your problems.
examples.zh: 别用你的问题来烦我。

night and day.usage: 日以继夜，表示持续不断发生

examples.en: The machines work night and day.
examples.zh: 机器日夜不停地运转。

night and day.usage: /naɪt ænd deɪ/ phrase. 日日夜夜；夜以继日（表示持续不断，强调时间之长）

examples.en: The constant noise drove me mad.
examples.zh: 持续的噪音让我快要发疯了。

examples.en: The new railway came into use last year.
examples.zh: 新铁路去年开始启用。

come into use.usage: /kʌm ˈɪntu juːz/ phrase. 开始使用（表示某物被投入使用）

examples.en: The farmers drove the cows away from the field.
examples.zh: 农民们把牛赶出田地。

drive away.usage: /draɪv əˈweɪ/ phrase. 驱赶；赶走（表示迫使某人离开某地）

examples.en: The old building was knocked down last month.
examples.zh: 那栋旧楼上个月被拆除了。

examples.en: He received a large sum of money from his uncle.
examples.zh: 他从他叔叔那里得到了一大笔钱。

examples.en: A large sum of money was lost.
examples.zh: 一大笔钱丢失了。

examples.en: She is determined to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 她决心按时完成这个项目。

examples.en: For some reason, the meeting was cancelled.
examples.zh: 由于某种原因，会议被取消了。

examples.en: You must be tired after the long journey.
examples.zh: 长途旅行后你一定很累。

examples.en: He is one of the few people who can speak five languages.
examples.zh: 他是少数能说五种语言的人之一。

never dreamed of.usage: 表示从未想过、从不敢想，用于强调意外或惊讶

examples.en: She never dreamed of winning the lottery.
examples.zh: 她从未想过会中彩票。

throw into.usage: 把...扔进...，强调动作的方向性

examples.en: She threw the bottle into the sea.
examples.zh: 她把瓶子扔进了海里。

examples.en: I often think of my childhood.
examples.zh: 我经常想起我的童年。

examples.en: I write to my parents every week.
examples.zh: 我每周给父母写信。

decide to.usage: 决定做某事，表示经过思考后做出选择

examples.en: They decided to go camping.
examples.zh: 他们决定去野营。

examples.en: I decided to visit a fortune-teller.
examples.zh: 我决定去拜访一位算命师。

a little more.usage: 多一点，修饰不可数名词或形容词比较级

examples.en: I need a little more time.
examples.zh: 我还需要一点时间。

ten months later.usage: 十个月后，表示过去某个时间点之后的时间

examples.en: He left home, and ten months later he returned.
examples.zh: 他离开了家，十个月后他回来了。

post office.usage: /pəʊst ˈɒfɪs/ noun phrase. 邮局（指寄送信件和包裹的机构）
/pəʊst ˈɒfɪs/ noun. 邮局（邮寄信件和包裹的地方）

examples.en: I had a letter from my sister yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我收到了姐姐的来信。

examples.en: If she comes, she will get a surprise.
examples.zh: 如果她来，她会大吃一惊。

examples.en: She could stay with us.
examples.zh: 她可以和我们住在一起。

examples.en: Work on it had begun before my sister left.
examples.zh: 在我姐姐离开之前，工程就已经开始了。

examples.en: She would come to England next year.
examples.zh: 她明年要来英国。

examples.en: The house was completed five months ago.
examples.zh: 房子五个月前竣工了。

examples.en: It must be the only modern house in the district.
examples.zh: 它一定是这个地区唯一的现代房子。

examples.en: It looks strange to some people.
examples.zh: 对某些人来说它看起来很奇怪。

examples.en: The house has many large rooms.
examples.zh: 这所房子有许多大房间。

examples.en: I lost my wallet on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公交车上丢了钱包。

examples.en: Everyone's losing money these days.
examples.zh: 如今每个人都在丢钱。

examples.en: I felt very upset when I found my money was gone.
examples.zh: 发现钱不见了时我感到非常不安。

examples.en: I left the money in my room.
examples.zh: 我把钱落在房间里了。

examples.en: She put an envelope on his desk.
examples.zh: 她把一个信封放在他桌上。

examples.en: He started to complain about this wicked world.
examples.zh: 他开始抱怨这个邪恶的世界。

examples.en: Almost immediately he began to complain about the weather.
examples.zh: 几乎立刻他就开始抱怨天气。

examples.en: He was interrupted by a knock at the door.
examples.zh: 他被敲门声打断了。

examples.en: I found this outside this gentleman's room.
examples.zh: 我在这位先生的房间外面发现的。

examples.en: There is still some honesty in this world.
examples.zh: 这个世界上仍然有诚实。

these days.usage: /ðiːz deɪz/ phrase. 现在，如今（指当前这个时期）

examples.en: I arrived in London at last.
examples.zh: 我终于到达伦敦了。

examples.en: When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth...
examples.zh: 当牙医终于从我嘴里取出棉球时...

examples.en: At last, the bus arrived.
examples.zh: 公交车终于来了。

at last.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

examples.en: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire.
examples.zh: 消防员们终于扑灭了一场大规模的森林火灾。

examples.en: I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
examples.zh: 我说英语不仅非常认真，而且非常清晰。

examples.en: It is not only of immense size, but is extremely accurate as well.
examples.zh: 它不仅体积巨大，而且非常精确。

examples.en: Not only was the meal well below the usual standard, but Bessie seemed unable to walk steadily.
examples.zh: 不仅饭菜远不如平时，而且贝齐看起来连路都走不稳。

examples.en: I repeated my question several times.
examples.zh: 我把我的问题重复了好几次。

examples.en: The porter and I looked at each other and smiled.
examples.zh: 行李员和我互相看着对方，笑了。

examples.en: In England, each person speaks a different language.
examples.zh: 在英国，每个人说不同的语言。

examples.en: The English understand each other, but I don't understand them.
examples.zh: 英国人彼此能理解，但我却听不懂他们。

examples.en: I did not know the way to my hotel.
examples.zh: 我不知道去我酒店的路。

examples.en: So I asked a porter.
examples.zh: 所以我向一个行李员询问。

examples.en: You'll soon learn English!
examples.zh: 你很快就会学会英语！

examples.en: We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢它们就像喜欢漂亮的窗帘布料一样。

examples.en: She came into my room yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天走进我的房间。

examples.en: She looked at it critically for a moment.
examples.zh: 她批判性地看了一会儿。

examples.en: I'm hanging this picture on the wall.
examples.zh: 我正把这幅画挂在墙上。

examples.en: She always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
examples.zh: 她总是告诉我我的画好不好。

examples.en: Many pictures are not 'about' anything.
examples.zh: 许多画并不'关于'任何东西。

upside down.usage: /ˌʌpsaɪd ˈdaʊn/ phrase. 上下颠倒；倒置（方向或位置颠倒）

examples.en: The boys put up their tent in the field.
examples.zh: 男孩们在田地里搭起了帐篷。

put up.usage: 表示张贴、建造或竖起某物

examples.en: They put up a tent in the garden.
examples.zh: 他们在花园里搭起了帐篷。

put up.usage: 此处指搭建、建造；还可表示张贴、提供住宿

examples.en: They plan to put up a temporary office on the construction site.
examples.zh: 他们计划在工地上搭建一间临时办公室。

examples.en: We can put you up for the night if you miss the last train.
examples.zh: 如果你赶不上末班车，我们可以给你提供一晚住宿。

examples.en: They put out the fire and crept into their tent.
examples.zh: 他们熄灭营火然后爬进帐篷。

examples.en: Firemen have put out a big forest fire.
examples.zh: 消防员已经扑灭了一场大规模的森林火灾。

examples.en: When the fire had at last been put out, the forest authorities ordered grass-seed.
examples.zh: 当大火终于被扑灭后，森林管理局订购了草籽。

examples.en: It took the firefighters three hours to put out the forest fire.
examples.zh: 消防员花了三个小时才扑灭这场森林火灾。

examples.en: Two boys woke up and began shouting.
examples.zh: 两个男孩醒来开始大喊。

examples.en: When she woke up a day later, she found herself in hospital.
examples.zh: 当她一天后醒来时，她发现自己在医院里。

examples.en: The young man did not wake up until the bed had struck the ground.
examples.zh: 直到床撞到地面，他才醒来。

examples.en: I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the doorbell.
examples.zh: 我按门铃试图叫醒我的妻子。

examples.en: The alarm clock woke me up at six.
examples.zh: 闹钟六点把我叫醒了。

examples.en: They leapt out of their sleeping bags.
examples.zh: 他们从睡袋里跳出来。

examples.en: The tent was full of water!
examples.zh: 帐篷里全是水！

in the middle of the night.phrase: in the middle of the night

examples.en: In the middle of the night, two boys woke up.
examples.zh: 在半夜，两个男孩醒来了。

examples.en: The stream wound its way across the field.
examples.zh: 小溪蜿蜒穿过田野。

examples.en: They hurried outside to see what happened.
examples.zh: 他们匆忙跑出去看发生了什么。

examples.en: They told stories and sang songs by the campfire.
examples.zh: 他们在营火旁讲故事、唱歌。

sleeping bag.usage: /ˈsliːpɪŋ bæɡ/ noun. 睡袋（露营时使用的保暖袋状寝具）

examples.en: He parked his car outside the shop.
examples.zh: 他把车停在了商店外面。

have trouble with.usage: 表示与某人某事有麻烦或纠纷

examples.en: She has trouble with her neighbors.
examples.zh: 她和邻居有麻烦。

turn tointo.usage: 表示变成某种状态或事物

examples.en: The water turned into ice.
examples.zh: 水变成了冰。

ever since.usage: 表示从那时起一直到现在

examples.en: He has been ill ever since last week.
examples.zh: 从上周起他就一直生病。

ever since.usage: 自从；从那以后一直。指从过去的某个时间点一直持续到现在

examples.en: There are countless people who, ever since their early years, have learned to associate snails with food.
examples.zh: 有无数人从童年时代起就学会把蜗牛和食物联系起来。

ever since.unitTitle: One Man's Meat is Another Man's Poison

because of.usage: 表示因为、由于（后接名词或代词）

examples.en: Because of the rain, we stayed at home.
examples.zh: 因为下雨，我们待在家里。

examples.en: The operation proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin.
examples.zh: 由于坚硬的树脂，手术变得非常困难。

examples.en: We cancelled the trip because of the bad weather.
examples.zh: 由于天气不好，我们取消了旅行。

examples.en: The medicine had no effect on him.
examples.zh: 这药对他没有效果。

one of.phrase: one of + 最高级 + 复数名词

examples.en: This is one of the most beautiful cities in the world.
examples.zh: 这是世界上最美丽的城市之一。

examples.en: Captain Fawcett has begun a new service.
examples.zh: 福西特机长开始了一项新服务。

examples.en: This wonderful plane can carry seven passengers.
examples.zh: 这架神奇的飞机能载七名乘客。

examples.en: It can land anywhere: on snow, water, or even on a ploughed field.
examples.zh: 它能在任何地方降落：雪上、水上，甚至在耕过的田地上。

examples.en: A doctor flew from Birmingham to a lonely village.
examples.zh: 一位医生从伯明翰飞到一个偏僻的村庄。

examples.en: On another occasion, he landed in a deserted car park.
examples.zh: 另一次，他降落在一个人迹罕至的停车场。

examples.en: Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request.
examples.zh: 福西特机长刚刚拒绝了一个奇怪的请求。

examples.en: The man wanted to fly to Rockall.
examples.zh: 那个人想要飞往罗卡尔岛。

examples.en: The trip was too dangerous.
examples.zh: 这趟旅行太危险了。

examples.en: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats.
examples.zh: 有一次他降落在了一栋公寓楼的屋顶上。

examples.en: Captain Fawcett did not take him because the trip was too dangerous.
examples.zh: 福西特机长没有带他去，因为旅途太危险了。

examples.en: The Wayle is a small river that cuts across the park.
examples.zh: 韦尔河是一条穿过我家附近公园的小河。

examples.en: Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat.
examples.zh: 岸上的一些人向船里的男人大声喊叫。

examples.en: There weren't any in sight.
examples.zh: 一个人影也看不见。

examples.en: There were no more mountains in sight.
examples.zh: 眼前再也没有山脉了。

examples.en: The destination was finally in sight.
examples.zh: 目的地终于出现在视野中了。

examples.en: There was nobody in sight to help me.
examples.zh: 看不到有任何人在场能帮我。

examples.en: They had all run away!
examples.zh: 他们都跑走了！

examples.en: The boy ran away from home.
examples.zh: 那个男孩从家里逃跑了。

examples.en: It went towards a passing boat.
examples.zh: 它朝一条经过的船飞去。

examples.en: He threw the ball back to the bank.
examples.zh: 他把球扔回岸上。

examples.en: Some children were playing games on the bank.
examples.zh: 一些孩子在岸上玩游戏。

examples.en: I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在晴朗的下午坐在韦尔河边。

used to.usage: 表示过去的习惯性动作或状态，现在已不再继续

examples.en: He used to work in a small shop.
examples.zh: 他过去在一家小商店工作。

examples.en: Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
examples.zh: Frank过去制造飞机配件。

used to.usage: 用于表示过去经常做但现在不再做的动作或状态。结构：主语 + used to + 动词原形。

examples.en: Our dog, Rex, used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
examples.zh: 我们的狗Rex过去常常坐在前门外叫。

used to.usage: 表示过去习惯性的动作或状态，现在已不再如此

examples.en: I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
examples.zh: 我小时候经常乘飞机旅行。

examples.en: My parents used to live in South America.
examples.zh: 我父母过去住在南美洲。

examples.en: The profits were used to build museums and colleges.
examples.zh: 展览的利润用来建造博物馆和学院。

examples.en: He saved money for years.
examples.zh: 他存了好几年的钱。

examples.en: In 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
examples.zh: 1958年他买下了自己的一个小车间。

examples.en: In his twenties Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
examples.zh: Frank在二十多岁时制造飞机配件。

examples.en: In a few years the small workshop had become a large factory.
examples.zh: 几年之后这个小车间变成了一个大工厂。

examples.en: He remembered his hard early years and the long road to success.
examples.zh: 他想起了早年艰难的岁月和通往成功的漫漫长路。

examples.en: She wanted him to repair their grandson's bicycle!
examples.zh: 她想让他修理他们孙子的自行车！

examples.en: At that time he used to work fourteen hours a day.
examples.zh: 在那时他每天工作十四个小时。

not soas.usage: 用于比较，表示前者不如后者

examples.en: People are not so honest as they once were.
examples.zh: 人们不像以前那样诚实了。

examples.en: This problem is not so difficult as that one.
examples.zh: 这个问题不像那个那么难。

more than ever before.usage: 比以前任何时候都...，表示程度增加

examples.en: The temptation to steal is greater than ever before.
examples.zh: 偷窃的诱惑比以往任何时候都大。

as quickly as possible.usage: 尽可能快地，表示尽快完成某事

examples.en: The assistant wrapped it up as quickly as possible.
examples.zh: 店员尽快把它包好。

examples.en: The woman walked out of the shop without paying.
examples.zh: 那个女人没付款就走出了商店。

examples.en: The woman walked out of the shop angrily.
examples.zh: 那个女人生气地走出了商店。

find out.usage: 发现，查明，指通过调查了解真相

examples.en: The detective found out that the assistant was her daughter.
examples.zh: 侦探发现那个店员是她女儿。

examples.en: They have been trying to find out how the fire began.
examples.zh: 他们一直试图查明这场火是怎么烧起来的。

examples.en: The doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
examples.zh: 医生们一直在试图查明这名女子是否死于一种罕见疾病。

examples.en: Please find out what time the train leaves.
examples.zh: 请查一下火车什么时候出发。

find out.usage: 表示“查明，弄清楚”，侧重通过努力、调查等获知事实真相

examples.en: She wanted to find out whether the costume was comfortable to wear.
examples.zh: 她想弄清楚这件化装服穿起来是否舒服。

examples.en: Please find out when the train leaves.
examples.zh: 请查一下火车什么时候开。

find out.usage: 表示经过调查、询问等过程后查明、弄清某个事实，强调主动探索的过程

examples.en: After telling several of his friends about the theft, Dimitri found out that his neighbour, Aleko, had suddenly acquired a new lamb.
examples.zh: 迪米特里把丢羊的事告诉了几个朋友之后，发现他的邻居阿列科突然多了一只新的小羊。

examples.en: The police are trying to find out the truth of the accident.
examples.zh: 警方正在努力查明这起事故的真相。

give someone something.usage: 给某人某物，表示赠送或提供

examples.en: The girl gave her mother a free dress once a week.
examples.zh: 女孩每周给她妈妈一件免费的衣服。

once a week.usage: 每周一次，表示固定频率

examples.en: She goes to the gym once a week.
examples.zh: 她每周去一次健身房。

once a week.usage: /wʌns ə wiːk/ phrase. 每周一次（表示频率的固定搭配）

examples.en: She handed the dress to an assistant.
examples.zh: 她把裙子递给店员。

examples.en: She was caught in a storm.
examples.zh: 她遇到了暴风雨。

be caught in.usage: 表示“遭遇、陷入（坏天气、困境等）”，通常用于被动结构

examples.en: He walked into an expensive shop after having been caught in a particularly heavy shower.
examples.zh: 他遇上了一场特别大的阵雨，之后走进了一家高档商店。

examples.en: We were caught in a traffic jam on the way to the airport.
examples.zh: 我们在去机场的路上遇上了交通堵塞。

examples.en: Towards evening, the boat struck a rock.
examples.zh: 临近傍晚时，小船撞上了一块礁石。

examples.en: The girl jumped into the sea.
examples.zh: 女孩跳入了海中。

examples.en: He jumped into the car and drove away.
examples.zh: 他钻进车里开走了。

examples.en: She spent the whole night in the water.
examples.zh: 她在水中度过了整晚。

examples.en: She knew she was near the shore.
examples.zh: 她知道自己靠近海岸了。

on arriving.usage: 表示一到达就...（相当于as soon as she arrived）

examples.en: On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff.
examples.zh: 一到达海岸，女孩就艰难地向上爬向悬崖。

examples.en: On arriving in England, they were taken to the Crystal Palace.
examples.zh: 一到英国，他们就被带到水晶宫。

examples.en: The girl struggled up the cliff towards the light.
examples.zh: 女孩艰难地向悬崖上的灯光爬去。

examples.en: During that time she covered a distance of eight miles.
examples.zh: 在那段时间里，她游了八英里。

pick up.usage: 表示偶然发现、捡起或接人

examples.en: The bicycle was picked up in a small village.
examples.zh: 自行车是在一个小村庄被发现的。

examples.en: I'll pick you up at the airport.
examples.zh: 我会去机场接你。

pick up.usage: /pɪk ʌp/ verb phrase. 捡起；偶然发现（表示发现或拾起某物）

examples.en: He picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins.
examples.zh: 他拿起一根装饰着硬币的长笛。

examples.en: The man sadly picked up the mattress.
examples.zh: 那人伤心地捡起床垫。

pick up.usage: /pɪk ʌp/ phrasal verb. 搭载，捡起（指让人上车或拾起某物）

examples.en: They can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
examples.zh: 他们能从池底捡起重物。

pick up.usage: 此处表示接走、营救某人，也可表示捡起、学会（知识/技能）、接收到信号等含义

examples.en: The lifeboat picked up all the survivors from the sunken ship.
examples.zh: 救生艇救起了沉船上的所有幸存者。

examples.en: I picked up some Japanese when I was travelling in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 我在东京旅行的时候学会了一些日语。

pick up.usage: 此处表示轻易买到、便宜买到，还可表示捡起、学会（语言）、接人等含义

examples.en: She picked up a beautiful vintage dress at the second-hand market for only 100 yuan.
examples.zh: 她在二手市场只花了100元就买到了一件漂亮的复古连衣裙。

pick up.usage: 此处含义为“接收到（信号、声音、图像等）”，此外还有“捡起；接人；学会”等含义

examples.en: My radio can pick up international stations very clearly.
examples.zh: 我的收音机可以非常清晰地接收国际电台。

examples.en: The equipment picked up a strange signal from outer space.
examples.zh: 这台设备接收到了一个来自外太空的奇怪信号。

examples.en: Dan Robinson has been worried all week.
examples.zh: 丹·鲁滨逊整个星期都很担心。

examples.en: She was worried about her exam.
examples.zh: 她担心她的考试。

examples.en: Dan was most surprised when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 丹听到这个消息时非常惊讶。

examples.en: We were surprised at the result.
examples.zh: 我们对结果感到惊讶。

examples.en: We were very much surprised when the snake charmer began to play jazz.
examples.zh: 当耍蛇人开始演奏爵士乐时，我们非常惊讶。

examples.en: He was amused too, because he never expected the bicycle to be found.
examples.zh: 他也觉得好笑，因为他从未期望自行车能被找到。

examples.en: He has been worried all week.
examples.zh: 他整个星期都很担心。

examples.en: Dan wondered why he was wanted by the police.
examples.zh: 丹想知道为什么警察要找他。

examples.en: He never expected the bicycle to be found.
examples.zh: 他从未期望自行车能被找到。

examples.en: I never expected to see you here.
examples.zh: 我从未想到会在这里见到你。

used to do sth.usage: 表示过去习惯性的动作或状态，现在已不再发生

examples.en: Roy used to drive a taxi.
examples.zh: Roy过去常开出租车。

a short while ago.usage: 表示不久之前，相当于not long ago

examples.en: A short while ago, he became a bus driver.
examples.zh: 不久之前，他成了一名公交车司机。

examples.en: A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
examples.zh: 刚才，我妹妹帮我把一个旧书架抬上楼梯。

examples.en: A short while ago, he was still a student.
examples.zh: 刚才，他还是个学生。

far more exciting.usage: far用于加强比较级，表示更加、得多

examples.en: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
examples.zh: 他发现新工作更加令人兴奋。

examples.en: He saw two thieves rush out of a shop.
examples.zh: 他看见两个小偷从一家商店冲出来。

examples.en: The thieves ran towards a waiting car.
examples.zh: 小偷们朝一辆等候的汽车跑去。

examples.en: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
examples.zh: Roy迅速行动，把公交车直接开向小偷。

examples.en: As the thieves were trying to get away in their car...
examples.zh: 当小偷们试图开车逃走时...

examples.en: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car.
examples.zh: 不久之后，警察拦住了那辆车。

examples.en: She hopes to set up a new world record.
examples.zh: 她希望创造一项新的世界纪录。

examples.en: He has surely set up a record for truant children.
examples.zh: 他无疑为逃学的孩子们创下了一项纪录。

examples.en: Many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
examples.zh: 许多人认为她一定会成功。

examples.en: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
examples.zh: Debbie打算每两小时短暂休息一次。

examples.en: Most of Debbie's school friends will be waiting for her on the English coast.
examples.zh: Debbie的大部分同学将在英国海岸等她。

examples.en: The world had to wait almost another 100 years.
examples.zh: 世界不得不再等将近100年。

examples.en: I bought a paper and waited for the train.
examples.zh: 我买了份报纸等火车。

examples.en: Debbie Hart is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.
examples.zh: Debbie Hart打算明天游过英吉利海峡。

examples.en: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims.
examples.zh: 明天当她游泳时他将焦虑地注视着她。

in four years time.usage: 表示从现在起的四年后，用于谈论将来的时间点

examples.en: The Olympic Games will be held in four years' time.
examples.zh: 奥运会将在四年后举行。

look forward to.usage: 表示期待、盼望，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: We are looking forward to the Olympic Games.
examples.zh: 我们期待着奥运会的到来。

by the end of.usage: 表示到...末为止，用于表示完成某事的时间期限

examples.en: Workers will have completed the new roads by the end of this year.
examples.zh: 工人们将在今年年底前完成新道路的建设。

go up.usage: 表示（建筑等）被建造、崛起

examples.en: Everybody will be watching as the new buildings go up.
examples.zh: 大家都会关注新建筑的拔地而起。

the whole area.usage: 表示整个区域、整个地区

examples.en: The whole area will be called 'Olympic City'.
examples.zh: 整个区域将被叫做'奥运城'。

just outside.usage: 表示就在...外面，形容距离很近

examples.en: The Games will be held just outside the capital.
examples.zh: 奥运会将在首都的郊外举行。

examples.en: The driver left him just outside the city.
examples.zh: 司机把他留在城外不远处。

be excited.usage: 表示感到兴奋、激动的状态

examples.en: We are all very excited about the Olympic Games.
examples.zh: 我们对奥运会都感到非常兴奋。

olympic games.usage: /əˈlɪmpɪk ɡeɪmz/ noun phrase. 奥运会（指国际性的体育赛事，每四年举办一次）

settle down.usage: 指在某地安顿下来，长期居住

examples.en: He planned to settle down in the country.
examples.zh: 他计划在这个国家安顿下来。

settle down.usage: /ˈsetl daʊn/ verb phrase. 定居；安顿下来（指在某地长期居住或安定下来）

examples.en: Hans settled down in a village fifty miles away.
examples.zh: 汉斯在五十英里外的一个村庄定居下来。

settle down.usage: 此处表示“定居；安顿下来”，也可指“平静下来；安定下来过稳定生活”

examples.en: After travelling for years, he decided to settle down in the countryside.
examples.zh: 游历多年后，他决定在乡村定居下来。

no soonerthan.usage: 表示一...就...，用于描述两个紧接着发生的动作

examples.en: He had no sooner returned than he bought a house.
examples.zh: 他一回来就买了一栋房子。

no soonerthan.usage: 一...就...，强调两个动作紧接发生

examples.en: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang.
examples.zh: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了。

no soonerthan.usage: 表示“一…就…”，引导时间状语从句，no sooner位于句首时句子要部分倒装

examples.en: I had no sooner got off the ship than I was assailed by a man who wanted to sell me a diamond ring.
examples.zh: 我一下船就被一个想要卖给我钻石戒指的男子缠住了。

examples.en: No sooner had we sat down than the film started.
examples.zh: 我们刚一坐下电影就开始了。

no soonerthan.usage: 固定句型，意为“一……就……”，引导时间状语从句，no sooner位于句首时主句要部分倒装。

examples.en: No sooner had we sat down at the table than the doorbell rang.
examples.zh: 我们刚在桌子旁坐下，门铃就响了。

examples.en: He no sooner finished his speech than the audience burst into warm applause.
examples.zh: 他刚做完演讲，观众就爆发出热烈的掌声。

more than one could bear.usage: 表示超过某人能忍受的限度

examples.en: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
examples.zh: 最后，他实在无法忍受了。

examples.en: He had often dreamed of retiring in England.
examples.zh: 他经常梦想在英国退休。

examples.en: Children who dream of evading school.
examples.zh: 梦想逃学的孩子们。

dream of.usage: 表示“梦想，渴望”，后面接名词或动名词，指向往某个还未实现的目标

examples.en: Many senior scientists dream of sending people to Mars.
examples.zh: 许多资深科学家梦想着把人类送上火星。

examples.en: She dreamed of becoming a professional dancer when she was a child.
examples.zh: 她小时候梦想成为一名专业舞者。

as if.usage: 表示好像、似乎，引导方式状语从句

examples.en: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
examples.zh: 他的表现就好像他从未在英国住过一样。

examples.en: He sold the house and left the country.
examples.zh: 他把房子卖了，离开了这个国家。

be in hospital.usage: 住院，表示生病或接受治疗而在医院

examples.en: John Gilbert was in hospital last week.
examples.zh: 约翰·吉尔伯特上周住院了。

the following day.usage: 第二天，指某事件之后的那一天

examples.en: The following day, the patient asked for a telephone.
examples.zh: 第二天，病人要了一个电话。

examples.en: When he was alone, he telephoned the hospital.
examples.zh: 当他独自一人时，他给医院打了电话。

examples.en: He asked his doctor to tell him about the operation.
examples.zh: 他请求医生告诉他关于手术的情况。

examples.en: When would he be allowed to go home?
examples.zh: 什么时候他才被允许回家？

be allowed to do sth.usage: 被动语态搭配，意为“被允许做某事”，表示得到许可做某件事

examples.en: The dogs are allowed to wander outside their enclosure in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天狗被允许在围场外面闲逛。

examples.en: Students are not allowed to use mobile phones in class in most schools.
examples.zh: 大多数学校不允许学生在课堂上使用手机。

examples.en: He would have to stay in hospital for another two weeks.
examples.zh: 他还得再住院两周。

examples.en: He telephoned the hospital exchange.
examples.zh: 他给医院总机打了电话。

examples.en: Are you a relative of the patient?
examples.zh: 你是病人的亲戚吗？

examples.en: The doctor refused to tell him.
examples.zh: 医生拒绝告诉他。

examples.en: The teacher asked me to sit next to Tom.
examples.zh: 老师让我坐在汤姆旁边。

examples.en: I took my seat beside the window.
examples.zh: 我在窗边坐了下来。

examples.en: He tried to make conversation with the stranger.
examples.zh: 他试图和那个陌生人攀谈。

examples.en: A new film is coming to our cinema next week.
examples.zh: 一部新电影下周将在我们电影院上映。

examples.en: We are going to see a play tonight.
examples.zh: 我们今晚要去看话剧。

examples.en: Many people spend holidays abroad in summer.
examples.zh: 很多人在夏天去国外度假。

examples.en: Will you stay in China for the holiday?
examples.zh: 你假期会留在中国吗？

examples.en: In despair, he gave up trying.
examples.zh: 绝望地，他放弃了尝试。

examples.en: We all enjoyed our dinner very much.
examples.zh: 我们都很享受这顿晚餐。

examples.en: If you eat more and talk less, you will be healthier.
examples.zh: 如果你多吃少说，你会更健康。

you neednt be so rude.usage: 表示不必如此粗鲁，用于表达对他人不礼貌行为的不满

examples.en: You needn't be so rude about it.
examples.zh: 你不必为此这么粗鲁。

you neednt be so rude.unitTitle: Do You Call That a Hat

looked at herself in the mirror.phrase: looked at herself in the mirror
looked at herself in the mirror.usage: 照镜子，描述看着镜中的自己

examples.en: My wife looked at herself in the mirror.
examples.zh: 我妻子看着镜中的自己。

looked at herself in the mirror.unitTitle: Do You Call That a Hat

examples.en: We mustn't buy things we don't need.
examples.zh: 我们不应该买不需要的东西。

buy things we dont need.unitTitle: Do You Call That a Hat

i neednt have said that.usage: 表示本不必说（但已经说了），带有后悔意味

examples.en: I regretted saying it almost at once. You needn't have said that.
examples.zh: 我几乎立刻就后悔说了那句话。你本不必说的。

i neednt have said that.unitTitle: Do You Call That a Hat

a man can never have too many ties.phrase: A man can never have too many ties
a man can never have too many ties.usage: 男人永远不会嫌领带太多（自我安慰的话）

examples.en: A man can never have too many ties.
examples.zh: 男人永远不会嫌领带太多。

a man can never have too many ties.unitTitle: Do You Call That a Hat

examples.en: Ten minutes later we walked out of the shop together.
examples.zh: 十分钟后我们一起走出了商店。

walked out of the shop.unitTitle: Do You Call That a Hat
