wearing a hat.usage: 戴着帽子，描述穿戴状态

examples.en: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!
examples.zh: 我妻子戴着一顶看起来像灯塔的帽子！

wearing a hat.unitTitle: Do You Call That a Hat

examples.en: My wife was still in front of the mirror.
examples.zh: 我妻子还在镜子前。

in front of the mirror.unitTitle: Do You Call That a Hat

examples.en: I sat down on one of those modern chairs.
examples.zh: 我坐在一把现代化的椅子上。

sit down on.unitTitle: Do You Call That a Hat

i neednt remind you.usage: 我不需要提醒你（暗示对方应该记得）

examples.en: I needn't remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday.
examples.zh: 我不需要提醒你那条昨天买的糟糕领带。

i neednt remind you.unitTitle: Do You Call That a Hat

examples.en: We stopped at a square to have a rest.
examples.zh: 我们在广场上停下来休息。

examples.en: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements.
examples.zh: 它从篮子里升起来，开始跟着动作移动。

examples.en: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz.
examples.zh: 它显然无法区分印度音乐和爵士乐。

examples.en: The snake continued to 'dance' slowly.
examples.zh: 蛇继续慢慢地'跳舞'。

examples.en: When he began to play a tune, we had our first glimpse of the snake.
examples.zh: 当他开始吹奏曲子时，我们第一次瞥见了那条蛇。

begin to do sth.usage: 开始做某事，表示动作的开始

examples.en: Workers began to unload the boxes.
examples.zh: 工人们开始卸箱子。

examples.en: We noticed a snake charmer at the other side of the square.
examples.zh: 我们注意到广场另一侧有一个耍蛇人。

snake charmer.usage: /sneɪk ˈtʃɑːmə(r)/ noun. 耍蛇人，吹笛者（指用笛子控制蛇的人，在印度等地常见）

run into trouble.usage: 遇到麻烦/困难，指突然遭遇问题

examples.en: They soon ran into serious trouble.
examples.zh: 他们很快遇到了严重的麻烦。

examples.en: The project ran into financial trouble.
examples.zh: 这个项目陷入了财务困境。

at one point.usage: 在某一时刻；在某种程度上

examples.en: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.
examples.zh: 在某个时刻，看起来他们的飞机肯定会坠毁。

examples.en: At one point, I thought I would give up.
examples.zh: 在某个时刻，我以为我会放弃。

examples.en: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet.
examples.zh: 只有上升到一万英尺才能越过这些山脉。

examples.en: She couldn't get over her fear of heights.
examples.zh: 她无法克服恐高症。

rise to.usage: 上升到；上升到某个高度或水平

examples.en: The plane rose to 10,000 feet.
examples.zh: 飞机上升到一万英尺。

examples.en: The temperature will rise to 30 degrees today.
examples.zh: 今天气温将上升到30度。

examples.en: Byrd ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.
examples.zh: 伯德命令他的手下扔出两个沉重的食物袋。

examples.en: Please throw out the trash.
examples.zh: 请把垃圾扔出去。

examples.en: The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.
examples.zh: 飞机能够毫无困难地飞越无边无际的白色平原。

examples.en: She finished the test without difficulty.
examples.zh: 她毫不费力地完成了考试。

examples.en: They took photographs of the mountains that lay below.
examples.zh: 他们拍摄了位于下方的山脉照片。

examples.en: A beautiful valley lay below the mountain.
examples.zh: 山下是一片美丽的山谷。

examples.en: She ran through the forest to catch the thieves.
examples.zh: 她穿过森林去追小偷。

examples.en: The two men rushed up to her while she was having a picnic.
examples.zh: 那两个男人趁她野餐时冲向她。

examples.en: They tried to steal her handbag.
examples.zh: 他们试图偷她的手提包。

examples.en: She was soon out of breath, but she continued to run.
examples.zh: 她很快气喘吁吁，但她继续跑。

examples.en: When she caught up with them, she saw they were going through the bag.
examples.zh: 当她追上他们时，她看到他们正在翻包。

examples.en: They were going through the contents of the bag.
examples.zh: 他们正在翻看包里的东西。

go through.usage: 此处含义是“仔细检查”，还有“经历、度过”的含义

examples.en: The police went through all the evidence to find the truth.
examples.zh: 警方仔细检查了所有证据来找出真相。

examples.en: She ran straight at them.
examples.zh: 她径直向他们冲去。

examples.en: The men got such a fright that they dropped the bag and ran away.
examples.zh: 那些男人吓得扔下包逃跑了。

examples.en: How did Mrs. Sterling get her bag back?
examples.zh: 斯特林夫人是怎么拿回她的包的？

examples.en: Mrs. Sterling did not think of the risk she was taking.
examples.zh: 斯特林夫人没有考虑到她所冒的风险。

take savings to the post office.phrase: take savings to the post office

examples.en: She took her savings to the post office to send them to her son.
examples.zh: 她把积蓄带到邮局寄给儿子。

must have been.usage: 一定曾经是（对过去的肯定推测）

examples.en: The wallet must have been found by someone.
examples.zh: 钱包一定是被某人发现了。

must have been.usage: 表示对过去发生的事情的肯定推测

examples.en: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance.
examples.zh: 主考官一定对我的表现很满意。

examples.en: The package was wrapped up in newspaper.
examples.zh: 包裹用报纸包着。

examples.en: In time, all the money was paid back.
examples.zh: 最终，所有的钱都还回来了。

examples.en: Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
examples.zh: 塔齐耶夫设法及时逃脱了。

in time.usage: 表示“及时”，指在约定或所需的时间之前完成动作，区别于on time（准时）

examples.en: The doctor arrived in time to save the injured man.
examples.zh: 医生及时赶到，救下了受伤的男子。

in time.usage: 表示“最终，经过一段时间之后”，强调经过一段时间后某情况发生

examples.en: In time, everyone forgot about the argument and became friends again.
examples.zh: 最终，所有人都忘记了那次争吵，又成了朋友。

in time.usage: 此处表示“最终；迟早；经过一段时间之后”，另一个常见含义是“及时”

examples.en: With practice, no doubt, I could in time learn to write by holding the pen still while the paper moved.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，经过练习，我最终能够学会笔不动而纸动来写字。

examples.en: You will get used to the new environment in time.
examples.zh: 你迟早会适应新环境的。

examples.en: He paid back the money he had borrowed.
examples.zh: 他还清了借的钱。

examples.en: Three months passed by before the wallet was found.
examples.zh: 三个月过去了，钱包才被找到。

examples.en: The wallet contained the money together with a note.
examples.zh: 钱包里有钱和一张纸条。

only per cent a thief.usage: 只是百分之五十的小偷

examples.en: I'm only 50 per cent a thief now!
examples.zh: 我现在只是百分之五十的小偷！

examples.en: The whole village soon learnt that money had been lost.
examples.zh: 整个村庄很快得知钱丢了。

a number of.usage: 许多；若干，后接可数名词复数

examples.en: A number of wooden boxes contained clothing.
examples.zh: 许多木箱装着衣服。

a number of.usage: 许多,若干,后接可数名词复数

examples.en: The tree has already claimed a number of victims.
examples.zh: 这棵树已经夺走了许多受害者的生命。

examples.en: A number of students were absent.
examples.zh: 许多学生缺席了。

examples.en: In the centre of the hall, there were a number of tall structures.
examples.zh: 大厅中央有一些高高的结构物。

it occurred to sb to do sth.phrase: It occurred to sb to do sth

examples.en: It occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
examples.zh: 其中一个工人突然想起要打开箱子。

examples.en: He was astonished at what he found.
examples.zh: 他对发现的东西感到非常惊讶。

try to do sth.usage: 试图/企图做某事（但未必成功）

examples.en: He did not even try to run away.
examples.zh: 他甚至没有试图逃跑。

examples.en: The man was ordered to pay £3,500.
examples.zh: 那个男子被要求支付3500英镑。

examples.en: He was ordered to pay for the cost of the trip.
examples.zh: 他被要求支付旅途费用。

examples.en: A man was lying on top of a pile of woollen goods.
examples.zh: 一名男子躺在羊毛制品堆的上面。

examples.en: He hid in the box before the plane left London.
examples.zh: 他在飞机离开伦敦之前藏进了箱子里。

up for sale.usage: 表示某物正在出售或待售

examples.en: The house is up for sale.
examples.zh: 这房子正在出售。

up for sale.usage: /ʌp fə seɪl/ phrase. 待售；正在出售（表示某物正在寻找买家）

examples.en: He turned the lights off before he went to bed.
examples.zh: 他睡觉前把灯关了。

shake ones head.usage: 摇头，表示否定或不同意

examples.en: Mr. Thompson shook his head.
examples.zh: 汤普森先生摇了摇头。

examples.en: They will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
examples.zh: 即使他白送，他们也不会接受这个酒吧。

even if.usage: 引导让步状语从句，意为“即使，纵然”，用来引出假设的让步条件

examples.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, we will still hold the sports meeting.
examples.zh: 即使明天下雨，我们还是会举办运动会。

examples.en: He is willing to give the pub away.
examples.zh: 他愿意把酒吧送出去。

must have past participle.usage: 表示对过去发生的事情的肯定推测

examples.en: The ghost must have drunk the whisky.
examples.zh: 那个鬼一定喝了威士忌。

public house.usage: /ˈpʌblɪk haʊs/ noun. 酒吧；酒馆（pub的全称，英国的饮酒场所）

examples.en: The dentist pulled out one of my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙医拔掉了我的一颗牙。

examples.en: He pulled out a pen from his pocket.
examples.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一支笔。

pull out.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

pull out.usage: /pʊl aʊt/ verb phrase. 拔出；拔掉（指用力将某物从某处拔出，如拔牙、拔刺等）
pull out.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

examples.en: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
examples.zh: 作为对这些问题的回答，我要么点头，要么发出奇怪的声音。

examples.en: She smiled in answer to his question.
examples.zh: 她微笑着回答他的问题。

in answer to.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

examples.en: My tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
examples.zh: 我的舌头正忙着找出拔掉牙齿的那个洞。

examples.en: He searched out the information he needed.
examples.zh: 他找到了他需要的信息。

search out.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

examples.en: I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
examples.zh: 我终于能告诉他他拔错了牙。

examples.en: She was able to speak three languages.
examples.zh: 她能说三种语言。

be able to.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

examples.en: He was able to solve the mystery.
examples.zh: 他能够解开这个谜团。

examples.en: He was able to return two days later.
examples.zh: 两天后他能够返回。

examples.en: I either nodded or made strange noises.
examples.zh: 我要么点头，要么发出奇怪的声音。

examples.en: The machine made strange noises.
examples.zh: 这台机器发出奇怪的声音。

make strange noises.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

examples.en: My tongue was busy searching out the hole.
examples.zh: 我的舌头正忙着找出那个洞。

examples.en: She is busy writing her report.
examples.zh: 她正忙着写报告。

busy doing something.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

have something done.usage: 让别人做某事（使役结构）

examples.en: The dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙医刚刚拔掉了我的一颗牙。

examples.en: I had my hair cut yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天理发了。

have something done.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

have something done.usage: 让某事被做（由他人完成）

examples.en: They have had special cages made to protect them.
examples.zh: 他们让人制作了特殊的笼子来保护他们。

examples.en: I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
examples.zh: 我突然感到非常担心，但说不出话来。

examples.en: I couldn't understand what he meant.
examples.zh: 我不明白他的意思。

could not couldnt.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

cotton wool.usage: /ˈkɒtn wʊl/ noun. 棉球；药棉（指用于止血或擦拭的棉花，在牙科中用于塞在拔牙处止血）
cotton wool.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

match box.usage: /mætʃ bɒks/ noun. 火柴盒（装火柴的小盒子，也是收藏家喜欢收藏的物品）
match box.unitTitle: Did You Want to Tell Me Something

examples.en: Tired of sleeping on the floor, he decided to buy a bed.
examples.zh: 由于厌倦了睡在地板上，他决定买一张床。

examples.en: He saved up for years to buy a real bed.
examples.zh: 他积蓄了多年才买到一张真正的床。

examples.en: For the first time in his life, he became the proud owner of a bed.
examples.zh: 他生平第一次成为一张床的骄傲主人。

examples.en: On the third night, a storm blew up.
examples.zh: 第三天晚上，刮起了风暴。

examples.en: A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof.
examples.zh: 一阵风把床从屋顶上刮走了。

examples.en: The bed crashed into the courtyard below.
examples.zh: 床砰的一声落到了下面的院子里。

examples.en: Although the bed was smashed to pieces, the man was unhurt.
examples.zh: 虽然床摔成了碎片，但人却安然无恙。

examples.en: He promptly went to sleep again.
examples.zh: 他立刻又睡着了。

save up.usage: /seɪv ʌp/ verb phrase. 积蓄；存钱（指为买某物而长期积攒钱财）

as far as.usage: 到...为止，表示距离或程度的终点

examples.en: This is as far as we go.
examples.zh: 这是我们能到达的最远的地方。

examples.en: As far as I know, he is a good teacher.
examples.zh: 据我所知，他是个好老师。

as far as.usage: /æz fɑːr æz/ phrase. 到...程度，就...而言（用于表示范围或程度）

in that case.usage: 既然那样/如果是这样的话，用于基于前面情况做出判断

examples.en: Well, in that case, I prefer to stay on the bus.
examples.zh: 既然那样，我宁愿继续待在车上。

examples.en: It might rain. In that case, we'll stay indoors.
examples.zh: 可能会下雨。如果是这样的话，我们就待在室内。

prefer to.usage: 宁愿/更喜欢，表示选择偏好

examples.en: I prefer to stay on the bus.
examples.zh: 我宁愿留在车上。

examples.en: She prefers to walk rather than take a bus.
examples.zh: 她宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。

examples.en: I'd prefer to stay here.
examples.zh: 我更想留在这里。

examples.en: I prefer to read books at home.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢在家里读书。

forget to do sth.usage: 忘记去做某事，指本应该做但没有做

examples.en: I forgot to put you off.
examples.zh: 我忘了让你下车。

examples.en: Don't forget to lock the door.
examples.zh: 别忘了锁门。

going back.usage: 回去，返回，指返回原来的地方

examples.en: We're going back now.
examples.zh: 我们现在要回去了。

examples.en: When are you going back home?
examples.zh: 你什么时候回家？

a good view of.usage: 良好的视野/景色，欣赏风景

examples.en: I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
examples.zh: 我坐在公交车的前部，以便好好欣赏乡村景色。

go on a diet.usage: 表示开始节食，控制饮食

examples.en: She decided to go on a diet after gaining weight.
examples.zh: 她在体重增加后决定节食。

examples.en: I paid him a visit yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天去拜访了他。

examples.en: He is as fat as ever.
examples.zh: 他和以前一样胖。

examples.en: First of all, I want to introduce myself.
examples.zh: 首先，我想介绍一下自己。

examples.en: He wrote out a long list of forbidden foods.
examples.zh: 他列出了一长串禁止吃的食物。

examples.en: He led me into his room.
examples.zh: 他把我带进了他的房间。

examples.en: It was obvious that he was embarrassed.
examples.zh: 很明显他很尴尬。

examples.en: He showed me the contents of the parcel.
examples.zh: 他给我看了包裹里的东西。

examples.en: I rang the bell and waited at the door.
examples.zh: 我按了门铃，在门口等着。

in order.usage: 表示整齐有序，井井有条

examples.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
examples.zh: 我一直在努力整理我的新房间。

examples.en: Let's put these papers in order.
examples.zh: 让我们把这些文件整理整齐。

to make matters worse.usage: 更糟糕的是，用来引出使情况更糟的因素

examples.en: To make matters worse, the room is rather small.
examples.zh: 更糟糕的是，房间相当小。

examples.en: It was raining, and to make matters worse, my car broke down.
examples.zh: 天在下雨，更糟糕的是，我的车坏了。

examples.en: I have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
examples.zh: 我不得不踩着它们进出房间。

examples.en: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!
examples.zh: 你可以在空闲时间坐在这里'读'地毯！

examples.en: Cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away often cause fires.
examples.zh: 人们随意扔掉的烟头经常引发火灾。

examples.en: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground.
examples.zh: 一只鸟从地上把蛇抓了起来。

examples.en: The bird dropped it on to the wires.
examples.zh: 那只鸟把蛇扔到了电线上。

examples.en: The snake wound itself round the wires.
examples.zh: 蛇把自己缠绕在电线上。

examples.en: It sent sparks down to the ground.
examples.zh: 它把火花送到地面上。

power line.usage: /ˈpaʊə laɪn/ noun phrase. 电力线；输电线路（固定搭配，指传输电力的线路）

make meat pies.usage: 制作肉馅饼，指做一种含肉的烘焙食品

examples.en: I decided to make some meat pies for dinner.
examples.zh: 我决定做些肉馅饼作为晚餐。

pick up the receiver.usage: 拿起电话听筒，指接电话的动作

examples.en: She picked up the receiver and said hello.
examples.zh: 她拿起听筒说了声你好。

examples.en: Please ring back later when I'm free.
examples.zh: 请稍后再打过来。

examples.en: At last I hung up the receiver.
examples.zh: 最后我挂断了电话。

in a short time.usage: 很快；不久，表示时间短暂

examples.en: In a short time I was busy mixing butter and flour.
examples.zh: 很快我就忙着搅拌黄油和面粉了。

examples.en: The doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.
examples.zh: 门铃响得震耳欲聋。

examples.en: He wanted me to sign for a registered letter.
examples.zh: 他要我签收一封挂号信。

at exactly that moment.usage: 就在那时，强调恰好在某个时间点

examples.en: At exactly that moment, the telephone rang.
examples.zh: 就在那时，电话响了。

come true.usage: 表示梦想、希望等成为现实

examples.en: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
examples.zh: 最近找到丢失宝藏的梦想几乎变成了现实。

examples.en: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.
examples.zh: 非常兴奋的搜寻队挖了一个两英尺深的洞。

be confident that.usage: 表示确信、相信某事会发生

examples.en: Many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value.
examples.zh: 许多人相信'探测仪'可能会发现有价值的东西。

examples.en: The men are confident that they will get out soon.
examples.zh: 这些人确信他们很快就能出去。

be used to do sth.usage: 表示被用来做某事，被用于

examples.en: The machine was used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
examples.zh: 这台机器被用来探测埋在地下黄金。

examples.en: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything.
examples.zh: 搜寻队随后彻底搜索了整个洞穴，但没有发现任何东西。

examples.en: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
examples.zh: 他们最终发现了一枚几乎毫无价值的小金币。

examples.en: A search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
examples.zh: 一支搜寻队进入洞穴，希望能找到埋藏的宝藏。

examples.en: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore.
examples.zh: 这台机器被用于海边附近的一个洞穴。

examples.en: They dug a hole two feet deep.
examples.zh: 他们挖了一个两英尺深的洞。

search party.usage: /sɜːtʃ ˈpɑːrti/ noun phrase. 搜索队，搜寻队（指为了寻找某人或某物而组织起来的一群人）

a great deal of.usage: 大量的（后接不可数名词）

examples.en: There was a great deal of excitement just before the race began.
examples.zh: 比赛开始前有大量的兴奋情绪。

a great deal of.usage: 大量；许多（修饰不可数名词）

examples.en: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
examples.zh: 还有大量机器展出。

a great deal of.usage: 表示“大量的，许多的”，后接不可数名词

examples.en: This exhibition received a great deal of attention in the press.
examples.zh: 这次展览受到了媒体的大量关注。

examples.en: The project requires a great deal of time and effort to complete.
examples.zh: 这个项目需要投入大量的时间和精力才能完成。

examples.en: Many of the cars broke down on the course.
examples.zh: 许多汽车在赛道上抛锚了。

break down.usage: /breɪk daʊn/ phrase. 抛锚；出故障（指机器或车辆出现故障）
/breɪk daʊn/ verb phrase. （机器）出故障；（汽车）抛锚（指机械设备不能正常运转）

examples.en: The driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it.
examples.zh: 司机费了很大劲才把它停下来。

examples.en: It sped downhill at the end of the race.
examples.zh: 它在比赛结束时加速下坡。

examples.en: The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure.
examples.zh: 比赛给每个人都带来了很大的乐趣。

examples.en: It was very different from modern car races.
examples.zh: 它与现代汽车比赛非常不同。

examples.en: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
examples.zh: 每年举行一次老式汽车比赛。

examples.en: Some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them!
examples.zh: 一些司机花在车底下的时间比在车里的时间还多！

no less exciting.usage: 同样精彩（双重否定表示肯定）

examples.en: It was very different but no less exciting.
examples.zh: 它非常不同，但同样精彩。

in jeans.usage: 穿着牛仔裤，in+衣物表示穿着状态

examples.en: The woman in jeans stood at the window.
examples.zh: 穿着牛仔裤的女人站在橱窗前。

examples.en: She hesitated for a moment before going in.
examples.zh: 她在进去之前犹豫了一会儿。

examples.en: She decided to punish the assistant next day.
examples.zh: 她决定第二天惩罚那个店员。

examples.en: She returned dressed in a fur coat.
examples.zh: 她穿着皮草大衣回来了。

examples.en: After seeking out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress.
examples.zh: 找到那个粗鲁的店员后，她要买同样的裙子。

be eager to do.usage: 渴望做某事，热切地想做

examples.en: The assistant was eager to serve her this time.
examples.zh: 这次店员热切地为她服务。

examples.en: With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window.
examples.zh: 费了很大力气，他爬进了商店橱窗。

examples.en: She returned to the shop the following morning.
examples.zh: 第二天早上她回到了商店。

examples.en: The village is said to possess a cursed tree.
examples.zh: 据说这个村庄拥有一棵被诅咒的树。

examples.en: He is said to be a great painter.
examples.zh: 据说他是一位伟大的画家。

examples.en: He is said to be very rich.
examples.zh: 据说他非常富有。

in recent years.usage: 近年来,用于谈论过去几年发生的事

examples.en: It is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.
examples.zh: 只是在近年来它才获得了邪恶的名声。

examples.en: Many things have changed in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来许多事情都发生了变化。

examples.en: If anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck.
examples.zh: 如果有人碰了这棵树,他就会倒霉。

examples.en: I had bad luck yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天运气不好。

examples.en: The vicar has refused to have the tree cut down.
examples.zh: 牧师拒绝让人把这棵树砍倒。

examples.en: You should cut down on smoking.
examples.zh: 你应该减少吸烟。

cut down.usage: /kʌt daʊn/ phrasal verb. 砍倒,削减（cut down the tree 表示砍树,cut down on 表示减少）

examples.en: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income.
examples.zh: 他指出这棵树是一个有用的收入来源。

examples.en: Can you point out the mistakes in my essay?
examples.zh: 你能指出我文章中的错误吗？

point out.usage: /pɔɪnt aʊt/ phrasal verb. 指出,提示（用于指出问题、事实或错误）

examples.en: As Brian pointed out, it is the easiest thing.
examples.zh: 正如布莱恩指出的，这是最简单的事。

point out.usage: 指出；指明，用于提示或解释某事

examples.en: The station master pointed out the mistake on the timetable.
examples.zh: 站长指出时刻表上的错误。

examples.en: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
examples.zh: 到目前为止,还没有一个人被突然击倒！

examples.en: Everything has been fine so far.
examples.zh: 到目前为止,一切都很顺利。

examples.en: So far, everything has been smooth.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，一切都很顺利。

so far.usage: 表示“到目前为止，迄今为止”，常与现在完成时连用，说明截止到现在的状态

examples.en: So far, the archaeologists have been unable to discover her identity.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，考古学家们还不能确定她的身份。

examples.en: So far, we have received more than 100 applications for the position.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经收到了100多份这个岗位的申请。

examples.en: Tourists have been cutting their names on the tree-trunk.
examples.zh: 游客们一直在树干上刻他们的名字。

examples.en: He cut his initials on the tree.
examples.zh: 他在树上刻上了自己名字的首字母。

have been doing.usage: 现在完成进行时,表示动作从过去持续到现在

examples.en: Tourists have been coming from all parts of the country.
examples.zh: 游客们一直从全国各地赶来。

examples.en: I have been waiting for you for two hours.
examples.zh: 我已经等了你两个小时。

to spend weeks doing something.usage: 表示花费数周时间做某事。结构：spend + 时间 + doing。

examples.en: My husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.
examples.zh: 我丈夫花了数周训练他用爪子按门闩，让自己进来。

to develop a bad habit.usage: 指养成坏习惯。常用结构：develop + a + (bad) habit。

examples.en: Since then, he has developed another bad habit.
examples.zh: 从那以后，他又养成了另一个坏习惯。

to let someone inout.usage: 表示让某人进来或出去。

examples.en: He sits and barks until someone lets him out.
examples.zh: 他坐在那里叫，直到有人让他出去。

to be annoyed.usage: 表示感到烦恼或生气。常用结构：be + annoyed (at/with)。

examples.en: Rex got so annoyed we have not seen him since.
examples.zh: Rex非常生气，以至于我们一直没有再见到他。

examples.en: Yesterday my husband removed the gate and Rex got so annoyed we have not seen him since.
examples.zh: 昨天我丈夫把门拆了，Rex非常生气，以至于我们一直没再见到他。

so that.usage: 作目的连词，意为“为了……”。用于说明行为的目的。

examples.en: This time he was barking so that someone would let him out!
examples.zh: 这次他叫是为了让有人让他出去。

to press his paw on the latch.phrase: to press his paw on the latch
to press his paw on the latch.usage: 指把爪子按在门闩上，用于开门或触发装置。

examples.en: my husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.
examples.zh: 我丈夫花了数周训练他用爪子按门闩，让自己进来。

examples.en: She looked into a crystal ball.
examples.zh: 她向水晶球里面看。

examples.en: I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky.
examples.zh: 我把贝琳斯基夫人忘得一干二净。

examples.en: My wife hurried towards me.
examples.zh: 我妻子匆忙向我走来。

examples.en: Your sister will be here in less than an hour.
examples.zh: 你姐姐不到一个小时就到了。

examples.en: She will lead you away from this place.
examples.zh: 她会把你从这个地方带走。

examples.en: She intends to stay for a few days.
examples.zh: 她打算待几天。

examples.en: As she walked away, I followed her.
examples.zh: 她走开时，我跟在她后面。

examples.en: We must be at the station to meet her.
examples.zh: 我们必须在车站接她。

crystal ball.usage: /ˈkrɪstl bɔːl/ noun. 水晶球（算命者用来预测未来的工具）

right from the start.usage: 从一开始，表示从一开始就出现问题或情况

examples.en: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
examples.zh: 从一开始，哈勃望远镜就有问题。

examples.en: NASA is now going to put the telescope right.
examples.zh: 美国国家航空航天局现在准备把望远镜修好。

examples.en: It will soon be sending up four astronauts to repair it.
examples.zh: 它很快将把四名宇航员送上太空去修理它。

examples.en: The astronauts make the necessary repairs.
examples.zh: 宇航员们进行必要的维修工作。

examples.en: The Hubble is above the earth's atmosphere.
examples.zh: 哈勃望远镜在地球大气层之上。

tell us a great deal about.phrase: tell us a great deal about

examples.en: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.
examples.zh: 哈勃望远镜将告诉我们很多关于宇宙的年龄和大小。

examples.en: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands of pictures.
examples.zh: 到你读到这个的时候，哈勃的鹰眼将已经给我们发送了成千上万的照片。

eagle eye.usage: /ˈiːɡl aɪ/ noun phrase. 敏锐的目光；鹰眼（比喻观察力非常敏锐）

examples.en: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks.
examples.zh: 消防队员们与森林大火搏斗了将近三个星期。

get under control.usage: 表示得到控制、被控制住

examples.en: Before they could get it under control, the fire had spread widely.
examples.zh: 在他们能够控制住火势之前，大火已经蔓延开了。

examples.en: Great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
examples.zh: 大树覆盖了周围数英里的乡村。

examples.en: In many places the grass had already taken root.
examples.zh: 在许多地方，草已经生了根。

examples.en: In place of the great trees, patches of green had begun to appear.
examples.zh: 在原来大树的地方，开始出现了片片绿色。

examples.en: Heavy rain would wash away the soil.
examples.zh: 大雨会冲走土壤。

examples.en: The forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed.
examples.zh: 森林管理局订购了好几吨一种特殊类型的草籽。

examples.en: The special grass-seed would grow quickly.
examples.zh: 这种特殊的草籽会快速生长。

come on.usage: 表示来临、到来（用于季节）

examples.en: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages.
examples.zh: 冬天即将来临，山丘威胁着周围的村庄。

a large circle of friends.usage: 指拥有很多的社交圈子，朋友很多

examples.en: He has a large circle of friends.
examples.zh: 他有很多朋友。

make a speech.usage: 发表演讲，在公共场合进行正式发言

examples.en: He was asked to make a speech at the wedding.
examples.zh: 他被邀请在婚礼上发表演讲。

to his surprise.usage: 令他惊讶的是，表示出乎意料

examples.en: To his surprise, she refused the invitation.
examples.zh: 令他惊讶的是，她拒绝了邀请。

the sort of thing.usage: 这类事情，某种类型的事物

examples.en: This is the sort of thing that he loves.
examples.zh: 这正是他喜欢的事情。

examples.en: He did as his daughter asked.
examples.zh: 他按照女儿的要求做了。

a large number of.usage: 大量的，许多的，后接可数名词复数

examples.en: He told a large number of funny stories.
examples.zh: 他讲了很多有趣的故事。

examples.en: He was a little disappointed by this.
examples.zh: 他对这件事感到有点失望。

examples.en: A better plan was put forward by an Englishman.
examples.zh: 一个更好的计划由一位英国人提出。

examples.en: This platform would serve as a port and a railway station.
examples.zh: 这个平台将作为港口和火车站使用。

serve as.usage: 表示“充当，用作，起……作用”，主语可以是人或物，后接表示身份、功能的名词

examples.en: Not all sounds made by animals serve as language.
examples.zh: 动物发出的声音并不都起语言的作用。

examples.en: The old sofa can serve as a bed for one night.
examples.zh: 这个旧沙发可以当床睡一晚。

serve as.usage: 动词短语，意为“充当；担任；起……作用”，说明事物的功能或角色

examples.en: The old sofa in the study can serve as a temporary bed for guests.
examples.zh: 书房里的旧沙发可以充当临时床供客人使用。

examples.en: This would solve the problem of ventilation.
examples.zh: 这将解决通风问题。

examples.en: It would draw in fresh air behind it.
examples.zh: 它会在身后吸入新鲜空气。

examples.en: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion...
examples.zh: 如果当时英国人不害怕入侵的话...

at the time.usage: 表示在某事发生的时候

examples.en: At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling.
examples.zh: 谋杀发生时，我正在旅行。

examples.en: Where were you at the time?
examples.zh: 当时你在哪里？

examples.en: I was in my office at the time.
examples.zh: 那时我在我的办公室。

examples.en: The children dressed up as pirates for Halloween.
examples.zh: 孩子们在万圣节装扮成海盗。

dress up as.usage: 表示“装扮成，打扮成”，用于化装、角色扮演等场景

examples.en: She intended to dress up as a ghost for the party.
examples.zh: 她打算在派对上装扮成鬼魂。

examples.en: Children love dressing up as cartoon characters on Halloween.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在万圣节装扮成卡通人物。

dress up as.usage: 表示装扮成、打扮成特定的样子

examples.en: The little girl dressed up as a princess for the Halloween party.
examples.zh: 小女孩在万圣节派对上装扮成了公主。

examples.en: They set off for the mountains early in the morning.
examples.zh: 他们一大早就出发去山区了。

set off.usage: 表示出发、动身，也可表示引爆、引发某事

examples.en: We set off at dawn so that we could get to the mountain top before noon.
examples.zh: 我们黎明就出发，这样就能在中午之前到达山顶。

examples.en: The news set off a heated discussion among the students.
examples.zh: 这个消息在学生中引发了激烈的讨论。

examples.en: The accident held up traffic for two hours.
examples.zh: 事故使交通堵塞了两个小时。

hold up.usage: 被动语态中表示“被耽搁、被延误”，主语通常是交通工具、行程等

examples.en: We were held up for two hours on the highway because of the car accident.
examples.zh: 因为车祸，我们在高速公路上被耽搁了两个小时。

examples.en: The project was held up by a lack of funding.
examples.zh: 这个项目因为资金短缺被延误了。

ought to have done.usage: 过去应该做但实际未做（虚拟语气）

examples.en: You ought to have told me the truth.
examples.zh: 你早该告诉我真相的。

let someone off.usage: 放过某人，不追究某人的责任

examples.en: The police let him off with a warning.
examples.zh: 警察只是警告了一下就放过了他。

examples.en: He has a good record at school.
examples.zh: 他在学校表现良好。

examples.en: This elephant weighs a few tons.
examples.zh: 这头大象有几吨重。

examples.en: Go along this road and turn left at the second corner.
examples.zh: 沿着这条路走，在第二个拐角左转。

ought to.usage: /ɔːt tuː/ modal verb. 应该，应当（表示责任或义务，也可表示建议）

a colony of bees.usage: 表示一群蜜蜂，用于描述蜂群

examples.en: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive.
examples.zh: 一群蜜蜂把这个发动机变成了蜂巢。

sweet as honey.usage: 形容某物像蜂蜜一样甜，文中用于形容发动机保存完好

examples.en: The fourth engine was sweet as honey--still in perfect condition.
examples.zh: 第四台发动机甜如蜂蜜——状况仍然完美。

examples.en: A Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare.
examples.zh: 状况良好的兰开斯特轰炸机很罕见。

examples.en: They broke open the packing cases.
examples.zh: 他们撬开了包装箱。

examples.en: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
examples.zh: 法国当局把飞机包装好，拆成部件运回法国。

examples.en: The bees had turned the engine into a hive.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂把发动机变成了蜂巢。

examples.en: She turned a suitcase into a bed for the children.
examples.zh: 她把手提箱变成了孩子们的床。

over the years.usage: 表示这些年来的时间流逝

examples.en: But over the years the crash was forgotten.
examples.zh: 但这些年来，坠机事故被遗忘了。

over the years.usage: 多年来，随着时间的推移

examples.en: Over the years, one may well become an authority on one's hobby.
examples.zh: 多年下来，人很可能会成为自己爱好的权威。

examples.en: It was rare and worth rescuing.
examples.zh: 它很罕见，值得拯救。

by this time.usage: 表示到那时、到这个时候

examples.en: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare.
examples.zh: 到这时，状况良好的兰开斯特轰炸机已经很少见了。

examples.en: The plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在一次航空测量中被意外重新发现。

aerial survey.usage: /ˈeəriəl ˈsɜːveɪ/ noun phrase. 航空测量；空中勘察（指从飞机上进行的地形或区域勘察）

examples.en: He has often risked his life in this way.
examples.zh: 他经常以这种方式冒着生命危险。

examples.en: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano.
examples.zh: 塔齐耶夫得以在离火山很近的地方搭建营地。

set up.usage: /set ʌp/ phrasal verb. 建立，创建（指创立或设立某事物）

examples.en: It set up a huge wave in the canal.
examples.zh: 它在运河里掀起了一股巨浪。

examples.en: He waited until the volcano became quiet.
examples.zh: 他等到火山安静下来。

examples.en: A river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
examples.zh: 一股熔岩正向他涌来。

examples.en: A stranger came towards me on the street.
examples.zh: 街上一个陌生人向我走来。

examples.en: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
examples.zh: 他告诉我们的关于活火山的情况比任何在世的人都多。

examples.en: He managed to take a number of brilliant photographs.
examples.zh: 他设法拍摄了一些精彩的照片。

examples.en: I crossed the street to avoid meeting him.
examples.zh: 我穿过街道以避免遇见他。

examples.en: You should avoid making the same mistake.
examples.zh: 你应该避免犯同样的错误。

examples.en: He saw me and came running towards me.
examples.zh: 他看见了我然后朝我跑过来。

examples.en: No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
examples.zh: 无论你有多忙，他总是坚持要陪着你。

examples.en: No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't open the door.
examples.zh: 无论我多努力，我都打不开门。

think of a way of doing something.phrase: think of a way of doing something

examples.en: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me.
examples.zh: 我得想个办法阻止他跟着我。

examples.en: I tried to prevent him from following me around.
examples.zh: 我试图阻止他一直跟着我。

fancy meeting you here.usage: 想不到在这儿遇见你！（表示惊讶）

examples.en: Fancy meeting you here! I thought you were in London.
examples.zh: 想不到在这儿遇见你！我以为你在伦敦呢。

would you mind my coming with you.phrase: Would you mind my coming with you?
would you mind my coming with you.usage: 你介意我和你一起去吗？（表示委婉请求）

examples.en: Would you mind my coming with you to the shops?
examples.zh: 你介意我和你一起去商店吗？

theres plenty to read.usage: 有很多可读的（有很多阅读材料）

examples.en: There's always plenty to read in the waiting room.
examples.zh: 候诊室里总有很多东西可读。

examples.en: There's plenty to see in this city.
examples.zh: 这座城市有很多可看的东西。

examples.en: He never has anything to do.
examples.zh: 他从来都没什么事可做。

examples.en: He asked, before I had finished speaking.
examples.zh: 他在我说完之前就问道。

be asked to do something.usage: 被要求做某事，表示被动地接受指示或要求

examples.en: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 我被要求在拥挤的交通中驾驶。

drive out of town.usage: 开车出城，表示从市区驶出

examples.en: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
examples.zh: 在接到开车出城的指示后，我开始有了信心。

be sure that.usage: 确信，确信某事会发生或已经发生

examples.en: Sure that I had passed, I was almost beginning to enjoy my test.
examples.zh: 确信自己已经通过了，我几乎开始享受这次考试。

take some time.usage: 花费一些时间，表示某事需要一定的时间才能完成

examples.en: It took me a long time to react.
examples.zh: 我花了很长时间才反应过来。

look at someone sadly.usage: 悲伤地看着某人，表示带着悲伤的表情注视

examples.en: The examiner looked at me sadly.
examples.zh: 主考官悲伤地看着我。

in a mournful voice.usage: 用悲伤的声音，表示以哀伤的语调说话

examples.en: He said in a mournful voice.
examples.zh: 他用悲伤的声音说道。

press the brake pedal.usage: 踩刹车踏板，指驾驶员刹车时的动作

examples.en: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal hard.
examples.zh: 我突然用力踩下刹车踏板。

be thrown forward.usage: 被向前抛出，描述因惯性身体前倾的状态

examples.en: We were both thrown forward.
examples.zh: 我们两个都向前倾倒。

wander into.usage: 漫步进入；不知不觉走进

examples.en: The drunk suddenly wandered into the middle of the ring.
examples.zh: 那个醉汉突然漫步走进了场地中央。

examples.en: The drunk was unaware of the danger.
examples.zh: 醉汉没有意识到危险。

examples.en: The bull suddenly caught sight of the drunk.
examples.zh: 公牛突然看见了那个醉汉。

catch sight of.usage: 意为“看见，瞥见”，强调偶然看到的动作

examples.en: I caught sight of an old friend in the crowd when I was shopping yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天购物的时候在人群里瞥见了一位老朋友。

examples.en: The little girl caught sight of a cat running through the garden.
examples.zh: 小女孩看见一只猫从花园里跑过。

examples.en: The drunk was waving a red cap.
examples.zh: 醉汉正在挥动一顶红色的帽子。

examples.en: The crowd suddenly grew quiet.
examples.zh: 观众突然变得安静了。

examples.en: The crowd broke into cheers.
examples.zh: 观众突然爆发出欢呼声。

examples.en: He clumsily stepped aside to let it pass.
examples.zh: 他笨拙地闪到一边让牛过去。

examples.en: They quickly dragged the drunk to safety.
examples.zh: 他们迅速把醉汉拖到安全的地方。

examples.en: The bull looked on sympathetically.
examples.zh: 公牛同情地看着。

examples.en: The teenagers looked on while three men dived into the water.
examples.zh: 当三个人反复潜水时，青少年们在一旁观看。

examples.en: The bull turned its attention to the matador.
examples.zh: 公牛把注意力转向了斗牛士。

examples.en: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall.
examples.zh: 大本钟以本杰明·霍尔爵士的名字命名。

examples.en: He was responsible for the making of the clock.
examples.zh: 他负责制造这个钟。

examples.en: Microphones are connected to the clock tower.
examples.zh: 麦克风与钟楼相连。

examples.en: He hung a pot of paint on one of the hands.
examples.zh: 他把一罐油漆挂在指针上。

examples.en: The painter slowed it down.
examples.zh: 油漆匠让钟走慢了。

examples.en: The car slowed down as it approached the crossroads.
examples.zh: 汽车接近十字路口时放慢了速度。

examples.en: The Houses of Parliament had been burned down in 1834.
examples.zh: 议会大厦在1834年被烧毁了。

examples.en: Officials have the clock checked twice a day.
examples.zh: 官员们每天两次检查这个钟。

examples.en: The clock can be heard all over the world.
examples.zh: 这个钟的声音全世界都能听到。

examples.en: It failed to give the correct time.
examples.zh: 它没能报出正确的时间。

set up a new world record.phrase: set up a new world record

examples.en: She set up a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
examples.zh: 她在百米赛跑中创造了新的世界纪录。

have great difficulty in doing something.phrase: have great difficulty in doing something
have great difficulty in doing something.usage: 在做某事方面有很大困难

examples.en: He had great difficulty in controlling the car.
examples.zh: 他在控制汽车方面有很大困难。

examples.en: I was disappointed to learn that the concert was cancelled.
examples.zh: 我失望地得知音乐会取消了。

examples.en: The train can reach speeds of over 300 kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 这列火车可以达到每小时300公里以上的速度。

following in someones footsteps.usage: 追随某人的脚步；继承衣钵

examples.en: She followed in her mother's footsteps and became a doctor.
examples.zh: 她追随母亲的脚步，成为了一名医生。

examples.en: The racing car drove at over 200 miles per hour.
examples.zh: 这辆赛车以超过每小时200英里的速度行驶。

examples.en: A few days later, we received the good news.
examples.zh: 几天后，我们收到了好消息。

examples.en: This car was specially built for the racing competition.
examples.zh: 这辆车是为赛车比赛专门建造的。

play truant.usage: 指学生逃学、旷课的行为

examples.en: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
examples.zh: 逃学的孩子都缺乏想象力。

examples.en: He was caught when playing truant.
examples.zh: 他逃学时被抓到了。

put to shame.usage: 使...相形见绌，使...自愧不如

examples.en: They have all been put to shame by this boy.
examples.zh: 他们都被这个男孩比得黯然失色。

examples.en: He fell asleep and the boat travelled to Calais in the meantime.
examples.zh: 他睡着了，船在这期间航行到了加来。

examples.en: The boat had travelled to Calais in the meantime.
examples.zh: 与此同时，船已经航行到了加来。

examples.en: There he was picked up by a policeman.
examples.zh: 在那里他被警察带走了。

as far as they get.usage: 他们最多也就...，他们的极限是...

examples.en: Eight hours in a cinema is usually as far as they get.
examples.zh: 在电影院待八个小时通常是他们能做到的极限。

examples.en: Seeing the same film over and over again.
examples.zh: 一遍又一遍地看同一部电影。

over and over again.usage: /ˈoʊvər ænd ˈoʊvər əˈɡen/ phrase. 一次又一次，反复地（表示重复的动作）

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
examples.zh: 带把伞以防下雨。

examples.en: It says 'No Camping' in case you can't read!
examples.zh: 上面写着'禁止露营'——以防你不会读！

examples.en: Now you get out of here, all of you!
examples.zh: 现在你们都给我滚出去！

examples.en: Get out of here! I don't want to see you.
examples.zh: 滚出去！我不想见到你。

be hard on someone.usage: 对某人苛刻；对某人严厉

examples.en: Don't be too hard on us, sheriff.
examples.zh: sheriff，别对我们太苛刻了。

examples.en: The teacher is too hard on the new students.
examples.zh: 老师对新学生太苛刻了。

examples.en: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.
examples.zh: 当他们都安顿好之后，一个陌生人出现了。

examples.en: Please make yourselves comfortable.
examples.zh: 请随便坐，不要拘束。

examples.en: They had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.
examples.zh: 他们采取了特别的预防措施以免被人认出来。

examples.en: We should take precautions against fire.
examples.zh: 我们应该采取防火措施。

examples.en: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes, they tried to hide.
examples.zh: 他们戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服，试图隐藏自己。

examples.en: The children were dressed in red.
examples.zh: 孩子们穿着红色的衣服。

examples.en: It couldn't be better, Gloria.
examples.zh: 再好不过了，Gloria。

examples.en: The weather couldn't be better for a picnic.
examples.zh: 这个天气野餐再合适不过了。

examples.en: The plane flew off course due to the bad weather.
examples.zh: 由于恶劣天气，飞机偏离了航线。

examples.en: It happened in the middle of winter when it was very cold.
examples.zh: 事情发生在非常寒冷的隆冬时节。

keep as near as possible to.phrase: keep as near as possible to

examples.en: The woman kept as near as possible to her children.
examples.zh: 那位妇女尽可能靠近她的孩子们。

examples.en: Early next morning, she heard planes passing overhead.
examples.zh: 第二天一大早，她听到飞机从头顶飞过。

examples.en: Planes passed overhead but no one saw her.
examples.zh: 飞机从头顶飞过，但没有人看到她。

examples.en: The pilot sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
examples.zh: 飞行员通过无线电向最近的城镇发送了消息。

examples.en: It was not long before a helicopter arrived.
examples.zh: 不久之后，一架直升机赶到了。

examples.en: Then she had an idea to stamp out letters in the snow.
examples.zh: 然后她想出了一个主意：在雪地上踩出字母。

examples.en: The helicopter came to rescue the survivors of the crash.
examples.zh: 直升机赶来营救坠机事故中的幸存者。

going over to.usage: 转向；切换到，指新闻报道中切换到另一个地点或话题

examples.en: We're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria.
examples.zh: 我们现在转向意大利卡拉布里亚的通心粉田地。

examples.en: Let's go over to our correspondent in Beijing.
examples.zh: 让我们切换到在北京的记者。

day and night.usage: 日夜不停地；夜以继日，形容持续不断的工作或活动

examples.en: The whole village has been working day and night.
examples.zh: 整个村子一直在日夜不停地工作。

examples.en: She studied day and night before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前她夜以继日地学习。

day and night.usage: 意为“日日夜夜，昼夜不停”，在句中作时间状语，描述动作持续的状态

examples.en: The nurses took care of the patient day and night until he recovered.
examples.zh: 护士们日夜照顾这位病人，直到他康复。

examples.en: The construction site works day and night to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 工地昼夜施工，以按时完成项目。

between them.usage: 他们两个一起；总共，用于指两个人共同完成某事

examples.en: Two workers who, between them, have just finished cutting three cartloads.
examples.zh: 两个工人，他们一起刚割完三车的通心粉茎。

examples.en: Between them, they have visited over 50 countries.
examples.zh: 他们两个总共访问了50多个国家。

every year since.usage: 自...以来每一年，表示从过去某时起每年都发生的动作

examples.en: He has won it every year since 1991.
examples.zh: 自1991年以来他每年都赢得比赛。

examples.en: She has called me every year since we graduated.
examples.zh: 自我们毕业以来她每年都给我打电话。

cutting cartloads of.usage: 收割满车的...，表示收获大量的农作物

examples.en: They have just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
examples.zh: 他们刚收割完三车金黄色的通心粉茎。

help sb for.usage: 帮助某人...时间，表示持续帮助的时长

examples.en: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.
examples.zh: 她帮丈夫干活到现在已经三十年了。

examples.en: He has been helping his father in the shop for five years.
examples.zh: 他在店里帮父亲干活已经五年了。

the end of the harvest.usage: 收获结束时；收割的尾声

examples.en: This shows you what will happen at the end of the harvest.
examples.zh: 这向你展示收获结束时会发生什么。

earlier than usual.usage: 比往常早，表示比正常时间提前

examples.en: Harvesting has begun earlier than usual.
examples.zh: 收割比往常开始得更早。

examples.en: The doctors wanted to know how the woman died of a rare disease.
examples.zh: 医生们想知道这名女子是如何死于一种罕见疾病的。

examples.en: He died of cancer last year.
examples.zh: 他去年死于癌症。

examples.en: The operation lasted for over four hours.
examples.zh: 手术持续了四个多小时。

examples.en: The meeting lasted for two hours.
examples.zh: 会议持续了两个小时。

examples.en: They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open.
examples.zh: 他们担心当切开木乃伊时，它会碎成碎片。

examples.en: The old book fell to pieces when I touched it.
examples.zh: 那本旧书我一碰就碎成了碎片。

fall to pieces.usage: /fɔːl tə ˈpiːsɪz/ verb phrase. 碎成碎片，崩溃（指某物分裂成许多小部分）

examples.en: The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
examples.zh: 医生们还没有确定这名女子是如何死的。

examples.en: I have not yet finished my homework.
examples.zh: 我还没有完成作业。

examples.en: This god was normally placed inside a mummy.
examples.zh: 这个神通常被放在木乃伊内部。

examples.en: The key was placed inside the drawer.
examples.zh: 钥匙被放在抽屉里面。

survive the operation.usage: 手术成功，经历手术存活下来

examples.en: The mummy successfully survived the operation.
examples.zh: 木乃伊成功挺过了这次手术。

examples.en: The patient survived the surgery.
examples.zh: 病人手术成功活了下来。

cut open.usage: /kʌt ˈəʊpən/ verb phrase. 切开，剖开（指用刀或其他工具将某物切开）

examples.en: He decided to give up smoking last year.
examples.zh: 他去年决定戒烟。

calm my nerves.usage: 镇定我的神经，使我放松

examples.en: She took a deep breath to calm her nerves.
examples.zh: 她深呼吸让自己放松下来。

keep on doing something.usage: 继续做某事，坚持做某事

examples.en: They kept on offering me cigarettes.
examples.zh: 他们一直给我递烟。

more than i could bear.usage: 超出我的承受能力，我无法忍受

examples.en: The pain was more than I could bear.
examples.zh: 疼痛超出了我的承受能力。

make no effort to do something.phrase: make no effort to do something
make no effort to do something.usage: 没有努力做某事，毫不费力做某事

examples.en: They made no effort to hide their amusement.
examples.zh: 他们毫不掩饰自己的笑意。

examples.en: He lit a cigarette to calm his nerves.
examples.zh: 他点了一根烟来镇定神经。

return to normal.usage: 恢复正常，回到正常状态

examples.en: Things had returned to normal once more.
examples.zh: 一切又恢复了正常。

examples.en: I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket.
examples.zh: 我从口袋里掏出一包糖果。

the easiest thing in the world.phrase: the easiest thing in the world

examples.en: It is the easiest thing in the world to give up smoking.
examples.zh: 戒烟是世界上最容易的事。

examples.en: A flight attendant would take charge of me.
examples.zh: 一位乘务员会照顾我。

examples.en: I am used to travelling by air.
examples.zh: 我习惯乘飞机旅行。

examples.en: Only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
examples.zh: 我只曾在一次感到害怕。

examples.en: The plane was slowly gaining height.
examples.zh: 飞机正在缓慢爬升。

examples.en: The plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport.
examples.zh: 飞机突然掉头飞回机场。

examples.en: A flight attendant told us to keep calm.
examples.zh: 乘务员告诉我们保持冷静。

examples.en: Everybody on board was worried.
examples.zh: 飞机上的每个人都很担心。

examples.en: There was tremendous excitement on board.
examples.zh: 船上有极大的兴奋。

examples.en: We were curious to find out what had happened.
examples.zh: 我们好奇想知道发生了什么事。

examples.en: The Crystal Palace was made of iron and glass.
examples.zh: 水晶宫由铁和玻璃建成。

examples.en: There were six million visitors in all.
examples.zh: 总共有六百万参观者。

examples.en: It was burnt down in 1936.
examples.zh: 它在1936年被烧毁。

examples.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings.
examples.zh: 水晶宫不同于所有其他建筑。

examples.en: He dragged the box into the room.
examples.zh: 他把箱子拖进房间。

examples.en: She changed into her sports clothes.
examples.zh: 她换上了运动服。

examples.en: The soldier marched up and down in front of the gate.
examples.zh: 士兵在门前来回走动。

examples.en: The soldiers stood to attention when the officer passed.
examples.zh: 当军官经过时，士兵们立正敬礼。

examples.en: He knocked the man to the ground with one punch.
examples.zh: 他一拳把那人打倒在地。

examples.en: The thief drove off at high speed.
examples.zh: 小偷高速驾车逃离。

examples.en: They couldn't see anything in the darkness.
examples.zh: 他们在黑暗中什么都看不见。

with a rifle over his shoulder.phrase: with a rifle over his shoulder

examples.en: He stood there with a bag over his shoulder.
examples.zh: 他肩上背着包站在那里。

at times.usage: 表示偶尔、有时，相当于 sometimes，用于描述不经常发生的情况

examples.en: At times I feel tired after work.
examples.zh: 有时我下班后会感到累。

no ordinary fish.usage: no + adj. 表示强调，意为'绝非普通的'，用来突出事物的特殊性

examples.en: This is no ordinary question.
examples.zh: 这绝不是一个普通的问题。

make every effort.usage: 表示尽一切努力、不遗余力，后接 to do sth.

examples.en: He made every effort to arrive on time.
examples.zh: 他尽一切努力准时到达。

be washed to the shore.usage: 表示被（海浪）冲到岸边，wash 还有'冲刷、洗涤'的意思

examples.en: The debris was washed to the beach by the waves.
examples.zh: 碎片被海浪冲到了海滩上。

pull on the line.usage: 表示拉鱼线，pull on 表示用力拉扯某物，line 在此指钓鱼线

examples.en: The fish pulled hard on the line.
examples.zh: 那条鱼用力拉鱼线。

in any way.usage: 表示以任何方式，常用于否定句中加强语气，意为'丝毫不'

examples.en: I don't want to trouble you in any way.
examples.zh: 我丝毫不想麻烦你。

be set to a museum.usage: 表示被送往博物馆，set 在此为过去分词，表示'被放置、被送往'

examples.en: The painting was set to the National Gallery.
examples.zh: 这幅画被送到了国家美术馆。

live at a depth of.usage: 表示生活在...深度，depth 前可加具体数字

examples.en: These fish live at a depth of 300 meters.
examples.zh: 这些鱼生活在300米深处。

laugh at.usage: 表示嘲笑、讥笑，也可表示'对...一笑了之'

examples.en: Don't laugh at his mistakes.
examples.zh: 不要嘲笑他的错误。

carry sb out to sea.usage: 表示把某人带到海上，carry 有'携带、带走'之意，此处指被鱼拖走

examples.en: The storm carried the boat out to sea.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把船带到了海上。

keep on doing sth.usage: 继续做某事，反复做某事

examples.en: He kept on asking the same question.
examples.zh: 他不断问同样的问题。

keep on doing sth.usage: 表示“持续做某事，反复做某事”，强调动作的持续性和重复性

examples.en: If you keep on practicing English every day, you will make great progress soon.
examples.zh: 如果你坚持每天练习英语，很快就会取得很大进步。

examples.en: The little boy kept on asking his parents strange questions about the universe.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩不停问他父母关于宇宙的奇怪问题。

examples.en: The policeman lost his temper.
examples.zh: 警察发脾气了。

examples.en: He lost his temper when he found his laptop had been damaged.
examples.zh: 当他发现自己的笔记本电脑被弄坏时，他发了脾气。

examples.en: The day after, Patrick went to the house again.
examples.zh: 第二天，Patrick又去了那所房子。

examples.en: On the following day Patrick went to the house again.
examples.zh: 第二天Patrick又去了那所房子。

examples.en: He has gone to live abroad.
examples.zh: 他已经去国外居住了。

examples.en: Mr. Lane was defeated in the recent elections.
examples.zh: Lane先生在最近的选举中败北了。

examples.en: He is retiring from political life.
examples.zh: 他即将退出政坛。

examples.en: The workers have decided to go on strike next week.
examples.zh: 工人们决定下周举行罢工。

examples.en: The meeting is due to begin at 9 o'clock.
examples.zh: 会议预定九点开始。

examples.en: To some extent, I agree with you.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上，我同意你的看法。

examples.en: The exam will be held in two days' time.
examples.zh: 考试将在两天后举行。

examples.en: It was cold; even so, we went swimming.
examples.zh: 天气很冷，尽管如此我们还是去游泳了。

examples.en: The government has stated that the policy will not change.
examples.zh: 政府已经声明政策不会改变。

examples.en: I want to express my gratitude to all my teachers.
examples.zh: 我想对所有老师表达我的感激之情。

examples.en: Many people object that young drivers drive too fast.
examples.zh: 许多人反对年轻人开车太快。

examples.en: The company offered free rides to all passengers during the strike.
examples.zh: 罢工期间公司向所有乘客提供免费乘车服务。

examples.en: I informed him that the meeting had been postponed.
examples.zh: 我通知他会议已经推迟了。

examples.en: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names.
examples.zh: 所有为这份礼物捐款的人都将签名。

examples.en: We sent him a present to mark the occasion.
examples.zh: 我们送他一份礼物以纪念这个时刻。

examples.en: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience.
examples.zh: 我们将永远因他的耐心而记住佩奇先生。

examples.en: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour.
examples.zh: 许多老校友将出席为他举行的告别晚宴。

examples.en: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.
examples.zh: 退休后他将致力于园艺。

one is never too old to learn.phrase: one is never too old to learn

examples.en: One is never too old to learn.
examples.zh: 活到老学到老。

examples.en: Pupils will be sending him a present.
examples.zh: 学生们将送他一份礼物。

it is a curious coincidence that.phrase: It is a curious coincidence that

examples.en: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for forty years.
examples.zh: 说来也巧，就在他退休前一天，佩奇先生将教满四十年书。

examples.en: The driver swung the car round to avoid the obstacle.
examples.zh: 司机急转弯避开障碍物。

examples.en: The button came away from my coat when I caught it on the door.
examples.zh: 我衣服上的扣子被门刮掉了。

examples.en: The drowning man waved desperately to the people on the shore.
examples.zh: 溺水的人拼命向岸上的人挥手。

examples.en: The ship struck a buoy in the fog.
examples.zh: 船在雾中撞上了浮标。

examples.en: The airplane moved in a circle before landing.
examples.zh: 飞机在着陆前绕了一圈。

examples.en: A big wave came straight towards us.
examples.zh: 一个大浪直朝我们冲过来。

examples.en: The train roared past the station without stopping.
examples.zh: 火车轰鸣着驶过车站，没有停。

examples.en: They managed to swim out of danger before the boat returned.
examples.zh: 他们在船返回之前设法游出了危险区。

examples.en: We've used up all the milk.
examples.zh: 我们把牛奶都用完了。

steering wheel.usage: /ˈstɪərɪŋ wiːl/ noun. 方向盘，舵轮（控制车辆或船只方向的装置）

water ski.usage: /ˈwɔːtə skiː/ verb. 滑水（指穿着滑雪板在水上滑行）

be travelling on.usage: 表示正在乘坐（某种交通工具）

examples.en: I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train.
examples.zh: 我正在乘坐8点的火车。

examples.en: I must catch the early train to work.
examples.zh: 我必须赶上早班火车去上班。

examples.en: I must be at work at 10 o'clock.
examples.zh: 我必须在10点上班。

notice anything unusual.usage: 表示注意到任何不寻常的事

examples.en: Did you notice anything unusual at the station?
examples.zh: 你在车站注意到什么不寻常的事了吗？

examples.en: You are not telling the truth.
examples.zh: 你没有说实话。

take off the line.usage: 表示停止运营；取消（线路）

examples.en: The train was taken off the line.
examples.zh: 火车停止运营了。

examples.en: I suggest that you are not telling the truth.
examples.zh: 我暗示你没有说实话。

examples.en: Would a later train get you to work on time?
examples.zh: 晚一点的火车能让你准时到公司吗？

on time.usage: /ɒn taɪm/ phrase. 准时；按时（指按时到达，不迟到）

examples.en: If they are not brought to the surface soon, they may lose their lives.
examples.zh: 如果不尽快把他们救到地面，他们可能会失去生命。

examples.en: The numerous items were brought to the surface.
examples.zh: 许多物品被打捞上来。

run out of.usage: 用完，耗尽（主动含义，主语消耗完某物）

examples.en: Though they are running out of food and drink, the men are cheerful.
examples.zh: 虽然他们的食物和饮料快用完了，但这些人仍然很乐观。

examples.en: The microphone has enabled the men to keep in touch with their closest relatives.
examples.zh: 麦克风使这些人能够与他们的至亲保持联系。

examples.en: If they knew how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock, they would lose heart.
examples.zh: 如果他们知道在硬岩石上钻孔有多难，他们会失去信心的。

lose heart.usage: /luːz hɑːt/ verb phrase. 失去信心，灰心（lose heart 是固定搭配，heart 不加 s） verb phrase. 泄气（与 lose heart 相反的是 take heart 或 pluck up courage）

prove difficult.usage: 证明是困难的，结果很困难

examples.en: However, rescue operations are proving difficult.
examples.zh: 然而，救援行动证明是困难的。

examples.en: They would have completed the job in a few hours.
examples.zh: 他们本可以在几小时内完成这项工作的。

as it is.usage: 事实上，实际上（表示与预期相反的情况）

examples.en: As it is, they have been drilling for 16 hours and they still have a long way to go.
examples.zh: 事实上，他们已经钻了16个小时了，但仍有很长的路要走。

have a long way to go.phrase: have a long way to go
have a long way to go.usage: 还有很长的路要走，还有很多工作要做

examples.en: They still have a long way to go.
examples.zh: 他们仍然有很长的路要走。

examples.en: They have been told that rescue operations are progressing smoothly.
examples.zh: 他们被告知救援行动正在顺利进行。

examples.en: When the news got round, everyone came to see.
examples.zh: 消息传开后，大家都来看了。

examples.en: We had to queue for hours to get in.
examples.zh: 我们不得不排了好几个小时的队才能进去。

examples.en: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
examples.zh: 他一开口，大家就突然大笑起来。

examples.en: He stood awkwardly before the microphone.
examples.zh: 他尴尬地站在麦克风前。

examples.en: He spoke at the beginning of the programme.
examples.zh: 他在节目开始时讲话。

examples.en: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed.
examples.zh: 那些没能进去的人不必感到失望。

examples.en: Many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
examples.zh: 许多本应该出现的艺人没有来。

examples.en: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed.
examples.zh: 那些没能进去的人本不必感到失望。

examples.en: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
examples.zh: 他一开口，大家就大笑起来。

good ladies evening and gentlemen.usage: 女士们，晚上好（的错误说法）

examples.en: What he actually said was: 'Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!'
examples.zh: 他实际说的是：'女士们好，晚上和先生们！'

fish and chips.usage: 炸鱼薯条，英国经典快餐

examples.en: Fish and chips has always been a favourite dish in Britain.
examples.zh: 炸鱼薯条一直是英国人最喜爱的菜肴。

out of ones wits.usage: 吓得魂不附体；不知所措

examples.en: Divers have been frightened out of their wits by giant fish.
examples.zh: 潜水员们被巨大的鱼吓得魂不附体。

examples.en: Giant fish are bumping into divers as they work.
examples.zh: 巨鱼在潜水员工作时撞到他们。

examples.en: So it comes as a surprise to learn that giant fish are terrifying the divers.
examples.zh: 因此，听说巨鱼令潜水员们恐惧是令人惊讶的。

examples.en: As a result, the fish just eat and eat and grow and grow.
examples.zh: 结果，这些鱼只是不停地吃，不停地长大。

examples.en: They grow to unnatural sizes, sometimes as much as twelve feet in length.
examples.zh: 它们长到不正常的尺寸，有时可达十二英尺长。

examples.en: Divers often have to work in darkness a hundred feet under water.
examples.zh: 潜水员经常需要在水下百尺的黑暗中工作。

examples.en: The warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea causes fish to grow.
examples.zh: 海底热油管周围的温暖海水导致鱼长大。

oil rig.usage: /ɔɪl rɪɡ/ noun. 石油钻井平台（用于海上开采石油的结构）

make for.usage: 驶向/走向某地，表示朝某个方向前进

examples.en: The balloon seemed to be making for the RAF station.
examples.zh: 气球似乎正朝皇家空军基地飘去。

keep track of.usage: 追踪/掌握...的动态，保持对某事的了解

examples.en: The pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
examples.zh: 飞行员被命令追踪那个奇怪的物体。

make out.usage: 辨认出/看清楚/理解，常用于表示看清或辨认某物

examples.en: He could make out three men in a basket.
examples.zh: 他辨认出篮子里有三个人。

make out.usage: 此处表示“辨认出；看出”，还可表示“理解；填写”

examples.en: It was so dark that I could hardly make out the road sign ahead.
examples.zh: 天太黑了，我几乎看不清前面的路标。

call in.usage: 召来/召集/叫来，指请求某人或某物前来帮助

examples.en: The police were called in.
examples.zh: 警察被召来了。

call in.usage: 请来，叫（专业人士）来帮忙

examples.en: We had to call in a plumber to fix the blocked pipe.
examples.zh: 我们不得不请水管工来修堵塞的管道。

soon afterwards.usage: 不久之后，表示紧接着发生的动作

examples.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend.
examples.zh: 不久之后，气球开始下降。

a great danger to.usage: 对...很大的危险，danger后接介词to引出危险对象

examples.en: Balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
examples.zh: 气球可能对飞机造成很大危险。

circle around.usage: 盘旋/环绕飞行，指绕着某物做圆周运动

examples.en: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
examples.zh: 飞行员设法绕着气球盘旋了一会儿。

take photographs.usage: 拍照/摄影，指用相机拍摄照片的动作

examples.en: One of the men was taking photographs.
examples.zh: 其中一个人正在拍照。

be angry with.usage: 对...生气，angry后接介词with再加对象

examples.en: The officer was very angry when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 军官听到这个消息后非常生气。

control tower.usage: /kənˈtrəʊl ˈtaʊə(r)/ noun. 指挥塔（机场或军事基地中用于指挥飞机起降的建筑）

commanding officer.usage: /kəˈmɑːndɪŋ ˈɒfɪsə(r)/ noun. 指挥官/司令官（军队中的最高指挥官，常缩写为C.O.）

member of parliament.usage: /ˈmembə(r) əv ˈpɑːləmənt/ noun. 国会议员（英国议会的下议院议员，简称MP）

examples.en: I got a ladder and put it against the wall.
examples.zh: 我拿了梯子把它靠在墙上。

examples.en: He put the ladder against the tree.
examples.zh: 他把梯子靠在树上。

examples.en: I looked down and nearly fell off the ladder.
examples.zh: 我向下看，差点从梯子上摔下来。

examples.en: She looked down at her feet.
examples.zh: 她低头看着自己的脚。

examples.en: I nearly fell off the ladder when I saw a policeman.
examples.zh: 我看到警察时差点从梯子上摔下来。

examples.en: The book fell off the table.
examples.zh: 书从桌子上掉了下来。

would you mind.usage: 用于礼貌请求，后跟动名词

examples.en: Would you mind coming with me to the station?
examples.zh: 你介意跟我去一趟警察局吗？

examples.en: Would you mind opening the window?
examples.zh: 你介意打开窗户吗？

examples.en: The policeman had started to climb towards me.
examples.zh: 警察已经开始向我爬过来。

examples.en: She started to cry when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息她开始哭了起来。

examples.en: She was fast asleep.
examples.zh: 她睡得很熟。

examples.en: The children are fast asleep.
examples.zh: 孩子们都睡得很熟。

examples.en: The policeman answered in the same tone.
examples.zh: 警察用同样的语气回答。

examples.en: He said in the same tone.
examples.zh: 他用同样的语气说道。

examples.en: My wife opened the window.
examples.zh: 我的妻子打开了窗户。

examples.en: It's hot here. Can you open the window?
examples.zh: 这里很热。你能打开窗户吗？

police station.usage: /pəˈliːs ˈsteɪʃn/ noun phrase. 警察局（警察办公的地方）

takeyears to complete.usage: 表示完成某事花费了多长时间

examples.en: The project took ten years to complete.
examples.zh: 这个项目花了十年才完成。

be made of.usage: 表示由某种材料制成（能看出原材料）

examples.en: The statue was made of copper.
examples.zh: 这座雕像是用铜制成的。

examples.en: It was taken to pieces and sent to America.
examples.zh: 它被拆成零件运往美国。

examples.en: The statue had been put together again.
examples.zh: 雕像已经被重新组装起来。

put together.usage: 表示“加起来；总共”，常用于对比某一群体和其他群体总和的差距

examples.en: All of them put together kill only a fraction of the number destroyed by spiders.
examples.zh: 把它们所有加起来，杀死的昆虫数量也只是蜘蛛消灭数量的一小部分。

examples.en: The profit of this month is more than the profit of the past three months put together.
examples.zh: 这个月的利润比过去三个月的总和还多。

examples.en: Ever since then, it has been a symbol of liberty.
examples.zh: 从那以后，它就一直是自由的象征。

examples.en: The statue is a symbol of liberty.
examples.zh: 这座雕像是自由的象征。

examples.en: People who have made their homes in America.
examples.zh: 在美国安家的人们。

examples.en: People who have passed through New York Harbour.
examples.zh: 经过纽约港的人们。

pass through.usage: 表示“经历，经过；穿过”，可指经历某个阶段、过程，也可指从某个空间穿过

examples.en: Arthur C.Clark once suggested a revolutionary idea passes through three phases.
examples.zh: 阿瑟·C·克拉克曾提出，一个革命性的想法要经历三个阶段。

examples.en: You need to pass through three security checks before boarding the plane.
examples.zh: 登机前你需要经过三次安检。

examples.en: An island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
examples.zh: 纽约港入口处的一个岛屿。

examples.en: The children are expert at holding their breath under water.
examples.zh: 孩子们很擅长在水下屏住呼吸。

examples.en: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming.
examples.zh: 没过多久他们就习惯了游泳。

examples.en: The children compete against each other to reach the other end.
examples.zh: 孩子们互相竞争看谁先到达池子的另一端。

examples.en: Some children can cover the whole length without coming up for breath.
examples.zh: 有些孩子能游完全程而不用浮出水面呼吸。

examples.en: Children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
examples.zh: 孩子们在很小的年龄就可以学习游泳。

examples.en: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool.
examples.zh: 有些孩子能游完整个泳池的长度。

examples.en: Children become expert at holding their breath.
examples.zh: 孩子们变得擅长屏住呼吸。

examples.en: Whether they will become Olympic champions, only time will tell.
examples.zh: 他们是否能成为奥运冠军，只有时间才能证明。

examples.en: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
examples.zh: 两个月大的婴儿似乎并不抗拒进入水中。

examples.en: She got a shock when she saw the damage.
examples.zh: 看到损坏程度，她吃了一惊。

examples.en: The wife got a shock when her husband returned home.
examples.zh: 丈夫回家时，妻子吃了一惊。

in a frightful state.usage: 状况糟糕；处于可怕的状态

examples.en: His clothes were in a frightful state.
examples.zh: 他的衣服状况很糟糕。

examples.en: The room was in a frightful state after the party.
examples.zh: 聚会后房间一团糟。

examples.en: Students set the Embassy on fire this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上学生们放火烧了大使馆。

examples.en: Someone set the car on fire last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有人放火烧了那辆车。

examples.en: The fire broke out in the basement.
examples.zh: 火灾在地下室突然发生。

examples.en: World War II broke out in 1939.
examples.zh: 第二次世界大战在1939年爆发。

break out.usage: /breɪk aʊt/ phrasal verb. 突然发生；爆发（指火灾、战争、疾病等突然发生）

examples.en: I went down immediately to the basement.
examples.zh: 我立刻下楼去了地下室。

examples.en: She went down to the first floor.
examples.zh: 她下到一楼去了。

go down.usage: 此处意为“（船）沉没”，还可表示下降、下跌、被记下等含义

examples.en: The small boat went down in the storm last night.
examples.zh: 那艘小船在昨晚的暴风雨中沉没了。

examples.en: Good heavens! What has happened?
examples.zh: 天哪！发生什么事了？

examples.en: Good heavens! Look at the time!
examples.zh: 天哪！看看几点了！

examples.en: She noticed a big hole in her husband's hat.
examples.zh: 她注意到丈夫帽子上有一个大洞。

examples.en: I noticed a hole in my sock.
examples.zh: 我注意到袜子上有一个洞。

examples.en: Someone fired a shot through my office window.
examples.zh: 有人朝我的办公室窗户开了一枪。

examples.en: The police fired a shot into the air.
examples.zh: 警察朝天鸣枪。

if i had been i would not have been able.phrase: If I had been... I would not have been able to...
if i had been i would not have been able.usage: 与过去事实相反的虚拟语气

examples.en: If I had been wearing it, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.
examples.zh: 如果我当时戴着它，就不能回家吃午饭了。

examples.en: If I had known, I would not have come.
examples.zh: 如果我早知道，我就不会来了。

fire extinguisher.usage: /faɪə(r) ɪkˈstɪŋɡwɪʃə(r)/ noun phrase. 灭火器（用于扑灭火灾的设备）

examples.en: They are expected to arrive tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他们预计明天到达。

examples.en: Food was laid out on the table.
examples.zh: 食物摆在桌子上。

lay out.usage: /leɪ aʊt/ verb phrase. 摆出；铺开（指将物品整齐地摆放出来）

examples.en: They spent three months laying out their new garden.
examples.zh: 他们花了三个月布置新花园。

examples.en: The lanterns help the dead to find their way.
examples.zh: 灯笼帮助死者找到路。

examples.en: People dance and sing all night long.
examples.zh: 人们整晚唱歌跳舞。

examples.en: In the early morning, the food is thrown into the river.
examples.zh: 一大早，食物被扔进河里。

examples.en: It is considered unlucky to eat the food.
examples.zh: 吃那些食物被认为是不吉利的。

examples.en: Thousands of lanterns drift out to sea.
examples.zh: 成千上万的灯笼漂向大海。

examples.en: The lanterns slowly drift out to sea.
examples.zh: 灯笼缓缓漂向大海。

until they can be seen no more.phrase: until they can be seen no more

examples.en: They watch until they can be seen no more.
examples.zh: 他们看着直到看不见为止。

the dead.usage: /ðə ded/ noun. 死者；死去的人（the + 形容词，表示一类人）

at large.usage: 表示（危险的人或动物）在逃、逍遥法外；也可表示“总的来说”

examples.en: The escaped prisoner is still at large.
examples.zh: 逃犯仍然在逃。

examples.en: People at large are against the new policy.
examples.zh: 总的来说人们反对这项新政策。

take sth seriously.usage: 认真对待某事，重视某事，否定形式为not take sth seriously

examples.en: You should take your parents' advice seriously.
examples.zh: 你应该认真对待父母的建议。

examples.en: His threat was not taken seriously at first.
examples.zh: 一开始没人把他的威胁当回事。

feel obliged to do sth.usage: 觉得有义务做某事，被迫做某事，强调主观上的责任感

examples.en: I felt obliged to help him when he was in trouble.
examples.zh: 他遇到困难时我觉得有义务帮他。

examples.en: The company felt obliged to apologize for the mistake.
examples.zh: 公司觉得有必要为这个错误道歉。

leave behind.usage: 留下；遗留，宾语可放在leave和behind之间，也可放在behind之后

examples.en: The thief left behind a wallet at the scene of the crime.
examples.zh: 小偷在犯罪现场留下了一个钱包。

examples.en: Don't leave your belongings behind when you get off the bus.
examples.zh: 下车时别落下你的随身物品。

complain of.usage: 抱怨；诉说（病痛、不适等），后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Many residents complain of the noise from the construction site.
examples.zh: 很多居民抱怨工地的噪音。

examples.en: The patient complained of having a headache for three days.
examples.zh: 病人诉说自己已经头疼三天了。

in the possession of.usage: 为某人所有，主语是被拥有的事物，注意和in possession of（主语是拥有者）区分

examples.en: The rare painting is now in the possession of a private collector.
examples.zh: 这幅罕见的画作现在为一位私人收藏家所有。

examples.en: The company is in possession of three advanced production lines.
examples.zh: 这家公司拥有三条先进的生产线。

go on.usage: 持续；继续，此处表示事件持续发生，后可接一段时间

examples.en: The meeting went on for more than three hours.
examples.zh: 会议持续了三个多小时。

examples.en: The rain has been going on since this morning.
examples.zh: 雨从今天早上就一直下个不停。

raise money.usage: 意为“筹钱，募集资金”，宾语后可接for引出筹款的目的对象

examples.en: We are raising money for the children in poor areas.
examples.zh: 我们正在为贫困地区的儿童筹款。

examples.en: The organization raised over 1 million yuan for disaster relief last year.
examples.zh: 该组织去年为救灾募集了超过100万元资金。

used to do.usage: 表示过去常常做某事（现在已经不做了），暗指过去和现在的对比

examples.en: I used to swim every week when I was a student.
examples.zh: 我上学的时候常常每周都去游泳。

examples.en: This park used to be a wasteland ten years ago.
examples.zh: 这个公园十年前曾是一片荒地。

wake up with a start.usage: 意为“猛然惊醒，突然惊醒”，强调惊醒的突发性

examples.en: I woke up with a start when the thunder struck last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚打雷的时候我猛然惊醒了。

examples.en: She woke up with a start, realizing she was late for the meeting.
examples.zh: 她猛地惊醒，意识到自己开会要迟到了。

armed with.usage: 意为“装备有，携带”，属于过去分词短语作状语，说明主语的状态

examples.en: Armed with a map and a compass, the hikers set off into the mountain.
examples.zh: 背着地图和指南针，徒步旅行者们出发进山了。

examples.en: Armed with all the evidence, he was confident he would win the case.
examples.zh: 掌握了所有证据，他有信心赢得这场官司。

night after night.usage: 意为“一夜又一夜，连续很多夜晚”，强调动作的重复性和持续性

examples.en: He came to the studio night after night to practice his speech for the contest.
examples.zh: 他连续很多个晚上来到演播室练习比赛的演讲。

examples.en: Night after night, the mother sat by the sick child's bed.
examples.zh: 一夜又一夜，这位母亲守在生病的孩子床边。

examples.en: She practiced the piano night after night.
examples.zh: 她夜复一夜地练习钢琴。

get used to.usage: 意为“习惯于”，to是介词，后面接名词、代词或动名词

examples.en: It took me a month to get used to the life in the new city.
examples.zh: 我花了一个月才习惯新城市的生活。

examples.en: My grandparents have got used to living in the countryside.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母已经习惯了在农村生活。

examples.en: We have got quite used to them.
examples.zh: 我们已经相当习惯它们了。

at one time.usage: 用于描述过去某个时期曾经发生的情况，相当于“曾经，一度”，常与过去时态搭配

examples.en: The city at one time must have been prosperous, for it enjoyed a high level of civilization.
examples.zh: 这座古城肯定一度很繁荣，因为它曾享有高度的文明。

examples.en: At one time, I lived in the countryside, so I know a lot about farm work.
examples.zh: 我曾经在农村住过，所以我很了解农活。

be equipped with.usage: 表示“配备有，装备有”，主语通常为地点、机构、设备等，后接配备的具体物品

examples.en: The city was even equipped with a drainage system, for a great many clay pipes were found beneath the narrow streets.
examples.zh: 这座城市甚至还敷设了排水系统，因为在狭窄的街道底下发现了许许多多陶土制作的排水管道。

examples.en: The new gym is equipped with all the latest fitness equipment.
examples.zh: 这个新健身房配备了所有最新的健身器材。

date from.usage: 表示“追溯到，始于（某个时期）”，主语通常为古物、遗迹、传统等，无被动形式，常用一般现在时

examples.en: The body of one statue was found among remains dating from the 15th century B.C.
examples.zh: 其中一尊雕像的躯体是在公元前15世纪的历史文物中发现的。

examples.en: This tradition dates from the Tang Dynasty and is still kept in many villages.
examples.zh: 这个传统可以追溯到唐朝，现在很多村庄仍然保留着。

happen to do.usage: 表示“碰巧做某事，偶然发生”，强调事情的偶然性，无被动语态

examples.en: Its missing head happened to be among remains of the fifth century B.C.
examples.zh: 它那失踪的头像恰巧在公元前5世纪的遗迹里。

examples.en: I happened to meet my primary school teacher when I was shopping yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天逛街的时候碰巧遇到了我的小学老师。

turn out to be.usage: 表示“结果是，原来是，最终被发现是”，强调结果与预期可能不同，后可接名词、形容词

examples.en: They were amazed to find that the goddess turned out to be a very modern-looking woman.
examples.zh: 他们惊奇地发现，那位女神原来竟是一位相貌十分摩登的女郎。

examples.en: The job turned out to be much harder than I thought at first.
examples.zh: 这份工作结果比我一开始想的要难得多。

rest on.usage: 表示“搁在，靠在；依赖，基于”，此处取“放置在某个支撑物上”的含义

examples.en: She stood three feet high and her hands rested on her hips.
examples.zh: 她身高3英尺，双手叉腰。

examples.en: After walking for two hours, he rested his shoulders on the wall and took a deep breath.
examples.zh: 走了两个小时的路，他把肩膀靠在墙上，深吸了一口气。

be used as.usage: 表示“被用作，充当”，主语为被使用的事物，后接功能、用途类名词

examples.en: The temple which the archaeologists explored was used as a place of worship from the fifteenth century B.C. until Roman times.
examples.zh: 考古工作者考察的这座庙宇从公元前15世纪直到罗马时代一直是祭祀祈祷的场所。

examples.en: The small room was used as a temporary storage room during the renovation.
examples.zh: 装修期间，这个小房间被用作临时储藏室。

refer to sb as.usage: 将某人称作、把某人称为，用来表达对某人的称谓

examples.en: People who work in offices are frequently referred to as 'white-collar workers'.
examples.zh: 在办公室工作的人常常被称作“白领工人”。

examples.en: He is often referred to as the best basketball player of his generation.
examples.zh: 他常被称为他那一代人中最好的篮球运动员。

refer to sb as.unitTitle: The Double Life of Alfred Bloggs

give rise to.usage: 引起；导致；使发生，后接表示结果类的名词

examples.en: This can give rise to curious situations.
examples.zh: 这就可能引起一些奇怪的现象。

examples.en: Poor communication may give rise to misunderstandings between team members.
examples.zh: 沟通不畅可能会导致团队成员之间产生误会。

give rise to.unitTitle: The Double Life of Alfred Bloggs

give rise to.usage: 正式表达，意为“引起；导致；使发生”，后接表示问题、变化等的名词

examples.en: Poor communication may give rise to misunderstandings between team members.
examples.zh: 沟通不畅可能会引起团队成员之间的误解。

in the case of.usage: 就……而言；在……的情况下，用来引出具体的例子或情况

examples.en: As it did in the case of Alfred Bloggs who worked as a dustman.
examples.zh: 在阿尔弗雷德·布洛格斯的情况中就是如此，他是埃尔斯米尔公司的清洁工。

examples.en: The new policy is quite flexible, especially in the case of small businesses.
examples.zh: 这项新政策很灵活，对小企业来说尤其如此。

in the case of.unitTitle: The Double Life of Alfred Bloggs

in the case of.usage: 用于引出特定的讨论对象，意为“就…而言，在…的情况下”

examples.en: In the case of emergency, press the red button to cut off the power immediately.
examples.zh: 在紧急情况下，按下红色按钮立即切断电源。

too to.usage: 太……而不能……，用来表达否定含义，说明程度过高导致无法做某事

examples.en: Alf was too embarrassed to say anything to his wife about his job.
examples.zh: 阿尔弗太尴尬了，以至于没法和妻子说自己工作的事。

examples.en: The little boy was too short to reach the book on the top shelf.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩太矮了，够不到顶层架子上的书。

too to.unitTitle: The Double Life of Alfred Bloggs

be well worth.usage: 非常值得……，后面接名词或动名词，表付出的代价是值得的

examples.en: He feels that his rise in status is well worth the loss of money.
examples.zh: 他觉得地位提升了，损失这点钱是非常值得的。

examples.en: The view from the mountain top is well worth the two-hour climb.
examples.zh: 爬两个小时的山来看山顶的景色是非常值得的。

be well worth.unitTitle: The Double Life of Alfred Bloggs

go to extremes.usage: 表示“走极端；做过头”，描述人在做某事时过于偏激，超出合理范围

examples.en: Some parents go to extremes to send their children to the best schools.
examples.zh: 有些家长为了把孩子送到最好的学校做得太过极端。

set out to do sth.usage: 表示“着手做某事；开始努力做某事”，强调带着明确目标开始行动

examples.en: He set out to finish the report within three days.
examples.zh: 他着手准备在三天内完成这份报告。

set out to do sth.usage: 表示开始着手做某件有明确目标的事情，强调行动的目的性

examples.en: Dimitri at once set out to find the thief.
examples.zh: 迪米特里立刻出发去找小偷。

examples.en: She set out to break the world record in the marathon.
examples.zh: 她立志要打破马拉松的世界纪录。

set out to do sth.usage: 表示“打算、着手做某事”，强调有明确的目的去做某件事

examples.en: True eccentrics never deliberately set out to draw attention to themselves.
examples.zh: 真正的怪人从不刻意去吸引他人的注意。

examples.en: She set out to break the world record in the long jump.
examples.zh: 她立志要打破跳远的世界纪录。

go to press.usage: 固定搭配，表示“（报刊、杂志）付印；即将出版”

examples.en: The weekly magazine will go to press tomorrow, so we have to submit the article today.
examples.zh: 这本周刊明天就要付印了，所以我们今天必须提交文章。

not onlybutas well.usage: 表示“不仅……而且……”，用于连接两个并列的成分，强调后者

examples.en: Not only did she win the first prize, but she got a scholarship as well.
examples.zh: 她不仅获得了一等奖，还拿到了奖学金。

lead to.usage: 此处表示“通向；通往”，此外也可表示“导致；引起”某个结果

examples.en: This path leads to the small village at the foot of the mountain.
examples.zh: 这条小路通向山脚下的小村庄。

examples.en: Lack of exercise can lead to many health problems.
examples.zh: 缺乏锻炼会导致很多健康问题。

lead to.usage: 动词短语，表示'导致'，后接结果或后果

examples.en: The need to produce cheap food leads to a different kind of pollution.
examples.zh: 生产廉价食品的需求导致了另一种污染。

lead to.usage: 动词短语，意为“导致，造成”，主语是原因，宾语是结果，to是介词，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Lack of communication may lead to misunderstanding between friends.
examples.zh: 缺乏沟通可能会导致朋友之间产生误会。

examples.en: Hard work and careful planning finally led to the success of the project.
examples.zh: 努力的工作和周密的计划最终让这个项目取得了成功。

come to a stop.usage: 表示车辆、机器等逐渐停下，强调停止的过程，比stop更具画面感

examples.en: The bus came to a stop just in time to avoid hitting the child.
examples.zh: 公交车及时停了下来，避免撞到那个孩子。

examples.en: The engine sputtered and finally came to a stop.
examples.zh: 引擎噼啪响了几声，最终停了下来。

help oneself to.usage: 指擅自取用、偷窃，也可礼貌邀请别人随意取用食物、物品等

examples.en: The intruder helped himself to all the cash in the safe.
examples.zh: 闯入者偷走了保险箱里所有的现金。

examples.en: Please help yourself to some drinks if you are thirsty.
examples.zh: 如果你渴了请随便喝点饮料。

at a fantastic speed.usage: 形容速度极快，相当于at an extremely high speed

examples.en: The sports car drove past at a fantastic speed.
examples.zh: 跑车以极快的速度开了过去。

examples.en: The project is progressing at a fantastic speed.
examples.zh: 这个项目正以惊人的速度推进。

get away with.usage: 表示偷了某物后成功逃脱，也可表示做了坏事却没有受到惩罚

examples.en: The burglars got away with jewellery worth over £100,000.
examples.zh: 窃贼偷走了价值10万多英镑的珠宝，逃之夭夭。

examples.en: Don't think you can get away with lying to me.
examples.zh: 别以为你对我撒谎能蒙混过关。

examples.en: He was glad to get away with a mere twenty pounds.
examples.zh: 他很高兴只花了二十英镑就买到了。

with its headlights on.usage: with的独立主格结构，用来描述伴随状态，结构为with + 宾语 + 宾补（形容词/副词/介词短语等）

examples.en: He stood in the rain, with his clothes completely wet.
examples.zh: 他站在雨里，衣服全湿了。

examples.en: She left the office, with the lights still on.
examples.zh: 她离开了办公室，灯还亮着。

worth of.usage: 表示“价值……的东西”，结构为“金额/时间 + worth of + 名词”

examples.en: The storm caused thousands of pounds worth of damage.
examples.zh: 风暴造成了价值数千英镑的损失。

examples.en: I bought two weeks' worth of food before the holiday.
examples.zh: 放假前我买了够吃两周的食物。

worth of.usage: 表示“价值……的东西”，前面加金额，后面接名词，说明价值对应的物品

examples.en: I bought ten dollars' worth of snacks for the picnic.
examples.zh: 我买了价值十美元的零食用于野餐。

examples.en: He gave me two yuan worth of stamps.
examples.zh: 他给了我价值两元的邮票。

stay at the wheel.usage: 表示留在驾驶座上开车，wheel此处指代汽车的方向盘

examples.en: You stay at the wheel while I go into the shop to buy some water.
examples.zh: 我去商店买水的时候你留在车里开车。

examples.en: He stayed at the wheel for 6 hours before stopping to rest.
examples.zh: 他连续开了6小时车才停下来休息。

deal with.usage: 表示“处理，应付”，后接问题、事件、人等作宾语

examples.en: The team deals with all kinds of customer complaints every day.
examples.zh: 这个团队每天处理各种各样的客户投诉。

examples.en: He is good at dealing with difficult situations.
examples.zh: 他擅长应对困难局面。

turn to ash.usage: 表示“变成灰烬”，属于turn to sth的固定搭配，指转化为某种形态

examples.en: The old books turned to ash in the big fire.
examples.zh: 那些旧书在大火中化成了灰烬。

examples.en: All his hopes turned to ash when he heard the bad news.
examples.zh: 听到这个坏消息时，他所有的希望都破灭了。

so long as.usage: 连词短语，引导条件状语从句，意为“只要”，相当于as long as

examples.en: So long as you work hard, you will pass the exam.
examples.zh: 只要你努力学习，你就会通过考试。

examples.en: We can go out so long as it doesn't rain.
examples.zh: 只要不下雨，我们就可以出门。

for safekeeping.usage: 固定搭配，表示“为了妥善保管”，在句中作目的状语

examples.en: He gave his important documents to his lawyer for safekeeping.
examples.zh: 他把自己的重要文件交给律师妥善保管。

examples.en: I put the diamond necklace in the bank for safekeeping.
examples.zh: 我把钻石项链放在银行妥善保存。

it seems that.usage: 常用表达，表示“似乎，看起来”，用于描述不确定的情况或主观推测

examples.en: It seems that no one knows what happened last night.
examples.zh: 似乎没有人知道昨晚发生了什么。

examples.en: It seems he is not interested in the plan at all.
examples.zh: 看起来他对这个计划一点都不感兴趣。

now that.usage: 引导原因状语从句，意为“既然；由于”，表示已知的事实或新出现的情况

examples.en: Now that a tunnel has been built through the mountains, the Pass is less dangerous.
examples.zh: 由于已经修建了一条穿山隧道，山口现在不那么危险了。

examples.en: Now that you have finished your homework, you can watch TV for a while.
examples.zh: 既然你已经做完了作业，你可以看一会儿电视。

send out.usage: 动词短语，意为“派出；发出”，可接人或物作宾语

examples.en: The dogs are still sent out into the snow whenever a traveller is in difficulty.
examples.zh: 每当有旅行者遇到困难时，这些狗仍然会被派到雪地里去。

examples.en: The rescue team sent out three groups to search for the missing climber.
examples.zh: 救援队派出了三个小组搜寻失踪的登山者。

in difficulty.usage: 介词短语，意为“处于困境中”，在句中可作表语或后置定语

examples.en: We should give a hand to those who are in difficulty.
examples.zh: 我们应该帮助那些身处困境的人。

attempt to do sth.usage: 动词搭配，意为“试图做某事；尝试做某事”，常指做有难度或风险的事

examples.en: Very few people attempt to cross the Pass in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天很少有人试图穿越山口。

examples.en: He attempted to climb the mountain alone, but failed due to the storm.
examples.zh: 他试图独自攀登那座山，但因为暴风雨失败了。

prefer a to b.usage: 动词搭配，意为“比起B更喜欢A”，用于表达两者间的偏好

examples.en: The monks prefer winter to summer for they have more privacy.
examples.zh: 修道士们喜欢冬天胜过夏天，因为他们有更多的独处时间。

examples.en: I prefer coffee to tea when I need to stay up late working.
examples.zh: 我需要熬夜工作的时候，比起茶更喜欢喝咖啡。

receive a warm welcome.usage: 固定搭配，意为“受到热烈欢迎”

examples.en: These young people always receive a warm welcome at St.Bernard's monastery.
examples.zh: 这些年轻人在圣伯纳德修道院总是受到热烈欢迎。

examples.en: The foreign visitors received a warm welcome when they arrived at the university.
examples.zh: 外国访客抵达这所大学时受到了热烈欢迎。

never fail to.usage: 双重否定结构，加强肯定语气，意为“一定会；从未不”，语气比直接用肯定形式更强烈

examples.en: Cats never fail to fascinate human beings.
examples.zh: 猫总能引起人类的极大兴趣。

examples.en: She never fails to call her parents every weekend.
examples.zh: 她每个周末一定会给父母打电话。

be based on.usage: 表示“以……为基础；基于……”，主语通常为理论、故事、结论等抽象事物

examples.en: A cat's ability to survive falls is based on fact.
examples.zh: 猫在坠落中存活的能力是有事实依据的。

examples.en: The movie is based on a real historical event.
examples.zh: 这部电影是基于真实历史事件改编的。

be based on.usage: 表示“以…为基础，根据…”，主语通常是故事、理论、判断等事物

examples.en: The movie is based on a real-life story that happened 20 years ago.
examples.zh: 这部电影是根据20年前发生的真实故事改编的。

examples.en: Your argument should be based on solid evidence instead of guesses.
examples.zh: 你的论点应该基于可靠的证据，而不是猜测。

be based on.usage: 表示“以……为基础，根据……”，主语通常为理论、制度、项目等抽象事物，介词on后接基础依据

examples.en: Modern industry is based on the conception of the maximum production at lowest cost.
examples.zh: 现代工业建立在以最低成本实现最高产量的理念之上。

examples.en: The research paper is based on three years of field investigation.
examples.zh: 这篇研究论文是以三年的实地调查为基础完成的。

have sth in common.usage: 表示“有共同之处”，可接介词with表示“和某人/某物有共同点”

examples.en: All these cats had one experience in common: they had fallen off high buildings.
examples.zh: 所有这些猫都有一个共同的经历：它们都曾从高楼上掉下来过。

examples.en: The two sisters have nothing in common in terms of hobbies.
examples.zh: 这两姐妹在爱好方面没有任何共同点。

die from.usage: 表示“死于（外部原因，如事故、伤害等）”，区别于die of（多用于死于内部疾病、情感等）

examples.en: Only eight of them died from shock or injuries.
examples.zh: 它们中只有8只死于休克或受伤。

examples.en: Many people in the accident died from serious burns.
examples.zh: 事故中的很多人死于严重烧伤。

no shortage of.usage: 表示“不缺少；充足的”，后接可数名词复数或不可数名词

examples.en: There is no shortage of tall buildings in New York.
examples.zh: 纽约不缺高楼大厦。

examples.en: There is no shortage of talented young people in this industry.
examples.zh: 这个行业里不缺有天赋的年轻人。

suffer from.usage: 表示“遭受；患有（疾病、伤痛等）”，后接具体的病痛、困难等名词

examples.en: Sabrina fell 32 storeys, yet only suffered from a broken tooth.
examples.zh: 萨布丽娜从32层楼掉下来，却只断了一颗牙。

examples.en: Many office workers suffer from back pain these days.
examples.zh: 现在很多上班族都有背痛的问题。

suffer from.usage: 表示“遭受……的痛苦，受……困扰”，后常接疾病、负面情绪或不利处境

examples.en: A lot of office workers suffer from neck pain due to long hours of sitting.
examples.zh: 很多上班族因为长时间久坐受到颈椎痛的困扰。
