stretch out.usage: 表示“伸展；伸开（肢体）”，可接宾语也可单独使用

examples.en: They stretch out their legs like flying squirrels.
examples.zh: 它们把腿伸展开，就像飞鼠一样。

examples.en: He stretched out on the sofa and fell asleep soon.
examples.zh: 他在沙发上舒展身体，很快就睡着了。

sail for.usage: 表示船只、水手等启航前往某地，后接目的地

examples.en: The ship will sail for Sydney next week.
examples.zh: 这艘船将于下周启航前往悉尼。

by standards.usage: 表示“按照……的标准”，用来引出判断事物的参考依据

examples.en: By today's standards, this old phone is almost useless.
examples.zh: 按照如今的标准，这部旧手机几乎没什么用了。

be regarded as.usage: 被动结构，表示“被认为是，被看作”，用来表达人们对某事物的普遍看法

examples.en: He is regarded as one of the best writers of his generation.
examples.zh: 他被认为是他那一代人中最优秀的作家之一。

be regarded as.usage: 表示“被认为是，被看作是”，是被动语态结构，用来表达人们对事物的普遍看法

examples.en: This novel is regarded as one of the greatest works of the 20th century.
examples.zh: 这部小说被认为是20世纪最伟大的作品之一。

examples.en: In many cultures, the tiger is regarded as a symbol of courage.
examples.zh: 在很多文化中，老虎被看作是勇气的象征。

to ones horror.usage: 插入语，意为“令某人惊恐的是”，用来表达某人得知某事时的恐惧情绪

examples.en: To his horror, he found his wallet missing at the airport.
examples.zh: 令他惊恐的是，他在机场发现自己的钱包不见了。

abandon ship.usage: 固定表达，意为“弃船”，指船只遇险时船上人员撤离船只的命令或行为

examples.en: When the fire spread out of control, the captain gave the order to abandon ship.
examples.zh: 当火势失去控制时，船长下达了弃船的命令。

green channel.usage: 海关场景专有名词，指无需申报物品的旅客通行的“绿色通道”

examples.en: If you have nothing to declare, you can take the Green Channel.
examples.zh: 如果你没有需要申报的物品，你可以走绿色通道。

look sb in the eye.usage: 表示直视某人的眼睛，通常用于坦诚、问心无愧的场景

examples.en: He lied to me and couldn't look me in the eye when he spoke.
examples.zh: 他对我撒了谎，说话的时候不敢直视我的眼睛。

in a dreadful mess.usage: 形容东西乱作一团，或者情况非常糟糕

examples.en: After the party, the whole house was in a dreadful mess.
examples.zh: 派对结束后，整栋房子乱得一塌糊涂。

light up.usage: 此处指“（脸上）流露出喜悦、兴奋的神情”，还有“点亮、开灯”的含义

examples.en: Her face lit up when she received the admission letter.
examples.zh: 收到录取通知书的时候，她脸上露出了喜色。

examples.en: The woman's eyes immediately lit up and she fetched several bottles.
examples.zh: 那女人的眼睛立刻亮了起来，拿出了好几个瓶子。

pounce on.usage: 指猛抓住某物，或者突然指出别人的错误、抓住机会

examples.en: The reporter pounced on the politician's slip of the tongue.
examples.zh: 记者立刻抓住了政客的口误进行追问。

examples.en: Who has not stood in awe at the sight of a spider pouncing on a fly?
examples.zh: 看到蜘蛛扑向苍蝇时，谁没有敬畏地驻足观看？

exempt from.usage: 表示免除某责任、义务或费用

examples.en: Students are exempt from the entrance fee for the museum.
examples.zh: 学生可以免除这家博物馆的门票费用。

import duty.usage: 专有名词，指进口商品需要缴纳的进口税

examples.en: You have to pay import duty on luxury goods brought from abroad.
examples.zh: 你从国外带回的奢侈品需要缴纳进口税。

form a picture of.usage: 表示对某事物形成某种想象或印象

examples.en: It's hard to form a clear picture of life on other planets.
examples.zh: 很难对其他星球上的生活形成清晰的想象。

a sort of.usage: 用来表示不确定的描述，意为“某种，可以说是”，弱化语气

examples.en: The small café by the lake is a sort of paradise for book lovers.
examples.zh: 湖边的那家小咖啡馆可以说是读书爱好者的乐园。

starve to death.usage: 固定搭配，表示饿死，强调极端饥饿的后果

examples.en: Many animals would starve to death in winter if they don't store enough food.
examples.zh: 如果没有储存足够的食物，很多动物会在冬天饿死。

an element of.usage: 表示“一点点，些许”，说明某事物中含有少量的某种特质

examples.en: There is always an element of risk when you travel alone.
examples.zh: 独自旅行的时候总会有一点点风险。

hardly any.usage: 表示“几乎没有”，相当于very few或very little，否定含义

examples.en: There is hardly any coffee left in the pot, so I need to make more.
examples.zh: 壶里几乎没有咖啡了，我得再煮点。

eat like kings.usage: 非正式表达，意思是吃得非常好，享用美食

examples.en: During the Spring Festival, we eat like kings with all kinds of delicious food.
examples.zh: 春节期间我们吃得非常好，有各种各样的美食。

try on.usage: 表示“试穿（衣物、配饰等）”，是动副短语，宾语为代词时要放在短语中间

examples.en: She was impatient to try the new costume on.
examples.zh: 她迫不及待要试穿那件新的化装服。

examples.en: You should try the shoes on before buying them.
examples.zh: 你买鞋之前应该先试穿一下。

consist of.usage: 表示“由……组成，由……构成”，不用于被动语态和进行时态

examples.en: The costume consisted only of a sheet, but it was very effective.
examples.zh: 这件化装服只用了一张床单做成，但效果非常好。

examples.en: The research team consists of three scientists and two engineers.
examples.zh: 这个研究团队由三名科学家和两名工程师组成。

consist of.usage: 表示“由……组成，由……构成”，不用于被动语态和进行时态，主语为整体，of后接组成部分

examples.en: The modern city consists of monstrous edifices and dark, narrow streets.
examples.zh: 现代城市由丑陋的巨大建筑和阴暗狭窄的街道组成。

examples.en: The research team consists of three professors and five graduate students.
examples.zh: 这个研究团队由三名教授和五名研究生组成。

consist of.usage: 动词短语，意为“由……组成”，不用于被动语态，主语是整体，宾语是组成部分

examples.en: The former method simply consists of setting an elephant to work and beating him until he does what is expected of him.
examples.zh: 前一种方法无非就是强迫大象干活，打它，直到它按要求做事为止。

examples.en: The research team consists of three professors and five graduate students.
examples.zh: 这个研究团队由三名教授和五名研究生组成。

let out a cry.usage: 表示“大叫一声，发出一声叫喊”，let out可表示发出（声音、光等）

examples.en: The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces when he saw the 'ghost'.
examples.zh: 那个男人看到“鬼魂”的时候大叫一声，往后跳了好几步。

examples.en: She let out a cry of surprise when she saw the birthday gift.
examples.zh: 她看到生日礼物的时候发出了一声惊喜的叫喊。

put sb out of business.usage: 表示“使某人停业，迫使某人破产”，指让企业或商家无法继续经营

examples.en: The big supermarket put many small shops out of business last year.
examples.zh: 去年这家大型超市迫使很多小商店停业了。

examples.en: The serious fire almost put the factory out of business.
examples.zh: 那场严重的火灾几乎让这家工厂破产。

make a name for oneself.usage: 表示“出名，成名”，指通过自身努力获得名声、知名度

examples.en: She made a name for herself as a talented singer at a young age.
examples.zh: 她年轻时就作为一名有天赋的歌手成名了。

examples.en: The designer made a name for himself with his unique style.
examples.zh: 这位设计师凭借其独特的风格出了名。

be at war with.usage: 表示“与……处于交战状态”，主语常为国家、城邦等政权主体

examples.en: The two countries were at war with each other for three years.
examples.zh: 这两个国家彼此交战了三年。

examples.en: The kingdom was at war with its neighbor for control of the island.
examples.zh: 这个王国为了争夺岛屿的控制权与邻国交战。

dedicate to the memory of.usage: 表示“为纪念……”，常用于艺术作品、纪念碑等，表达对逝者的纪念

examples.en: This book is dedicated to the memory of my grandfather.
examples.zh: 这本书是为了纪念我的祖父而写的。

examples.en: The monument was dedicated to the memory of the soldiers who died in the war.
examples.zh: 这座纪念碑是为了纪念在战争中牺牲的士兵而建的。

go a long way.usage: 表示（钱、物品等）可以用很长时间，很经花；也可表示“大有帮助”

examples.en: A little kindness will go a long way when you meet people in trouble.
examples.zh: 当你遇到有困难的人时，一点善意会帮上大忙。

examples.en: If you are careful, this bottle of milk will go a long way.
examples.zh: 如果你省着点用，这瓶牛奶可以喝很久。

exchange for.usage: 表示“把……兑换成/换成……”，用于物品或货币的交换

examples.en: You can exchange your leftover foreign currency for local money at the airport.
examples.zh: 你可以在机场把剩下的外币兑换成当地货币。

examples.en: He exchanged his old phone for a new one by paying extra money.
examples.zh: 他补了差价，把旧手机换成了新的。

find ones way tointo.usage: 表示“偶然到达，最终进入”，主语常是物，暗含“不经意间去到某个地方”的含义

examples.en: Many of the books I bought never found their way to the bookshelf; they just stayed on my desk.
examples.zh: 我买的很多书从来没被放到书架上，就一直摆在我的书桌上。

examples.en: The lost key finally found its way into my jacket pocket.
examples.zh: 那把丢失的钥匙最后居然在我夹克口袋里找到了。

roll up sleeves.usage: 字面意思是卷起袖子，常引申为“准备动手干活，准备大干一场”

examples.en: After finishing the plan, we rolled up our sleeves and started the project.
examples.zh: 完成计划后，我们撸起袖子开始做这个项目。

examples.en: Roll up your sleeves; we have a lot of dishes to wash today.
examples.zh: 准备干活吧，我们今天有好多盘子要洗。

what is more.usage: 插入语，意为“而且，更重要的是”，用于补充说明更严重或更重要的情况

examples.en: It's difficult to finish this task in one day, and what is more, we don't have enough tools.
examples.zh: 一天内完成这个任务很难，而且我们还没有足够的工具。

examples.en: The hotel is not comfortable, and what is more, it's far from the city center.
examples.zh: 这家酒店住起来不舒服，而且离市中心还很远。

examples.en: What is more, they will not have to rely solely on the written word.
examples.zh: 更重要的是，他们不必完全依赖文字记载。

accuse sb of doing sth.usage: 用于指责或控告某人做了错事/违法行为，正式和非正式语境都可使用

examples.en: Dimitri immediately went to Aleko's house and angrily accused him of stealing the lamb.
examples.zh: 迪米特里立刻去了阿列科家，气冲冲地指责他偷了小羊。

examples.en: The man was accused of driving after drinking alcohol.
examples.zh: 这名男子被指控酒驾。

had better do sth.usage: 用来提出建议或警告，意为“最好做某事”，语气较强，暗含如果不做会有不好的后果

examples.en: He told him he had better return it or he would call the police.
examples.zh: 他告诉阿列科最好把羊还回去，否则他就要报警。

examples.en: You had better take an umbrella with you, for the weather forecast says it will rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 你最好带把伞，天气预报说今天下午会下雨。

deny doing sth.usage: 表示否认做过某件事，deny后必须接动名词形式，不能接不定式

examples.en: Aleko denied taking it and led Dimitri into his backyard.
examples.zh: 阿列科否认拿了羊，还把迪米特里领到了他的后院。

examples.en: The little boy denied breaking the window of the neighbor's house.
examples.zh: 小男孩否认打碎了邻居家的窗户。

ashamed of doing sth.usage: 表示为自己做过的某件事感到羞愧、惭愧，主语通常是人

examples.en: Ashamed of having acted so rashly, Dimitri apologized to Aleko for having accused him.
examples.zh: 迪米特里为自己的鲁莽行为感到不好意思，于是为自己指责了阿列科向他道歉。

examples.en: He was ashamed of having lied to his parents when he was a child.
examples.zh: 他为自己小时候对父母撒谎感到愧疚。

it is obvious that.usage: 用于引出很容易就能推断出的事实，it是形式主语，真正的主语是that引导的从句

examples.en: The rope had been cut, so it was obvious that the lamb had been stolen.
examples.zh: 绳子是被割断的，所以很明显小羊是被偷走的。

examples.en: It is obvious that he hasn't finished his homework by the look on his face.
examples.zh: 从他的表情就能明显看出来他没写完作业。

by no means.usage: 表示否定含义，意为“绝不，一点也不”，属于副词短语，可放在句首（需倒装）、句中或句末

examples.en: Though Verrazano is by no means considered to be a great explorer, his name will probably remain immortal.
examples.zh: 虽然韦拉扎诺绝对算不上一个伟大的探险家，但他的名字很可能会流芳百世。

examples.en: This is by no means the end of the project, we still have a lot of work to do.
examples.zh: 这绝不是项目的终点，我们还有很多工作要做。

by no means.unitTitle: The Longest Suspension Bridge in the World

by no means.usage: 表示“绝不，一点也不”，用于加强否定语气，可置于句首（需倒装）或句中

examples.en: He is by no means an experienced teacher.
examples.zh: 他绝不是一个有经验的老师。

name after.usage: 动词短语，意为“以……命名”，常用被动结构be named after sb

examples.en: The longest suspension bridge in the world was named after him.
examples.zh: 世界上最长的悬索桥是以他的名字命名的。

examples.en: The street is named after the famous scientist who made great contributions to the city.
examples.zh: 这条街是以那位为这座城市做出巨大贡献的著名科学家的名字命名的。

name after.unitTitle: The Longest Suspension Bridge in the World

take into account.usage: 动词短语，意为“考虑到，把……考虑在内”，相当于take into consideration，宾语可放在短语中间或account后面

examples.en: The bridge is so long that the shape of the earth had to be taken into account by its designer.
examples.zh: 这座桥太长了，以至于设计者必须把地球的形状考虑在内。

examples.en: When planning the trip, we need to take the weather into account.
examples.zh: 计划旅行的时候，我们需要把天气因素考虑在内。

take into account.unitTitle: The Longest Suspension Bridge in the World

be packed with.usage: 形容词短语，意为“挤满，塞满”，强调人或物的密度非常大

examples.en: It has been estimated that if the bridge were packed with cars, it would still only be carrying a third of its total capacity.
examples.zh: 据估计，即使桥上挤满了汽车，它的载重量也仍然只有总承载量的三分之一。

examples.en: During the Spring Festival, the train station is always packed with passengers going home.
examples.zh: 春节期间，火车站总是挤满了回家的旅客。

be packed with.unitTitle: The Longest Suspension Bridge in the World

in the midst of.usage: 介词短语，意为“在……之中，在……中间”，可指地理位置的中间，也可指处于某种事件的过程中

examples.en: He described it as 'a very agreeable situation located within two small hills in the midst of which flowed a great river.'
examples.zh: 他把它描述为“一个非常宜人的地方，坐落在两座小山之间，中间流淌着一条大河。”

examples.en: The country is in the midst of an economic recovery.
examples.zh: 这个国家正处于经济复苏的过程中。

in the midst of.unitTitle: The Longest Suspension Bridge in the World

in the midst of.usage: 表示“在…之中；正当…的时候”，既可指处于某个具体的环境中间，也可指处于某个事件的过程中

examples.en: In the midst of all this movement, the weight and the pen would be still.
examples.zh: 在所有这些运动中，重物和笔却会保持不动。

examples.en: The country is in the midst of an economic recovery.
examples.zh: 这个国家正处于经济复苏的过程中。

take no interest in.usage: 表示对某事物不感兴趣，毫不关心

examples.en: Even people who take no interest in art cannot have failed to notice examples of modern sculpture.
examples.zh: 即使对艺术不感兴趣的人也不可能没注意到公共场所的现代雕塑。

examples.en: The objects move in response to a gust of wind.
examples.zh: 这些物体会随风而动。

in response to.usage: 表示“作为对…的回应；响应”，引出某个动作的触发原因

examples.en: In response to renewed pleadings, Bruce stopped.
examples.zh: 在我们再次恳求下，布鲁斯停了车。

examples.en: The company changed its policy in response to customer complaints.
examples.zh: 公司为了回应客户投诉，修改了政策。

examples.en: Some so-called 'modern' pieces have been on display for nearly eighty years.
examples.zh: 一些所谓的'现代'作品已经展出将近八十年了。

examples.en: Lined up against the wall, there were long thin wires attached to metal spheres.
examples.zh: 靠墙排列着系着金属球的细长电线。

examples.en: It was rather like an exhibition of prehistoric electronic equipment.
examples.zh: 它非常像一场史前电子设备的展览。

examples.en: These peculiar forms not only seemed designed to shock people emotionally.
examples.zh: 这些奇特的形状似乎不仅是为了在情感上震撼人们。

cannot have failed to notice.usage: 不可能没注意到，表示一定会注意到

examples.en: Even people who take no interest in art cannot have failed to notice examples of modern sculpture.
examples.zh: 即使对艺术不感兴趣的人也一定会注意到现代雕塑。

electric shock.usage: /ɪˈlektrɪk ʃɒk/ noun. 电击，触电（指电流通过身体时造成的感觉或伤害）

examples.en: They recently took considerable interest in Mrs. Ramsay's cat.
examples.zh: 他们最近对拉姆齐夫人的猫非常感兴趣。

in safe hands.usage: 安全；处于可信赖的人手中

examples.en: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands.
examples.zh: 写信人称拉斯塔斯很安全。

examples.en: She changed her mind and decided to pay the ransom.
examples.zh: 她改变了主意，决定支付赎金。

examples.en: Mrs. Ramsay was sure that the kidnapper would keep his word.
examples.zh: 拉姆齐夫人确信绑匪会遵守诺言。

examples.en: She looked everywhere for him but could not find him.
examples.zh: 她到处找他，但找不到。

examples.en: She withdrew money and followed the kidnapper's instructions.
examples.zh: 她取了钱并按照绑匪的指示行事。

examples.en: Rastus leads an orderly life.
examples.zh: 拉斯塔斯过着有规律的生活。

in more ways than one.usage: 不止一种方式；多方面地

examples.en: Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one!
examples.zh: 考虑到她付出的金额，拉斯塔斯多方面都很珍贵！

be dear to someone.usage: 对某人来说很珍贵/亲爱的

examples.en: Rastus was very dear to her.
examples.zh: 拉斯塔斯对她来说非常珍贵。

examples.en: The letter had made that quite clear.
examples.zh: 信里已经把这一点说得清清楚楚。

it looked as if.usage: 用来表示“看起来似乎/好像”，可描述真实情况，也可描述虚拟的假设

examples.en: It looked as if it was going to rain, so we took an umbrella with us.
examples.zh: 看起来好像要下雨了，所以我们带了一把伞。

examples.en: He smiled happily, and it looked as if he had won the game.
examples.zh: 他笑得很开心，看起来好像已经赢了比赛。

be forced to do sth.usage: 表示“被迫做某事”，强调因外界原因不得不做非主观意愿的事

examples.en: Because of the heavy snow, the driver was forced to stop the car.
examples.zh: 因为大雪，司机被迫把车停下来。

examples.en: Many small companies were forced to close during the economic crisis.
examples.zh: 经济危机期间很多小公司被迫倒闭。

make an attempt.usage: 表示“尝试、试图做某事”，后可接to do或at doing

examples.en: He made an attempt to pass the driving test, but he failed because of nervousness.
examples.zh: 他尝试通过驾照考试，但因为紧张失败了。

examples.en: The team made an attempt at climbing the highest mountain in the country.
examples.zh: 这支队伍尝试攀登该国最高的山峰。

within of.usage: 表示“在距离……不到……的范围内”，用来描述距离、时间等的接近程度

examples.en: The hotel is within 10 minutes' walk of the railway station.
examples.zh: 这家酒店距离火车站步行不到10分钟。

examples.en: The team was within one point of winning the championship.
examples.zh: 这支队伍差一分就能赢得冠军。

bring science to the game.usage: 指把科学的方法或技术引入某项运动，使其更系统化

examples.en: Mendoza brought science to the game, revolutionising prizefighting.
examples.zh: 门多萨把科学带进拳击，使当时的拳击运动发生了革命性变化。

enjoy tremendous popularity.usage: 表示某人或某事在大众中极受欢迎

examples.en: Mendoza enjoyed tremendous popularity among all classes.
examples.zh: 门多萨在各阶层中都极受欢迎。

be adored by rich and poor alike.phrase: be adored by rich and poor alike
be adored by rich and poor alike.usage: 形容受到所有社会阶层人们的喜爱

examples.en: He was adored by rich and poor alike.
examples.zh: 无论是富人还是穷人，都对他崇拜不已。

rise to fame swiftly.usage: 指在短时间内迅速成名

examples.en: Mendoza rose to fame swiftly after a boxing match at fourteen.
examples.zh: 门多萨在十四岁时的一场拳击赛后迅速成名。

turn against.usage: 表示从友好或支持转为敌对或反对

examples.en: Humphries turned against him after Mendoza's success.
examples.zh: 在门多萨成功后，汉弗莱斯转向反对他。

examples.en: The two men quarrelled bitterly.
examples.zh: 两人激烈争吵。

settle the argument by a fight.phrase: settle the argument by a fight

examples.en: The argument could only be settled by a fight.
examples.zh: 这场争论只能通过一场拳赛来解决。

bet a great deal of money on.phrase: bet a great deal of money on
bet a great deal of money on.usage: 指在某人或某事上投入大量赌注

examples.en: The public bet a great deal of money on Mendoza.
examples.zh: 公众在门多萨身上下了大额赌注。

be paid as much as for a single appeara.phrase: be paid as much as £100 for a single appearance
be paid as much as for a single appeara.usage: 指一次出场费高达一百英镑

examples.en: He was paid as much as £100 for a single appearance.
examples.zh: 他一次出场就能得到高达一百英镑的报酬。

be sent to prison for failing to pay his.phrase: be sent to prison for failing to pay his debts
be sent to prison for failing to pay his.usage: 因未能偿还债务而被监禁

examples.en: He was sent to prison for failing to pay his debts.
examples.zh: 他因未能偿还债务而被送进监狱。

examples.en: Students must learn these poems by heart.
examples.zh: 学生们必须把这些诗背下来。

examples.en: He knew all the lines by heart.
examples.zh: 他把这些台词都背熟了。

examples.en: The show has run for years on end.
examples.zh: 这个节目已经连续演出了很多年。

examples.en: You have no cause to complain.
examples.zh: 你没有理由抱怨。

examples.en: The actress came on to the stage at the second act.
examples.zh: 女演员在第二幕登上舞台。

play a joke on someone.usage: 捉弄某人；开某人的玩笑

examples.en: They decided to play a joke on their teacher.
examples.zh: 他们决定捉弄一下老师。

examples.en: The audience looked on eagerly as the drama unfolded.
examples.zh: 观众热切地看着剧情展开。

be cast in the role of.phrase: be cast in the role of

examples.en: She was cast in the role of Juliet.
examples.zh: 她被选中扮演朱丽叶的角色。

examples.en: He handed the letter to the prisoner.
examples.zh: 他把信递给了囚犯。

examples.en: With this, he hurried off the stage.
examples.zh: 说完，他便匆匆离开了舞台。

one mans meat is another mans poison.phrase: One man's meat is another man's poison
one mans meat is another mans poison.usage: 谚语，意思是甲之蜜糖，乙之砒霜。指不同的人对同一种事物有不同的喜好或评价

examples.en: One man's meat is another man's poison - some people love coffee but others find it terrible.
examples.zh: 萝卜青菜各有所爱——有人爱咖啡，有人却觉得它很糟糕。

one mans meat is another mans poison.unitTitle: One Man's Meat is Another Man's Poison

stick to.usage: 坚持；坚守；维持原状。指坚持做某事或坚持某种习惯

examples.en: We stick to our original plan despite the difficulties.
examples.zh: 尽管有困难，我们仍然坚持原计划。

examples.en: Most people stick to the foods they grew up with.
examples.zh: 大多数人都坚持吃他们从小吃到大的食物。

stick to.unitTitle: One Man's Meat is Another Man's Poison

appeal to.usage: 吸引；使感兴趣。指某事物引起某人的兴趣或好感

examples.en: The idea never appealed to me very much.
examples.zh: 这个想法从来没有真正吸引过我。

examples.en: Does this job appeal to you?
examples.zh: 这份工作吸引你吗？

appeal to.unitTitle: One Man's Meat is Another Man's Poison

on a sudden impulse.usage: 凭（一时）冲动。指突然产生的强烈欲望或想法驱使的行动

examples.en: Acting on a sudden impulse, I collected several dozen snails.
examples.zh: 一时冲动之下，我抓了几十只蜗牛。

examples.en: She bought the dress on impulse.
examples.zh: 她一时冲动买下了那条裙子。

on a sudden impulse.unitTitle: One Man's Meat is Another Man's Poison

take possession of.usage: 拥有；接管；占领。指开始控制或占据某物

examples.en: The snails had taken complete possession of the hall!
examples.zh: 蜗牛已经完全占领了门厅！

examples.en: The company took possession of the new building last month.
examples.zh: 公司上个月接管了那栋新楼。

take possession of.unitTitle: One Man's Meat is Another Man's Poison

be delighted to.usage: 高兴做某事；对某事感到高兴。表达对某事的愉悦感受

examples.en: Robert was delighted to see me and equally pleased with my little gift.
examples.zh: 罗伯特见到我很高兴，对我的小礼物也很满意。

be delighted to.unitTitle: One Man's Meat is Another Man's Poison

turn at.usage: 对...感到恶心/反胃。指对某种想法或气味感到厌恶

examples.en: Your stomach would turn at the idea of frying potatoes in animal fat.
examples.zh: 一想到用动物油炸土豆，你就会感到恶心。

turn at.unitTitle: One Man's Meat is Another Man's Poison

bring up.usage: 抚养；培养；养大。指在成长过程中被照顾和教育

examples.en: Most of us have been brought up to eat certain foods.
examples.zh: 我们大多数人在成长过程中都被培养吃某些特定的食物。

bring up.unitTitle: One Man's Meat is Another Man's Poison

a heavy shower.usage: 一阵大雨；倾盆大雨。指短时间内的大降雨

examples.en: One day, after a heavy shower, I noticed a huge number of snails.
examples.zh: 有一天，一阵大雨过后，我注意到大量的蜗牛。

a heavy shower.unitTitle: One Man's Meat is Another Man's Poison

a skeleton in the cupboard.usage: 固定习语，指家庭或个人不愿公开的丑事、家丑

examples.en: After the politician resigned, the public found he had many skeletons in the cupboard.
examples.zh: 这位政客辞职后，公众发现他有很多不可告人的丑事。

to varying degrees.usage: 表示“在不同程度上”，用于说明事物的程度差异

examples.en: Students in this class are to varying degrees interested in art.
examples.zh: 这个班的学生对艺术的兴趣程度各不相同。

once upon a time.usage: 常用于故事开头，表示“从前；曾经”，也可口语中提及过去的经历

examples.en: Once upon a time, there lived an old fisherman by the sea.
examples.zh: 从前，海边住着一位老渔夫。

show sb to.usage: 表示“带领某人到（某地）”，常用于接待客人的场景

examples.en: The waiter showed us to our table near the window.
examples.zh: 服务员把我们领到了靠窗的桌子旁。

stand on end.usage: (毛发) 竖立，通常用来形容人非常恐惧、震惊

examples.en: The horror movie was so scary that it made my hair stand on end.
examples.zh: 这部恐怖电影太吓人了，吓得我汗毛都竖起来了。

be about to do.usage: 表示“即将做某事；正要做某事”，强调动作马上就要发生

examples.en: I was about to go out when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我正要出门，电话响了。

dash to.usage: 表示“冲向；猛奔到某地”，强调动作的急促

examples.en: When the bell rang, he dashed to the classroom.
examples.zh: 铃声一响，他就冲向了教室。

examples.en: On the Indian Ocean, the Cutty Sark took the lead.
examples.zh: 在印度洋上，卡蒂萨克号取得了领先。

be struck by.usage: 被击中；遭受，指突然遭遇不好的事情

examples.en: In August, she was struck by a very heavy storm.
examples.zh: 八月，她遭遇了一场猛烈的暴风雨。

examples.en: Because of this, the Cutty Sark lost her lead.
examples.zh: 因此，卡蒂萨克号失去了领先地位。

call in at.usage: （船等）停靠，指在某个港口停留

examples.en: The captain called in at a port to have a new rudder fitted.
examples.zh: 船长将船停靠在一个港口，让工人安装新舵。

roll from side to side.usage: 左右摇晃，形容船只不稳地晃动

examples.en: The Cutty Sark rolled from side to side and it became impossible to steer her.
examples.zh: 卡蒂萨克号左右摇晃，变得无法操控。

fit with difficulty.usage: 困难地安装，形容做某事很艰难

examples.en: A temporary rudder was made and it was fitted with great difficulty.
examples.zh: 一个临时舵被制造出来，但安装得非常困难。

there is no doubt that.usage: 毫无疑问...，用于强调确信某事

examples.en: There is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder she would have won the race easily.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，如果她没有失去舵，她会轻松赢得比赛。

there is no doubt that.usage: 固定句型，意思是“毫无疑问……”，that引导同位语从句说明doubt的内容

examples.en: There is no doubt that regular exercise is good for physical and mental health.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，规律锻炼对身心健康都有好处。

examples.en: Her rudder was torn away.
examples.zh: 她的舵被撕裂了。

examples.en: Before they were replaced by steamships, sailing vessels were used to carry tea.
examples.zh: 在被汽船取代之前，帆船被用来运茶。

get something for nothing.usage: 表示免费获得某物、不劳而获，口语和书面语中都常用

examples.en: There is no such thing as getting something for nothing in the world.
examples.zh: 世界上没有不劳而获的好事。

examples.en: Many people are attracted by the idea of getting something for nothing.
examples.zh: 很多人都被免费得东西的想法吸引。

exert an influence on.usage: 表示对……施加影响，可在influence前加形容词修饰影响的性质

examples.en: Parents exert a great influence on their children's character development.
examples.zh: 父母对孩子的性格发展有很大影响。

examples.en: Social media exerts a subtle influence on people's values.
examples.zh: 社交媒体对人们的价值观有着微妙的影响。

pride oneself on.usage: 为……感到自豪、得意，主语通常是人

examples.en: He prides himself on his ability to speak four languages fluently.
examples.zh: 他为自己能流利说四种语言而自豪。

examples.en: The restaurant prides itself on using only fresh local ingredients.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅以只使用新鲜本地食材为荣。

enable sb to do sth.usage: 使某人能够做某事，是正式表达，常用于说明某事物的作用

examples.en: The new policy enables low-income families to afford better housing.
examples.zh: 新政策让低收入家庭能够负担得起更好的住房。

examples.en: The Internet enables people to communicate with others around the world easily.
examples.zh: 互联网让人们可以轻松和世界各地的人交流。

capture the attention of.usage: 吸引……的注意力，同义表达还有draw/attract one's attention

examples.en: The bright color of the poster captured the attention of passers-by.
examples.zh: 海报鲜艳的颜色吸引了路人的注意。

examples.en: His speech at the conference captured the attention of all the attendees.
examples.zh: 他在会议上的发言吸引了所有参会者的注意。

the response to.usage: 对……的反应、回应，response后接介词to

examples.en: The response to the new product launch was beyond our expectation.
examples.zh: 新产品发布后的反响超出了我们的预期。

examples.en: There has been a positive response to the government's new environmental policy.
examples.zh: 公众对政府新的环保政策反应积极。

before long.usage: 不久之后，相当于soon，可放在句首或句末

examples.en: Before long, he got used to the new school life and made many friends.
examples.zh: 不久之后他就适应了新的学校生活，还交了很多朋友。

examples.en: The project is progressing well, and before long we will see the results.
examples.zh: 项目进展顺利，很快我们就能看到成果了。

of all shapes and sizes.usage: 各种形状和大小的，用来形容事物种类多样

examples.en: The store sells bags of all shapes and sizes to meet different customers' needs.
examples.zh: 这家店卖各种形状和尺寸的包，满足不同顾客的需求。

examples.en: On the beach, there are shells of all shapes and sizes scattered everywhere.
examples.zh: 沙滩上散落着各种形状和大小的贝壳。

in the light of.usage: 介词短语，意为“根据；鉴于”，用于引出做判断或决定的依据，可置于句首或句中

examples.en: In the light of recent research, this theory has been proved wrong.
examples.zh: 根据最近的研究，这个理论已经被证明是错误的。

examples.en: We revised our plan in the light of the new data.
examples.zh: 我们根据新的数据修改了计划。

in the light of.unitTitle: Nothing to Sell and Nothing to Buy

in terms of.usage: 介词短语，意为“就…而言；在…方面”，用于限定讨论的角度或范围

examples.en: The job is great in terms of salary, but it has its disadvantages.
examples.zh: 就薪水而言这份工作很棒，但它也有缺点。

examples.en: Measured in terms of educational resources, this city is far ahead of others.
examples.zh: 从教育资源方面衡量，这座城市远远领先于其他城市。

in terms of.unitTitle: Nothing to Sell and Nothing to Buy

in terms of.usage: 用于从某个角度、某个方面谈论事物，引出讨论的维度

examples.en: Rest, in terms of muscle relaxation and so on, can be achieved by a brief period lying, or even sitting down.
examples.zh: 就肌肉放松等方面而言，短暂的躺卧甚至坐着就能得到休息。

examples.en: In terms of customer satisfaction, the new policy is a great success.
examples.zh: 从客户满意度来看，新政策非常成功。

in terms of.usage: 用于引出谈论的角度或范围，意为“就……而言，在……方面”

examples.en: In terms of nutrition, this vegetable is much better than potato.
examples.zh: 就营养而言，这种蔬菜比土豆好得多。

examples.en: The job is great in terms of salary, but it has its disadvantages.
examples.zh: 就薪水而言，这份工作很棒，但它也有自己的缺点。

be free from.usage: 形容词短语，意为“不受…影响；没有…的”，用于描述人或事物摆脱了某种不好的状态

examples.en: She wants to live in a place that is free from noise.
examples.zh: 她想住在一个没有噪音的地方。

examples.en: Regular exercise helps you stay free from illness.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼能帮你远离疾病。

be free from.unitTitle: Nothing to Sell and Nothing to Buy

move from place to place.usage: 动词短语，意为“四处迁徙；奔波”，描述没有固定住所、经常更换居住地点的状态

examples.en: As a travel photographer, he has to move from place to place all year round.
examples.zh: 作为一名旅行摄影师，他常年需要四处奔波。

examples.en: In ancient times, nomadic tribes moved from place to place to find water and grass for their animals.
examples.zh: 在古代，游牧部落为了给牲畜寻找水草四处迁徙。

move from place to place.unitTitle: Nothing to Sell and Nothing to Buy

in times of.usage: 介词短语，意为“在…的时候；在…的时期”，后接表示困难、需要等的名词，描述特定的情境阶段

examples.en: Friends always help each other in times of difficulty.
examples.zh: 朋友总会在困难的时候互相帮助。

examples.en: The company provided enough supplies in times of emergency.
examples.zh: 公司在紧急时期提供了充足的物资。

in times of.unitTitle: Nothing to Sell and Nothing to Buy

speak of sb with contempt.usage: 动词短语，意为“以轻蔑的态度谈论某人”，描述对某人的不尊重态度

examples.en: It is impolite to speak of those who made mistakes with contempt.
examples.zh: 以轻蔑的态度谈论那些犯过错的人是不礼貌的。

examples.en: He used to speak of his former boss with contempt, but now he admires him a lot.
examples.zh: 他过去常常轻蔑地谈论他的前老板，但现在他非常敬佩对方。

speak of sb with contempt.unitTitle: Nothing to Sell and Nothing to Buy

go to great lengths to do sth.phrase: go to great lengths to do sth.
go to great lengths to do sth.usage: 表示“竭尽全力做某事，不遗余力做某事”，含为达成目的不惜花费时间精力的含义

examples.en: The man went to great lengths to prove that the diamonds were real.
examples.zh: 那个男子竭尽全力证明这些钻石是真的。

examples.en: Many companies go to great lengths to protect their trade secrets.
examples.zh: 许多公司不遗余力地保护自己的商业机密。

get rid of.usage: 表示“摆脱，除去，处理掉”，可接人或物作宾语

examples.en: It took me over half an hour to get rid of him.
examples.zh: 我花了半个多小时才摆脱掉他。

examples.en: I need to get rid of these old clothes I never wear.
examples.zh: 我需要把这些我从来不穿的旧衣服处理掉。

get rid of.usage: 表示“摆脱，除去，处理掉”，后接不需要的人或事物

examples.en: We need to get rid of all the old furniture in the apartment.
examples.zh: 我们需要把公寓里所有的旧家具都处理掉。

examples.en: It took me a month to get rid of my cough.
examples.zh: 我花了一个月时间才治好咳嗽。

as a special favour.usage: 表示“作为特别优惠/优待”，常用于商家说服顾客购买商品的语境

examples.en: As a special favour, he would let me have it for ￡30.
examples.zh: 作为特别优惠，他愿意收我30英镑就把它卖给我。

examples.en: The shop owner gave me the discount as a special favour for regular customers.
examples.zh: 作为给老顾客的特别优待，店主给了我这个折扣。

have no intention of doing sth.phrase: have no intention of doing sth.
have no intention of doing sth.usage: 表示“没有做某事的打算，无意做某事”，强调主观上完全不想做

examples.en: I had no intention of buying one, but I could not conceal the fact that I was impressed by the size of the diamonds.
examples.zh: 我根本不想买（钻戒），但我无法掩饰的是，那些钻石的大小确实给我留下了深刻的印象。

examples.en: She has no intention of giving up her career after getting married.
examples.zh: 她完全没有打算在结婚后放弃自己的事业。

be impressed by.usage: 表示“对…印象深刻，被…打动”，主语是人，宾语是令人印象深刻的事物

examples.en: I was impressed by the efficiency of the local government.
examples.zh: 当地政府的办事效率给我留下了深刻的印象。

throw up ones arms in despair.phrase: throw up one's arms in despair
throw up ones arms in despair.usage: 表示“绝望地举起双手，无可奈何”，用来表达失望、无力的肢体动作和情绪

examples.en: Though he kept throwing up his arms in despair, he readily accepted the ￡5 I gave him.
examples.zh: 尽管他一直绝望地挥舞着手臂，但还是欣然接受了我付给他的5英镑。

examples.en: When he found all his efforts had been in vain, he threw up his arms in despair.
examples.zh: 当他发现自己所有的努力都白费了时，他绝望地举起了双手。

be pleased with.usage: 表示“对…感到满意/高兴”，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: I felt especially pleased with my wonderful bargain.
examples.zh: 我为自己这笔绝妙的交易感到格外得意。

examples.en: The manager was very pleased with the performance of the new employee.
examples.zh: 经理对新员工的表现非常满意。

be bound up with.usage: 表示事物之间密切相关、密不可分，用来描述两个事物的关联性

examples.en: The future of the company is bound up with the development of new technology.
examples.zh: 这家公司的未来和新技术的发展密切相关。

examples.en: Personality is bound up with the environment one grows up in.
examples.zh: 性格和一个人的成长环境密不可分。

fail to do sth.usage: 表示没能做到某事、未达成某个动作，比can't do更书面正式

examples.en: I failed to catch the last bus yesterday, so I had to take a taxi home.
examples.zh: 我昨天没赶上末班车，所以只好打车回家。

examples.en: The team failed to win the game even after three months of hard training.
examples.zh: 尽管经过了三个月的刻苦训练，这支队伍还是没能赢得比赛。

come into fashion.usage: 表示“开始流行，成为时尚”，主语通常是某种风格、事物、风潮

examples.en: Vintage clothes have come into fashion again among young people these years.
examples.zh: 这些年复古服装又在年轻人中流行起来了。

examples.en: Short haircuts came into fashion in the 1920s for women in Western countries.
examples.zh: 20世纪20年代，短发在西方国家的女性中开始流行。

take heart.usage: 表示“鼓起勇气，振作起来”，是不及物短语，用来描述人在受挫后恢复信心

examples.en: When you face difficulties in study, take heart and you will find solutions finally.
examples.zh: 当你在学习中遇到困难时，振作起来，最终会找到解决办法的。

examples.en: The team took heart after their first victory and performed better in the following matches.
examples.zh: 这支队伍在首场胜利后振作了起来，在后续的比赛中表现得更好。

sure enough.usage: 表示“果然，果真”，放在句首或句中，用来证明之前的猜测、预料是正确的

examples.en: I thought it would rain this afternoon, and sure enough, it started pouring at 3 o'clock.
examples.zh: 我就觉得今天下午会下雨，果然，三点的时候就开始下大雨了。

examples.en: She said she would bring me a gift when she came back from Japan, and sure enough, she gave me a delicate handcraft.
examples.zh: 她说从日本回来的时候会给我带礼物，果然，她给了我一个精致的手工艺品。

slip on.usage: 表示“在…上滑倒”，后接表示路面、地面的名词，强调滑倒的地点/原因

examples.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor when you enter the room.
examples.zh: 进房间的时候小心别在湿地板上滑倒。

examples.en: The old man slipped on the icy road and hurt his arm last winter.
examples.zh: 去年冬天这位老人在结冰的路上滑倒，伤到了胳膊。

give up ones job.usage: 表示辞职、放弃工作，可用于主动离职的场景

examples.en: He gave up his job in the city to move back to his hometown.
examples.zh: 他辞去了城里的工作，搬回了家乡。

stay up all night.usage: 表示熬夜，一整晚不睡觉，强调夜间保持清醒的状态

examples.en: I had to stay up all night to finish the report before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我不得不熬一整晚，在截止日期前完成报告。

claim to have done sth.usage: 声称曾经做过某事，to have done是不定式的完成式，表示动作发生在claim之前

examples.en: The man claimed to have seen a UFO flying over the park last week.
examples.zh: 这名男子声称上周看到一个不明飞行物飞过公园上空。

none other than.usage: 表示“不是别人，正是……”，用于强调某人的身份出人意料

examples.en: The winner of the competition was none other than my little sister.
examples.zh: 比赛的获胜者不是别人，正是我的小妹妹。

be supposed to have done sth.phrase: be supposed to have done sth
be supposed to have done sth.usage: 表示“被认为已经做了某事”，暗含该认知可能与事实不符的含义

examples.en: The ancient temple was supposed to have been destroyed in the war, but it still exists.
examples.zh: 人们本以为这座古庙已经在战争中被毁了，但它依然存在。

in action.usage: 表示“在战斗中，在行动中”，此处指军事作战场景

examples.en: Many soldiers were reported missing in action after the battle.
examples.zh: 战斗结束后，许多士兵被报失踪。

in hiding.usage: 表示“躲藏着，隐藏着”，是固定搭配，描述躲避他人的状态

examples.en: The witness remained in hiding until the criminal was arrested.
examples.zh: 在罪犯被逮捕之前，证人一直躲着不露面。

unaware of.usage: 表示“不知道，没意识到”，可作状语或表语，后接名词或名词性从句

examples.en: He walked straight past his teacher, completely unaware of her presence.
examples.zh: 他径直从老师身边走过，完全没意识到她在那里。

draw attention to sbsth.usage: 表示“吸引对……的注意”，主语可以是人或事物

examples.en: The poster is designed to draw attention to the problem of global warming.
examples.zh: 这张海报旨在吸引人们关注全球变暖的问题。

examples.en: He tried not to draw attention to his mistake in the report.
examples.zh: 他尽量不让别人注意到他报告里的错误。

add colour to.usage: 表示“给……增添趣味/色彩”，用比喻义表示让原本平淡的事物变得生动

examples.en: They add colour to the dull routine of everyday life.
examples.zh: 他们给平淡的日常生活增添了趣味。

examples.en: Her lively stories added colour to the boring meeting.
examples.zh: 她生动的故事给无聊的会议增添了乐趣。

pay no attention to.usage: 表示“不理会、不注意……”，后面接人或事物

examples.en: The assistant asked him to leave, but Dickie paid no attention to him and requested to see the manager.
examples.zh: 店员让他离开，但迪基理都不理他，要求见经理。

examples.en: Pay no attention to what others say about your choice.
examples.zh: 别理会别人对你的选择的议论。

insist on.usage: 表示“坚持要求、坚决主张”，后接名词或动词的-ing形式

examples.en: He insisted on the assistant's counting the money before he left.
examples.zh: 他坚持要店员数清楚钱再离开。

examples.en: My mother insists on walking for an hour after dinner every day.
examples.zh: 我妈妈坚持每天饭后散步一小时。

be supposed to.usage: 表示“被认为；应该”，可以指人们普遍的看法，也可以指义务、规定

examples.en: Though the pictures were supposed to be the work of famous artists, they had in fact been painted by Dickie.
examples.zh: 虽然这些画被认为是著名艺术家的作品，但实际上都是迪基画的。

examples.en: You are supposed to arrive at the office before 9 o'clock every morning.
examples.zh: 你应该每天早上九点之前到办公室。

examples.en: The captain was instructed to give up the search.
examples.zh: 船长被指示放弃搜索。

examples.en: The crew were at first under the impression that the lost ship had been found.
examples.zh: 船员们最初以为找到了那艘失踪的船。

examples.en: The captain was able to piece together all the information.
examples.zh: 船长能够拼凑出所有的信息。

piece together.usage: /piːs təˈɡeðər/ verb phrase. 拼凑；整合（指将零散的信息拼凑成完整画面）

examples.en: Information that had come to light was collected.
examples.zh: 被揭露的信息被收集起来。

examples.en: The captain of the Elkor ordered his men to salvage as much as possible.
examples.zh: 埃尔科号船长命令他的手下尽可能多地打捞。

examples.en: Elkor had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks.
examples.zh: 埃尔科号已经在巴伦支海搜索了数周。

examples.en: What they had in fact found was a ship which had been sunk many years before.
examples.zh: 他们实际上发现的是一艘很多年前沉没的船。

examples.en: It is, in fact, a primitive type of calendar.
examples.zh: 实际上，这是一种原始的日历。

examples.en: This was later confirmed by a naval official.
examples.zh: 这后来被一位海军官员证实。

log book.usage: /ˈlɒɡ bʊk/ noun. 航海日志（记录船舶航行情况的日志）

get out of control.usage: 表示事态、情绪等失去控制，无法被管理或约束

examples.en: The protest got out of control and turned into a riot.
examples.zh: 抗议活动失去了控制，演变成了骚乱。

examples.en: If you don't set rules for the kids, they'll soon get out of control.
examples.zh: 如果你不给孩子们定规矩，他们很快就会无法无天。

set up a chain of reactions.phrase: set up a chain of reactions
set up a chain of reactions.usage: 指一个事件引发一连串连锁反应，常用来描述因果递进的事件序列

examples.en: The announcement of the price rise set up a chain of reactions in the market.
examples.zh: 涨价的公告在市场上引发了一连串连锁反应。

examples.en: A small mistake in the experiment set up a chain of reactions that ruined the whole project.
examples.zh: 实验中的一个小错误引发了连锁反应，毁了整个项目。

keep an eye on.usage: 口语常用表达，意思是照看、留意、密切关注

examples.en: Could you keep an eye on my suitcase while I go to the restroom?
examples.zh: 我去洗手间的时候你能帮我照看一下行李箱吗？

examples.en: We need to keep an eye on the weather forecast in case it rains during the picnic.
examples.zh: 我们得留意天气预报，以防野餐的时候下雨。

reduce sb to tears.usage: 表示使某人难过/委屈到哭，强调事件对人情绪的强烈影响

examples.en: The cruel comments on her speech reduced her to tears.
examples.zh: 对她演讲的刻薄评论把她弄哭了。

examples.en: The pressure of being a new nurse reduced her to tears several times in the first month.
examples.zh: 作为新护士的压力让她第一个月好几次都哭了。

rush hour.usage: 指城市早晚的交通高峰时段，不可数名词短语

examples.en: It's better to leave before 7 a.m. to avoid the rush hour traffic.
examples.zh: 最好早上7点前出发，避开高峰时段的车流。

examples.en: The subway is always crowded during rush hour.
examples.zh: 地铁在高峰时段总是很拥挤。

get into a panic.usage: 表示陷入恐慌状态，强调突然产生的慌乱情绪

examples.en: She got into a panic when she found her passport was missing.
examples.zh: 她发现护照不见了的时候陷入了恐慌。

examples.en: Don't get into a panic when you meet difficulties, take a deep breath and think of solutions.
examples.zh: 遇到困难时别慌，深呼吸想想解决办法。

draw up alongside.usage: 指车辆等驶到旁边、并排停靠

examples.en: A police car drew up alongside us and signaled us to pull over.
examples.zh: 一辆警车开到我们旁边，示意我们靠边停车。

examples.en: The taxi drew up alongside the curb to pick up the passenger.
examples.zh: 出租车开到路边停靠，接乘客上车。

pull up.usage: 指车辆或司机停车、放慢车速停下

examples.en: He pulled up in front of the gate and got out of the car quickly.
examples.zh: 他在大门前停下车，快速从车里出来。

examples.en: The bus pulled up just as I was running to the stop.
examples.zh: 我正跑向公交站的时候，公交车刚好停下了。

pile up.usage: 表示堆积、积压，可指具体物品的堆叠，也可指事务、问题的累积

examples.en: Work always piles up at the end of the year.
examples.zh: 年底的时候工作总是堆成山。

examples.en: Snow piled up against the windows during the blizzard.
examples.zh: 暴风雪期间，雪靠着窗户堆了起来。

get sth on the move.usage: 表示使某事重新运转、恢复正常运行

examples.en: The new manager tried his best to get the delayed project on the move.
examples.zh: 新经理尽全力让延误的项目重新运转起来。

examples.en: We need extra workers to get the production line on the move after the breakdown.
examples.zh: 故障之后我们需要额外的工人让生产线重新运转。

exert a fascination on.usage: 表示对…产生吸引力，主语通常是具有魅力的事物

examples.en: Ancient cities exert a peculiar fascination on tourists from all over the world.
examples.zh: 古城对来自世界各地的游客有着独特的吸引力。

keep sth free from.usage: 表示使某物远离…、免受…的影响

examples.en: We should keep the laboratory free from dust and noise.
examples.zh: 我们应该让实验室远离灰尘和噪音。

muster up courage.usage: 固定搭配，意为鼓起勇气做某事，后面常接to do不定式

examples.en: She mustered up courage to give a speech in front of hundreds of people.
examples.zh: 她鼓起勇气在数百人面前发表演讲。

by chance.usage: 表示偶然、意外地，相当于accidentally，在句中作状语

examples.en: I met my former classmate by chance in the supermarket yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在超市偶然碰到了我以前的同学。

by chance.usage: 表示“偶然；碰巧；意外地”，在句中作状语，说明事件发生的随机性

examples.en: It is only by chance that such a fate is avoided.
examples.zh: 这种命运的逃脱完全是偶然的。

examples.en: I met my old classmate by chance on the street yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在街上偶然碰到了我的老同学。

by chance.unitTitle: The Past Life of the Earth

above all.usage: 插入语，意为最重要的是，用于强调后续内容的重要性

examples.en: To be a good nurse, you need to be careful, patient and above all, kind to patients.
examples.zh: 要成为一名好护士，你需要细心、有耐心，最重要的是要对病人友善。

above all.usage: 用于强调诸多因素中最重要的一点，通常放在句首或句中作插入语

examples.en: When you choose a career, above all, you should consider your interest and long-term development.
examples.zh: 当你选择职业时，最重要的是要考虑自己的兴趣和长期发展。

examples.en: The hotel offers perfect service, above all, its location is very convenient for tourists.
examples.zh: 这家酒店服务很棒，最重要的是，它的位置对游客来说十分便利。

be bent on.usage: 表示一心想要、决心要，后面接名词或动名词，常指下定决心做某事

examples.en: He is bent on winning the first prize in the national English competition.
examples.zh: 他一心想要在全国英语竞赛中获得一等奖。

be about to do sth when.phrase: be about to do sth when
be about to do sth when.usage: 表示正要做某事，这时突然发生另一件事，强调动作的突发性

examples.en: I was about to go out when the telephone rang.
examples.zh: 我正要出门，这时电话铃响了。

cannot be bothered to do sth.phrase: cannot be bothered to do sth
cannot be bothered to do sth.usage: 表示懒得做某事，不想费心做某事，是口语中常用的表达

examples.en: After a long day at work, I can't be bothered to cook dinner.
examples.zh: 工作了一整天之后，我懒得做晚饭了。

justice has been done.usage: 表示正义已经得到伸张或实现

examples.en: Justice has been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
examples.zh: 甚至在这个人移交给警察之前，正义就已经得到了伸张。

it serves him right.usage: 表示某人自食其果、活该倒霉

examples.en: The shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right'.
examples.zh: 店员们一定会觉得忍不住想说'他活该'。

examples.en: The manager promptly rang up the fire brigade.
examples.zh: 经理立刻给消防队打了电话。

ring up.usage: 指打电话，是口语中常见的表达

examples.en: She rang up her daughter and asked for help.
examples.zh: 她给女儿打电话请求帮助。

examples.en: He had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney.
examples.zh: 他试图在夜间闯入商店，但卡在了烟囱里。

examples.en: Justice had been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
examples.zh: 甚至在这个人移交给警察之前，正义就已经得到了伸张。

hand over.usage: /hænd ˈəʊvə/ verb phrase. 移交；交出（指把某人或某物交给另一个人或权威机构）

examples.en: We are, in part, admitting that a certain set of circumstances has enabled justice to act of its own accord.
examples.zh: 我们在某种程度上承认，某些环境因素使得正义能够自行发挥作用。

of ones own accord.usage: /ɒv wʌnz əʊn əˈkɔːd/ phrase. 出于自愿；自动地（指在没有外部压力的情况下自己去做某事）

beyond doubt.usage: 毫无疑问地；确定无疑地

examples.en: We might say that justice has been done when a man's innocence or guilt has been proved beyond doubt.
examples.zh: 当一个人的清白或罪行被毫无疑问地证实后，我们可以说正义得到了伸张。

examples.en: Those who seek it, undertake an arduous journey and can never be sure that they will find it.
examples.zh: 那些寻求正义的人，踏上了艰难的旅程，而且永远无法确定他们能否找到它。

examples.en: When a thief was caught on the premises of a large jewellery store one morning.
examples.zh: 一天早上，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店的场所内被抓时。

free someone by doing something.usage: 通过做某事使某人获救

examples.en: The fire fighters were eventually able to free him by cutting a huge hole in the wall.
examples.zh: 消防队员最终通过在墙上凿开一个大洞将他救了出来。

mete out.usage: /miːt aʊt/ verb phrase. 给予；实施（惩罚等）（指分配或给予奖惩）

examples.en: A novelist would bring his story to a conclusion by presenting coincidences.
examples.zh: 小说家会通过呈现一系列巧合来给故事收尾。

bring to a conclusion.usage: 使结束；得出结论，指完成某事或做出决定

examples.en: Only in this way can we bring the matter to a conclusion.
examples.zh: 只有这样我们才能结束这件事。

examples.en: Franz poured scorn on the idea.
examples.zh: 弗朗茨对这个想法嗤之以鼻。

examples.en: Mrs. Bussman was fully acquainted with this story.
examples.zh: 布斯曼太太对这件事非常了解。

a chance in a million.usage: 极小的可能性，万分之一的可能

examples.en: There was a chance in a million that she might be right.
examples.zh: 她可能是对的，这种可能性微乎其微。

examples.en: Hans explained how it was that he was still alive.
examples.zh: 汉斯解释了他是如何活下来的。

examples.en: Hans had made his way back into Western Germany on foot.
examples.zh: 汉斯步行回到了西德。

examples.en: He was thought to have been killed twenty years before.
examples.zh: 人们以为他二十年前就已经死了。

examples.en: Yet, in real life, circumstances do sometimes conspire to bring about coincidences.
examples.zh: 然而，在现实生活中，情况有时确实会凑巧带来巧合。

take advantage of.usage: 表示利用某种有利条件、机会或服务，中性用法

examples.en: You should take advantage of the free library resources to improve your English.
examples.zh: 你应该利用免费的图书馆资源来提升你的英语水平。

examples.en: Many tourists take advantage of the low season to travel at a lower cost.
examples.zh: 很多游客利用淡季以更低的成本出行。

dawn on sb.usage: 表示某人逐渐明白、突然意识到某个之前没注意到的事实，主语通常是it

examples.en: It dawned on me that I had left my keys at the office when I got home.
examples.zh: 我到家的时候才突然意识到我把钥匙落在办公室了。

examples.en: It finally dawned on him that all the suggestions his parents gave were for his own good.
examples.zh: 他终于明白父母给的所有建议都是为了他好。

in black and white.usage: 表示“以书面形式、白纸黑字”，强调内容有正式的文字记录，不容否认

examples.en: I want the terms of our agreement in black and white to avoid future disputes.
examples.zh: 我希望我们的协议条款白纸黑字写下来，避免未来产生纠纷。

examples.en: You can't deny you made the promise—it's here in black and white.
examples.zh: 你不能否认你许下过这个承诺——这里白纸黑字写着呢。

lodge a complaint.usage: 表示正式向相关方提出投诉，语气比较正式

examples.en: If the noise from the construction site continues, I will lodge a complaint with the property management.
examples.zh: 如果工地的噪音还继续，我就要向物业投诉了。

examples.en: Many customers lodged complaints against the restaurant for its poor hygiene conditions.
examples.zh: 很多顾客投诉这家餐厅卫生条件很差。

examples.en: If any further complaints are lodged against him, he will be prosecuted.
examples.zh: 如果再有人对他提出投诉，他将受到起诉。

strike sb as odd.usage: 表示某人觉得某事很奇怪、反常

examples.en: It strikes me as odd that he never mentions his family when we talk.
examples.zh: 我们聊天的时候他从来没提过他的家人，我觉得很奇怪。

examples.en: Her sudden change of attitude struck everyone as odd.
examples.zh: 她突然的态度转变让所有人都觉得反常。

cant help doing sth.usage: 表示忍不住、情不自禁做某事

examples.en: I can't help laughing every time I watch that comedy show.
examples.zh: 我每次看那个喜剧节目都忍不住笑。

examples.en: She couldn't help crying when she heard the bad news.
examples.zh: 她听到这个坏消息的时候忍不住哭了。

examples.en: Future historians will be in a unique position when they come to record the history of our own times.
examples.zh: 未来的历史学家在着手记录我们这个时代的历史时，将处于独特的地位。

examples.en: They will be able, as it were, to see and hear us in action.
examples.zh: 可以说，他们将能够看到和听到我们的一举一动。

as it were.usage: 插入语，用于表示所说的话不完全准确，是一种比喻或委婉的说法，可译为“可以说，在某种程度上”

examples.en: The new shopping centre is, as it were, the heart of the city.
examples.zh: 这个新的购物中心可以说是这座城市的心脏。

examples.en: He is, as it were, a walking dictionary in our class.
examples.zh: 他在我们班可以说是一本活字典。

examples.en: Even seemingly insignificant remains can shed interesting light on the history of early man.
examples.zh: 即使是看似不重要的遗迹也能揭示早期人类历史的有趣线索。

shed light on.usage: /ʃed laɪt ɒn/ phrase. 阐明；使...清楚（使某事更易理解或解释）

examples.en: It has long been known that the hunting scenes depicted on walls were not simply a form of artistic expression.
examples.zh: 人们早已知道，墙上描绘的狩猎场景不仅仅是艺术表现形式。

examples.en: They have found that it is connected with the passage of days and the phases of the moon.
examples.zh: 他们发现它与日月的推移和月相有关。

examples.en: For then man was faced with a real need to understand something about the seasons.
examples.zh: 因为那时人类确实需要了解季节的变化。

be faced with.usage: 表示“面临，面对”，主语通常为人或组织，后接困难、问题、挑战等名词作宾语

examples.en: They were expecting their sixth child and were faced with even more pressing economic problems.
examples.zh: 他们正等着第六个孩子出生，面临着更为严峻的经济问题。

examples.en: When you are faced with a difficult choice, try to stay calm and weigh all the options.
examples.zh: 当你面临艰难抉择时，尽量保持冷静，权衡所有选择。

be faced with.usage: 表示“面对；面临”，主语通常是人或组织，后接困难、问题等对象

examples.en: When faced with difficulties, we should try to find solutions instead of complaining.
examples.zh: 面对困难时，我们应该努力寻找解决方法，而不是抱怨。

examples.en: It seems that man was making a real effort to understand the seasons 20,000 years earlier than has been supposed.
examples.zh: 看来人类早在人们想象的2万年前就在努力了解季节的变化了。

in the least.usage: 用于否定句中，加强否定语气，表示“一点也不，丝毫没有”

examples.en: Even though the road was littered with boulders and pitted with holes, Bruce was not in the least perturbed.
examples.zh: 尽管路上满是大石头，坑坑洼洼，布鲁斯却一点也不慌。

examples.en: She was not in the least surprised by the bad news.
examples.zh: 她对这个坏消息一点也不感到惊讶。

give way to.usage: 表示“被…取代；让位于”，描述一种情况被另一种情况替代

examples.en: What a relief it was when the boulders suddenly disappeared, giving way to a stretch of plain where the only obstacles were clumps bushes.
examples.zh: 大石头突然消失了，取而代之的是一片平原，唯一的障碍是一簇簇灌木丛，这让我们松了一大口气。

examples.en: The storm gave way to bright sunshine the next morning.
examples.zh: 第二天早上，暴风雨过后阳光明媚。

go into low gear.usage: 原指车辆挂上低速挡，也可引申为“放慢节奏；低速运行”

examples.en: Bruce went into a low gear and drove at a terrifying speed.
examples.zh: 布鲁斯挂上低速挡，以惊人的速度行驶。

examples.en: When you climb a steep hill, you need to go into low gear.
examples.zh: 爬陡坡的时候，你需要挂低速挡。

come to a halt.usage: 表示“停止；停下来”，强调逐渐停止的过程，可加形容词修饰停止的状态

examples.en: Bruce charged at it, but in the middle, the car came to a grinding halt.
examples.zh: 布鲁斯冲着水潭开过去，可开到中间时，车嘎吱一声停住了。

examples.en: The project came to a halt due to lack of funding.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏资金，项目停了下来。

sooner or later.usage: 作时间状语，表示“迟早，总有一天”，强调某事最终必然会发生

examples.en: We felt sure that sooner or later a stone would rip a hole in our petrol tank or damage the engine.
examples.zh: 我们确信迟早会有石头把油箱砸个洞，或者把发动机弄坏。

examples.en: If you keep lying, people will find out sooner or later.
examples.zh: 如果你一直撒谎，大家迟早会发现的。

a trail of.usage: 表示“一串；一溜；痕迹”，描述人或物经过后留下的连续痕迹

examples.en: We kept looking back, wondering if we were leaving a trail of oil and petrol behind us.
examples.zh: 我们不停地往后看，想知道是不是在身后漏了一路油。

examples.en: The hurricane left a trail of destruction across the country.
examples.zh: 飓风在全国留下了满目疮痍。

charge at.usage: 表示“向…猛冲；冲向”，带有动作鲁莽、不顾后果的意味

examples.en: Bruce charged at it, but in the middle, the car came to a grinding halt.
examples.zh: 布鲁斯冲着水潭开过去，可开到中间时，车嘎吱一声停住了。

examples.en: The dog charged at the stranger when he walked into the yard.
examples.zh: 陌生人走进院子时，狗朝他冲了过去。

specialize in.usage: 表示专门从事、专攻某一领域或活动

examples.en: The company specializes in organic skincare products.
examples.zh: 这家公司专门生产有机护肤产品。

take sb seriously.usage: 表示认真对待某人、把某人的话当回事

examples.en: Don't take him seriously - he's always making silly jokes.
examples.zh: 别把他的话当真，他总爱开无聊的玩笑。

play jokes on sb.usage: 表示开某人的玩笑、捉弄某人

examples.en: The boys love to play jokes on their classmates on April Fool's Day.
examples.zh: 男孩子们喜欢在愚人节那天捉弄同学。

examples.en: The police were on the scene within five minutes of receiving the emergency call.
examples.zh: 警察接到紧急电话后五分钟内就赶到了现场。

by force.usage: 表示靠武力、用强制手段

examples.en: The security guards had to remove the troublemaker by force.
examples.zh: 保安不得不强行把闹事者带走。

examples.en: The suspect was under arrest for stealing cars.
examples.zh: 这名嫌疑人因盗窃车辆被逮捕。

examples.en: I need to make a telephone call to my parents to tell them I'll be home late.
examples.zh: 我得给我父母打个电话，告诉他们我会晚点儿回家。

go into raptures.usage: 表示极度兴奋或欣喜若狂

examples.en: They always go into raptures at the mere mention of the country.
examples.zh: 他们一提到乡村就会欣喜若狂。

be beyond me.usage: 表示无法理解或超出能力范围

examples.en: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day is beyond me.
examples.zh: 我无法理解为什么人们愿意每天忍受四个小时的旅程。

do without.usage: 表示没有某物也能应付，没有也行

examples.en: If you can do without the few pastoral pleasures of the country, you will find the city can provide you with the best.
examples.zh: 如果你能不要乡村的那点乐趣，你会发现城市能给你最好的生活。

examples.en: There is so much variety that you never have to make do with second best.
examples.zh: 品种繁多，你永远不必凑合用次品。

run wild.usage: 表示疯狂、放纵、胡乱购物

examples.en: Country people run wild when they go shopping in the city.
examples.zh: 乡下人进城购物时会疯狂采购。

draw to a close.usage: 表示接近尾声，即将结束

examples.en: As the play draws to its close, they wonder whether they will ever catch that last train home.
examples.zh: 当戏剧接近尾声时，他们担心能否赶得上最后一班回家的火车。

be tucked away.usage: 表示被藏起来，安置在某个地方

examples.en: The thousands that travel to work every day are tucked away in their homes in the country.
examples.zh: 每天成千上万进城工作的人都被藏在乡村的家中。

it has always been a mystery to me.phrase: It has always been a mystery to me
it has always been a mystery to me.usage: 表示对某人来说一直是个谜

examples.en: It has always been a mystery to me why city dwellers pretend they would prefer to live in the country.
examples.zh: 我一直不明白为什么城里人偏要假装喜欢住在乡下。

under the illusion.usage: 表示误以为，持有错误的观念

examples.en: Even he still lives under the illusion that country life is somehow superior to town life.
examples.zh: 甚至他仍然误以为乡村生活比城市生活优越。

for the dubious privilege of.usage: 表示为了某种不值得的特权/好处

examples.en: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country.
examples.zh: 为什么人们愿意每天忍受四小时的路程，就为了住乡下的那个并不值得的好处。

come to be known.usage: 表示逐渐被熟知、被称为，强调过程性而非突然成名

examples.en: Cave exploration, or pot-holing, as it has come to be known, is a relatively new sport.
examples.zh: 洞穴勘探，也就是人们现在常说的洞穴探险，是一项相对较新的运动。

examples.en: The small town has come to be known for its well-preserved ancient buildings.
examples.zh: 这个小镇现在已经因保存完好的古建筑而广为人知。

rig up.usage: 指临时或快速搭建、装配设备、结构等

examples.en: It can take as long as eight days to rig up rope ladders and to establish supply bases before a descent can be made into a very deep cave.
examples.zh: 在进入非常深的洞穴之前，可能需要长达8天的时间来搭建绳梯并建立补给基地。

examples.en: The hikers rigged up a simple shelter with branches and a plastic sheet when it started to rain.
examples.zh: 开始下雨时，徒步旅行者们用树枝和塑料布临时搭了一个简易庇护所。

edge ones way along.usage: 指小心翼翼地沿某条路径慢慢移动，强调动作的谨慎

examples.en: They had to edge their way along this, sometimes wading across shallow streams, or swimming across deep pools.
examples.zh: 他们不得不沿着这条狭窄的通道慢慢挪行，时而蹚过浅溪，时而游过深潭。

examples.en: We had to edge our way along the crowded platform to get to the train door.
examples.zh: 我们不得不沿着拥挤的站台慢慢挪到列车车门处。

plunge into.usage: 既可指纵身跳入水中，也可引申为突然投入、开始做某事

examples.en: They plunged into the lake, and after loading their gear on an inflatable rubber dinghy, let the current carry them to the other side.
examples.zh: 他们跳入湖中，把装备装上充气橡皮艇后，就让水流带着他们漂向对岸。

examples.en: After graduation, he plunged into his first job with great enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 毕业后，他满怀热情地投入了自己的第一份工作。

squeeze through.usage: 指用力挤过狭窄的空间，强调空间的狭小和通过的费力

examples.en: Squeezing through a cleft in the rocks, the pot-holers arrived at an enormous cavern, the size of a huge concert hall.
examples.zh: 探险者们挤过岩石的缝隙，来到了一个足有大型音乐厅那么大的巨大洞穴里。

examples.en: There was only a small gap in the fence, so we had to squeeze through it.
examples.zh: 围栏上只有一个小缺口，所以我们不得不挤过去。

arouse instincts.usage: 表示激发、唤起本能，属于常用的动宾搭配

examples.en: They arouse instincts which can only be dimly understood.
examples.zh: 它们激发了人们的本能，而这种本能只能被模糊地理解。

examples.en: The smell of cooking aroused the dog's hunting instincts immediately.
examples.zh: 烹饪的气味立刻唤起了这只狗的狩猎本能。

wash up.usage: 通常指水流将某物冲到岸边或某个地方，也可表示餐后清洗餐具

examples.en: At the far end of the lake, they came to huge piles of rubble which had been washed up by the water.
examples.zh: 在湖的尽头，他们看到了被水冲上来的大堆碎石。

examples.en: After the storm, a lot of driftwood was washed up on the beach.
examples.zh: 风暴过后，很多浮木被冲到了海滩上。

be willing to.usage: 愿意做某事，表示乐意或准备做某事

examples.en: Insurance companies are normally willing to insure anything.
examples.zh: 保险公司通常愿意为任何东西保险。

in the event of.usage: 如果；万一；倘若，用于引出假设的灾难情况

examples.en: It would be possible to insure yourself in the event of bad weather.
examples.zh: 如果遇到坏天气，你也可以为自己投保。

make a claim.usage: 提出索赔，向保险公司要求赔偿

examples.en: A shipping company has made a claim for the cost of salvaging.
examples.zh: 一家航运公司提出了打捞费用的索赔。

examples.en: A local authority to recover the cost of salvaging.
examples.zh: 地方当局为收回打捞费用。

examples.en: A powerful winch was put into operation.
examples.zh: 一台大功率绞车被启动运转。

examples.en: It was almost impossible to attach hawsers to the rim.
examples.zh: 几乎不可能把缆绳系在边缘上。

attach to.usage: 表示“把…固定在；把…附在…上”，常用被动形式be attached to，也可引申为“依恋；重视”

examples.en: Imagine a pen attached to the weight in such a way that its point rests upon a piece of paper on the floor.
examples.zh: 设想在重物上系一支笔，笔尖刚好落在地板上的一张纸上。

examples.en: Please attach your photo to the application form before submitting it.
examples.zh: 提交申请表之前请把你的照片贴在上面。

examples.en: By working at tremendous speed, the men got the dish on to dry land.
examples.zh: 由于以极快的速度工作，这些人把盘子弄到了陆地上。

examples.en: The men were now obliged to try once more.
examples.zh: 这些人现在不得不再次尝试。

take your mind off.usage: 转移注意力；使不再想某事

examples.en: Reading is only a partial solution, for the monotonous rhythm of the wheels clicking on the rails soon lull you to sleep.
examples.zh: 阅读只是部分解决办法，因为车轮撞击铁轨的单调节奏很快就会让你昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: He tried to take his mind off the problem by watching TV.
examples.zh: 他试图通过看电视来转移注意力，不再想那个问题。

come in snatches.usage: 断断续续地；时有时无地

examples.en: During the day, sleep comes in snatches.
examples.zh: 白天的时候，睡眠断断续续。

examples.en: We only got the information in snatches.
examples.zh: 我们只是断断续续地得到这些信息。

examples.en: By comparison, ferry trips or cruises offer a great variety of civilized comforts.
examples.zh: 相比之下，渡船旅行或游轮提供了多种多样的文明享受。

examples.en: By comparison, city life is more exciting.
examples.zh: 相比之下，城市生活更加精彩。

examples.en: You can stretch your legs on the spacious decks, play games, meet interesting people and enjoy good food.
examples.zh: 你可以在宽敞的甲板上伸展双腿、做游戏、结识有趣的人、享用美食。

examples.en: We've been driving for hours. Let's stop and stretch our legs.
examples.zh: 我们已经开了几个小时的车了，停下来活动一下吧。

examples.en: Aeroplanes have the reputation of being dangerous and even hardened travellers are intimidated by them.
examples.zh: 飞机有危险的名声，甚至老练的旅行者也对其感到畏惧。

examples.en: She has the reputation of being very reliable.
examples.zh: 她有非常可靠的名声。

examples.en: For a few hours, you settle back in a deep armchair to enjoy the flight.
examples.zh: 在几个小时内，你可以靠在扶手椅上享受飞行。

examples.en: Settle back and enjoy the show.
examples.zh: 坐好享受演出吧。

examples.en: The journey is so smooth that there is nothing to prevent you from reading or sleeping.
examples.zh: 旅途如此平稳，没有什么能阻止你阅读或睡觉。

examples.en: Nothing can prevent me from achieving my goals.
examples.zh: 没有什么能阻止我实现目标。

examples.en: but more often than not, the greater part of the journey is spent on roads with few service stations and too much traffic.
examples.zh: 但更多的时候，大部分旅程是在只有很少服务站和交通拥挤的道路上度过的。

examples.en: More often than not, she arrives late for meetings.
examples.zh: 她开会经常迟到。

examples.en: enjoy good food--always assuming, of course, that the sea is calm.
examples.zh: 享用美食——当然，前提是海面平静。

examples.en: I'll help you, always assuming that you need my assistance.
examples.zh: 我会帮你的，只要你需要我的帮助。

examples.en: An aeroplane gets you to your destination rapidly.
examples.zh: 飞机会快速把你送到目的地。

examples.en: The bus will get you to the station on time.
examples.zh: 公共汽车会把你准时送到车站。

act on.usage: 表示“根据……行事，按照……采取行动”，后接建议、观点、信息等名词作宾语

examples.en: Acting on the contention that facts are sacred, reporters can cause untold suffering to individuals.
examples.zh: 记者们遵从“事实至上”的观点，却可能给个人带来难以估量的痛苦。

examples.en: You should act on your teacher's advice if you want to improve your grades quickly.
examples.zh: 如果你想快速提高成绩，就应该按照老师的建议去做。

bring about.usage: 表示“导致，引起，使发生”，为及物短语动词，宾语通常为变化、问题、后果等名词

examples.en: Newspapers can not only bring about major changes to the lives of ordinary people but can even overthrow a government.
examples.zh: 报纸不仅能给普通人的生活带来重大改变，甚至能推翻一个政府。

examples.en: Technological advances have brought about great changes to the way we communicate.
examples.zh: 技术进步给我们的沟通方式带来了巨大的变化。

press for.usage: 表示“强烈要求，敦促”，后接要求得到的事物或行动作宾语，也可接press sb for sth表示“向某人索要某物/敦促某人做某事”

examples.en: Reporters kept pressing for interviews so lawyers had to be employed to act as spokesmen.
examples.zh: 记者们不断要求采访，所以这家人不得不聘请律师在新闻发布会上充当发言人。

examples.en: Environmental groups are pressing for stricter laws to reduce plastic waste.
examples.zh: 环保组织正在敦促出台更严格的法律来减少塑料垃圾。

pay the price for.usage: 表示“为……付出代价”，后接行为、事件等名词，强调因某件事而承受不好的后果

examples.en: While the five babies were still sleeping in oxygen tents, their parents were paying the price for fame.
examples.zh: 当五个婴儿还在医院育婴室的氧气帐里安睡时，他们的父母已经在为出名付出代价了。

examples.en: Many young people pay the price for staying up late frequently when they get older.
examples.zh: 很多年轻人年纪大了之后，会为经常熬夜付出代价。

pour in.usage: 表示“大量涌入，蜂拥而至”，主语通常为信件、礼物、信息等名词，强调数量多、速度快

examples.en: Gifts poured in not only from unknown people, but from baby food manufacturers as well.
examples.zh: 大量礼物涌来，不仅来自素不相识的人，还有婴儿食品制造商。

examples.en: After the star shared her donation story, messages of support poured in from all over the country.
examples.zh: 这位明星分享了她的捐赠故事后，支持的信息从全国各地蜂拥而至。

struggle against.usage: 表示“与……作斗争，努力克服”，后接困难、逆境、疾病等名词，强调对抗的过程很艰难

examples.en: They would have continued to struggle against economic odds and would have lived in obscurity.
examples.zh: 他们本会继续和经济困难作斗争，过着默默无闻的生活。

examples.en: The local people have been struggling against the flood for three days to protect their homes.
examples.zh: 当地民众已经和洪水抗争了三天，以保护他们的家园。

get round to.usage: 抽出时间做（一直想做的事）

examples.en: I've been meaning to fix the shelf, but I never got round to it.
examples.zh: 我一直想修那个架子，但始终抽不出时间做。

examples.en: Some fans go so far as to wait outside the hotel for hours just to see the star.
examples.zh: 一些粉丝甚至在酒店外等好几个小时，就为了看明星一眼。

examples.en: This restaurant caters for vegetarians with a special menu.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅有专门的菜单满足素食者的需求。

cater for.usage: 表示“满足需要，迎合”，主语通常为服务类机构，后接服务对象

examples.en: This restaurant caters for vegetarians.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅提供素食餐食，满足素食者的需求。

examples.en: He lives under the delusion that he can win the game without practice.
examples.zh: 他误以为不用练习就能赢得比赛。

examples.en: My mother would not hear of me walking home alone at night.
examples.zh: 我妈妈不同意我晚上独自走路回家。

examples.en: The floor was littered with toy bricks after the kids played.
examples.zh: 孩子们玩过之后，地板上散落着积木。

examples.en: Needless to say, the concert was canceled because of the bad weather.
examples.zh: 不用说，演唱会因为恶劣天气取消了。

when you come to think about it.phrase: when you come to think about it
when you come to think about it.usage: 固定表达，意思是'当你仔细想想'，用于引出思考后的结论

examples.en: When you come to think about it, there are only four ways to deal with rubbish.
examples.zh: 当你仔细想想，垃圾处理只有四种方式。

at any time of the day or night.phrase: at any time of the day or night
at any time of the day or night.usage: 固定短语，意思是'无论白天还是黑夜'，强调随时都可能发生

examples.en: Burglar alarms going off at any time of the day or night annoy passers-by.
examples.zh: 无论白天还是黑夜响起防盗警报都会惹恼路人。

make contribution to.usage: 动词短语，表示'对...做出贡献'，to为介词

examples.en: New technology has made its own contribution to noise.
examples.zh: 新技术也对噪音做出了'贡献'。

on a scale ranging fromto.usage: 固定表达，表示'在从...到...的范围内'，用于描述测量范围

examples.en: Noise pollution was rated on a scale ranging from 1 to 7.
examples.zh: 噪音污染按1到7的等级进行评分。

a steady diet of.usage: 短语，表示'长期大量的某物'，常指频繁接触某事物

examples.en: You may have a steady diet of pesticides every time you eat vegetables.
examples.zh: 每次吃蔬菜时你可能都在大量摄入农药。

keep doing something.usage: 动词短语，表示'继续做某事'，强调动作的持续性

examples.en: We keep trying all four methods, but the volume threatens to overwhelm us.
examples.zh: 我们不断尝试这四种方法，但垃圾量之大让我们难以应对。

it seems.usage: 固定表达，表示'似乎，看来'，用于表达推测

examples.en: Silence, it seems, has become a golden memory.
examples.zh: 看来，静谧已经成为了一段黄金记忆。

have the choice of.usage: 动词短语，表示'有...的选择'，后面接选择的内容

examples.en: You have the choice of very expensive organically-grown vegetables.
examples.zh: 你可以选择非常昂贵的有机蔬菜。

think youll abandon.usage: think + that从句的用法，表示'认为你会放弃'

examples.en: And if you think you'll abandon meat and become a vegetarian...
examples.zh: 如果你认为自己会放弃肉类成为素食者...

cut off from.usage: 表示“与……隔绝，切断与……的联系”，被动形式be cut off from更常用

examples.en: The small village is cut off from the outside world in winter due to heavy snow.
examples.zh: 冬天大雪封山，这个小村庄与外界隔绝了。

cut off from.usage: 意为“切断、隔绝与……的联系”，常用被动形式

examples.en: Alpine villages tended to be impoverished settlements cut off from civilization by the high mountains.
examples.zh: 阿尔卑斯山区的村庄大多是贫穷的村落，被高山隔绝了与文明世界的联系。

examples.en: The small town was cut off from the outside world due to the heavy snow.
examples.zh: 由于大雪，这个小镇和外界失去了联系。

in the vicinity.usage: 表示“在附近，在邻近地区”，后可接of+具体地点说明范围

examples.en: There are several famous scenic spots in the vicinity of the hotel.
examples.zh: 酒店附近有好几处著名景点。

descend on.usage: 指“（大量人）突然到访，涌入”，带有出人意料、给当地带来压力的含义

examples.en: Every summer, crowds of tourists descend on this coastal town.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，大批游客涌入这个海滨小镇。

have no idea.usage: 口语常用表达，意思是“不知道，不清楚”，后可接疑问词引导的从句

examples.en: I have no idea when he will come back from his business trip.
examples.zh: 我不知道他什么时候出差回来。

fast asleep.usage: 表示“睡得很熟，酣睡”，是固定搭配，fast此处为副词，修饰asleep

examples.en: When I got home last night, my kids were already fast asleep in bed.
examples.zh: 我昨晚到家的时候，孩子们已经在床上睡得很熟了。

be shy of.usage: 表示“害怕……，对……感到腼腆/迟疑”，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Many children are shy of speaking in front of a large audience.
examples.zh: 很多孩子都不好意思在很多人面前讲话。

come to life.usage: 表示“苏醒过来，恢复生机，变得活跃”，可用于描述人、地方或场景

examples.en: The quiet park comes to life at dawn when elderly people come to do exercise.
examples.zh: 清晨老人们来锻炼的时候，安静的公园就变得热闹起来。

examples.en: She would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic.
examples.zh: 她将无法就她最喜欢的话题发表意见。

examples.en: She was sentimentally attached to this house.
examples.zh: 她对这座房子怀有深厚的感情。

examples.en: She always referred to them as 'the shifting population'.
examples.zh: 她总称他们为'流动的人口'。

examples.en: They came and went with such frequency.
examples.zh: 他们来来去去非常频繁。

to the end of her days.phrase: to the end of her days

examples.en: She carried on an unrelenting search to the end of her days.
examples.zh: 她至死都在不懈地寻找理想的仆人。

examples.en: She was put in charge of the domestic staff.
examples.zh: 她被安排负责管理家务人员。

examples.en: The pudding narrowly missed my aunt.
examples.zh: 布丁险些砸到我的姑妈。

examples.en: Aunt Harriet was reluctantly came to the conclusion that Bessie was drunk.
examples.zh: 姑妈哈丽雅特不得不得出结论：贝齐喝醉了。

examples.en: The guests had a difficult time trying to conceal their amusement.
examples.zh: 客人们费了好大劲才忍住没笑出来。

examples.en: The same old favourites recur year in year out with monotonous regularity.
examples.zh: 同样的喜好年复一年地以单调的规律性重复出现。

examples.en: Do a thousand and one jobs about the house.
examples.zh: 做无数的家务事。

examples.en: We never have time to carry them out.
examples.zh: 我们从没有时间去实现它们。

examples.en: When we slip back into our bad old ways.
examples.zh: 当我们重新回到坏习惯时。

examples.en: I applied myself assiduously to the task.
examples.zh: 我勤奋地致力于这项任务。

creep down.usage: 悄悄溜下；蹑手蹑脚地走下

examples.en: I managed to creep down into the living room.
examples.zh: 我设法悄悄溜进客厅。

examples.en: I fended off the taunts and jibes of the family.
examples.zh: 我挡开了家人的嘲笑和讽刺。

examples.en: Little by little the eleven minutes fell to zero.
examples.zh: 渐渐地，十一分钟降到了零。

examples.en: I soon got back to my old bad habit of dozing off in front of the screen.
examples.zh: 我很快又回到了在屏幕前打瞌睡的坏习惯。

keep something to oneself.usage: 对某事保密；不告诉别人

examples.en: This year I attempted to keep my resolutions to myself.
examples.zh: 今年我试图对自己的决心保密。

as long ago as.usage: 早在...（用于强调时间久远）

examples.en: As long ago as the 1960s, Leon Bagrit predicted these uses.
examples.zh: 早在20世纪60年代，莱昂·巴格瑞特就预测到了这些用途。

examples.en: It pointed the way to the future.
examples.zh: 它指明了未来的方向。

examples.en: Many of their functions have been taken over by small personal computers.
examples.zh: 许多功能已被小型个人电脑所取代。

examples.en: They would be capable of providing information about traffic jams.
examples.zh: 它们将能够提供有关交通拥堵的信息。

examples.en: A planet would have to be a very long way from it to be capable of supporting life.
examples.zh: 行星必须离它很远才能维持生命。

be capable of.usage: 固定搭配，表示“有能力做……；能够做出……”，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Elephants are capable of a considerable degree of personal affection.
examples.zh: 大象能产生相当深厚的个人感情。

examples.en: This new device is capable of detecting even tiny leaks in the pipe.
examples.zh: 这个新设备甚至能检测到管道里极其微小的泄漏。

relieve someone of something.usage: 解除某人的...；使某人从...中解脱

examples.en: They would relieve office workers of dull, repetitive clerical work.
examples.zh: 它们将把办公室工作人员从枯燥重复的文书工作中解放出来。

nor could he have foreseen.usage: 他也无法预见（用于否定句后加强语气）

examples.en: Nor could he have foreseen the development of the Internet.
examples.zh: 他也不可能预见互联网的发展。

examples.en: Computers linked to telephone networks.
examples.zh: 与电话网络相连的计算机。

examples.en: Computers have become more and more powerful.
examples.zh: 计算机变得越来越强大。

it is even more remarkable that.phrase: it is even more remarkable that

examples.en: It is even more remarkable that an Englishman could predict these uses.
examples.zh: 更值得注意的是一个英国人能够预测这些用途。

examples.en: Bagrit dismissed the idea that computers would learn to 'think' for themselves.
examples.zh: 巴格瑞特摒弃了计算机会学会'独立思考'的观念。

examples.en: He keeps a large bottle on permanent display in his study.
examples.zh: 他在书房里永久陈列着一个大瓶子。

examples.en: Despite the fact that the bottle is tinted green, an observant visitor would notice it's filled with greyish substance.
examples.zh: 尽管瓶子被染成绿色，敏锐的来访者会注意到里面装的是灰色物质。

examples.en: When Harry put on his act of being mildly annoyed, the assistant promised to order some for him.
examples.zh: 当哈利装出有点烦恼的样子时，店员答应为他订购一些。

examples.en: He beat a hasty retreat, clutching the precious bottle under his arm.
examples.zh: 他匆忙撤退，腋下夹着那个珍贵的瓶子。

examples.en: He is fond of relating this interesting story.
examples.zh: 他喜欢讲述这个有趣的故事。

examples.en: He would invent fanciful names on the spot.
examples.zh: 他会当场编造一些稀奇古怪的名字。

examples.en: None of them met with Harry's requirements.
examples.zh: 没有一个能满足哈利的要求。

examples.en: How Harry came into the possession of this outlandish stuff makes an interesting story.
examples.zh: 哈利是如何得到这种稀奇古怪的东西的，这本身就是一个有趣的故事。

in the public interest.usage: 为了公共利益；符合公众利益

examples.en: The minister acted in the public interest.
examples.zh: 部长为了公共利益行事。

evolve an excellent system.usage: 逐步形成一套优秀的体制

examples.en: Sweden has evolved an excellent system for protecting citizens.
examples.zh: 瑞典逐步形成了一套优秀的保护公民的体制。

examples.en: The system protects the individual citizen from incompetent officials.
examples.zh: 该体制保护个人公民免受不称职官员的侵害。

safeguard the interest of.usage: 保护...的利益；维护...的利益

examples.en: The scheme was introduced to safeguard the interest of the individual.
examples.zh: 该方案的出台是为了保护个人的利益。

examples.en: The Ombudsman is not subject to political pressure.
examples.zh: 巡视官不受政治压力的影响。

be subject to.usage: 表示“受…支配；易遭受…；取决于…”，to为介词，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: From both maturity to death, a wave is subject to the same laws as any other 'living' thing.
examples.zh: 从成熟到消亡，波浪和其他任何“有生命”的事物一样，都受相同的规律支配。

examples.en: All flights are subject to delay due to the bad weather.
examples.zh: 受恶劣天气影响，所有航班都有可能延误。

act on ones behalf.usage: 代表某人采取行动；代理

examples.en: If a citizen's complaint is justified, the Ombudsman will act on his behalf.
examples.zh: 如果公民的投诉是合理的，巡视官将代表他采取行动。

examples.en: The Ombudsman's prompt action put an end to an unpleasant practice.
examples.zh: 巡视官的迅速行动结束了一种不良做法。

examples.en: A policeman had dealt roughly with foreigners on several occasions.
examples.zh: 一名警察多次粗暴对待外国人。

be open to public inspection.usage: 公开接受公众检查；可供公众查阅

examples.en: There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work, for his correspondence is open to public inspection.
examples.zh: 巡视官的工作没有任何秘密，因为他的信函可供公众查阅。

examples.en: We regard them as unnecessary creatures that do more harm than good.
examples.zh: 我们认为它们是无用的生物，弊大于利。

examples.en: We continually wage war on them, for they contaminate our food.
examples.zh: 我们不断地对它们发动战争，因为它们污染我们的食物。

examples.en: They sting or bite without provocation.
examples.zh: 它们无缘无故地蜇人或咬人。

examples.en: Knowing that the industrious ant lives in a highly organized society does nothing to prevent us from being filled with revulsion.
examples.zh: 尽管知道勤劳的蚂蚁生活在高度组织化的社会中，这并不能阻止我们对它们产生厌恶感。

examples.en: Who has not stood in awe at the sight of a spider pouncing on a fly?
examples.zh: 看到蜘蛛扑向苍蝇时，谁没有敬畏地驻足观看？

examples.en: I immediately embarked on an experiment.
examples.zh: 我立刻着手进行一项实验。

examples.en: I got up early next morning hoping to find that the ants had given up in despair.
examples.zh: 第二天一大早我起床，希望发现蚂蚁已经绝望地放弃了。

examples.en: Instead, I saw that they had discovered a new route.
examples.zh: 然而，我发现它们已经找到了一条新的路线。

examples.en: The ants had been quick to find an answer to my thoroughly unscientific methods!
examples.zh: 蚂蚁很快就找到了对付我完全不科学的方法的答案！

examples.en: In relative terms, planets are very small and do not emit light.
examples.zh: 相对而言，行星非常小且不发光。

examples.en: In the first instance, we would be looking for plant life, rather than 'little green men'.
examples.zh: 首先，我们会寻找植物生命，而不是小绿人。

rather than.usage: 连词短语，表示“而不是”，用于连接两个并列成分，否定后者

examples.en: I prefer to go for a walk rather than stay at home on weekends.
examples.zh: 周末我宁愿去散步也不愿待在家里。

examples.en: But this hope is always in the realms of science fiction.
examples.zh: 但这种希望总是在科幻小说的领域里。

examples.en: We would have to find a way of blotting out the light from its star.
examples.zh: 我们必须找到一种方法遮住它恒星的光。

examples.en: In the first instance, we would be looking for plant life.
examples.zh: 首先，我们会寻找植物生命。

examples.en: Venus is far too hot and Mars is far too cold to support life.
examples.zh: 金星太热而火星太冷，都无法维持生命。

take for to do.phrase: take + 时间 + for + 事物 + to do

examples.en: It has taken more than four billion years for plant and animal life to evolve.
examples.zh: 动植物生命进化花了四十多亿年。

examples.en: It is bacteria that have generated the oxygen we breathe on earth.
examples.zh: 正是细菌产生了我们呼吸的氧气。

examples.en: The river has always played an important part in our lives.
examples.zh: 这条河在我们的生活中一直扮演着重要的角色。

examples.en: Without it we could not make a living.
examples.zh: 没有它，我们无法谋生。

examples.en: We took turns in watching that point.
examples.zh: 我们轮流监视那个地点。

examples.en: The men waded down with boat hooks in the hope of being able to grapple a corner of the raft.
examples.zh: 男人们涉水走下去，带着船钩，希望能够抓住木筏的一角。

examples.en: The floods had put the telephone out of order.
examples.zh: 洪水使电话出了故障。

examples.en: Flooding can sometimes spell disaster for their owners.
examples.zh: 洪水有时会给农场主带来灾难。

examples.en: At the most critical juncture we took turns in watching that point.
examples.zh: 在最关键的时刻，我们轮流监视那个地点。

examples.en: A raft appeared, looking rather like Noah's ark.
examples.zh: 一个木筏出现了，看起来有点像诺亚方舟。

examples.en: We stood to lose little.
examples.zh: 我们损失不大。

examples.en: The lower fields make up a very small proportion of our farm.
examples.zh: 地势较低的田地只占我们农场的一小部分。

examples.en: I stopped to let the car cool off.
examples.zh: 我停下来让汽车冷却下来。

examples.en: He became absorbed in making a new life for the two of us.
examples.zh: 他全神贯注地为我们俩创造新生活。

examples.en: I lacked for nothing, for he was both father and mother to me.
examples.zh: 我什么都不缺，因为他既当父亲又当母亲。

examples.en: I decided that I must have taken a wrong turning somewhere.
examples.zh: 我认定我一定是某个地方拐错弯了。

examples.en: The spire of the church of our village showing in the far distance.
examples.zh: 我们村庄教堂的尖顶在远处显现出来。

examples.en: He always meant to go back one day, but not to stay.
examples.zh: 他一直打算有一天回去，但不是为了留下来。

examples.en: He made me promise to go on my own.
examples.zh: 他让我答应独自去。

examples.en: As I was wondering what to do next, a man appeared.
examples.zh: 正当我在想下一步该怎么办时，一个人出现了。

examples.en: This time he pointed to the lake.
examples.zh: 这次他指向了那个湖。

a spot of bother.usage: 表示小麻烦、小纠纷，是英语中常用的委婉表达

examples.en: She described it as a little spot of bother.
examples.zh: 她把这描述为一点小麻烦。

force an entry.usage: 指通过武力或强行手段进入某处

examples.en: Burglars had forced an entry during her absence.
examples.zh: 窃贼趁她不在时强行闯入了。

at her age.usage: 表示在某人这个年纪，常用于表达某种行为是否适合某人的年龄

examples.en: At her age, it might be more prudent to have someone with her.
examples.zh: 在她这个年纪，有人陪着可能更明智。

turn over.usage: 指把东西翻过来或翻遍

examples.en: Everything she possessed had been tossed out and turned over.
examples.zh: 她的所有东西都被扔了出来，翻了个遍。

examples.en: She regained her composure and was ready to search.
examples.zh: 她恢复了镇定，准备开始搜查。

be not the first job.usage: 表示不是第一次做某事，暗示之前有过类似经历

examples.en: Their entry into this flat was apparently not the burglars' first job that day.
examples.zh: 他们进入这间公寓显然不是当天第一次作案。

examples.en: The old lady was glad to be back at the block of flats.
examples.zh: 老太太很高兴回到她住的公寓。

examples.en: Her basket had grown heavier with every step.
examples.zh: 她的篮子每走一步就重一些。

as clear as daylight.usage: 比喻某事非常清楚、显而易见

examples.en: It was as clear as daylight that burglars had forced an entry.
examples.zh: 显而易见，窃贼强行闯入了。

examples.en: People tend to amass possessions, sometimes without being aware of doing so.
examples.zh: 人们往往会积聚财产，有时甚至没有意识到自己在这样做。

examples.en: Both physical and mental energy are essential in turning out and throwing away.
examples.zh: 体力和脑力对于清理和扔掉东西都是必不可少的。

examples.en: I know someone who always cuts sketches out from newspapers.
examples.zh: 我认识一个人，她总是从报纸上剪下时装图样。

examples.en: It is a harmless habit, but it litters up her desk to such an extent.
examples.zh: 这是个无害的习惯，但它把她的桌子弄得乱七八糟。

examples.en: There is always something to do in connection with it.
examples.zh: 与此相关的总有事情可做。

examples.en: This hobby educates one not only in the chosen subject, but also in general matters which have some bearing on it.
examples.zh: 这种爱好不仅使人对自己选择的主题有所了解，而且还能使人了解与之相关的一般性知识。

examples.en: One wants to meet like-minded collectors, to get advice, to compare notes.
examples.zh: 人们想遇到志趣相投的收藏家，获取建议，交流心得。

examples.en: One wants to meet like-minded collectors, to compare notes, to exchange articles, to show off the latest find.
examples.zh: 人们想遇到志趣相投的收藏家，交流心得，交换物品，展示最新发现。

examples.en: Perhaps a trip abroad in search of a rare specimen.
examples.zh: 或许还会出国寻找珍稀标本。

in a state of chaos.usage: 处于混乱状态，形容无秩序、混乱的局面

examples.en: Without rules, everything would be in a state of chaos.
examples.zh: 没有规则，一切都会陷入混乱。

cut things fine.usage: 把时间扣得很紧，指在最后时刻才完成任务或到达

examples.en: He always cuts things fine when catching trains.
examples.zh: 他赶火车时总是把时间扣得很紧。

impress upon.usage: 使深刻印象；叮嘱，强调某事的重要性让某人记住

examples.en: Her parents impressed upon her that punctuality was important.
examples.zh: 她的父母让她深刻记住准时的重要性。

slip into.usage: 溜进；悄悄进入，指不引人注意地进入某处

examples.en: She tried to slip into the train before it left.
examples.zh: 她试图在火车开走前溜进去。

to her horror.usage: 使她恐惧的是，用于引出令人害怕或震惊的情况

examples.en: To her horror, the train had already left.
examples.zh: 使她恐惧的是，火车已经开走了。

as muchas.usage: 和...一样（用于比较），强调两者在某方面程度相同

examples.en: The over-punctual can be as much a trial as the unpunctual.
examples.zh: 过于准时的人和不准时的人一样让人头疼。

be unforgivable.usage: 不可原谅的，指错误严重到无法被原谅

examples.en: It would be unforgivable to miss the train.
examples.zh: 错过这班火车将是不可原谅的。

hand down.usage: 动词短语，指将传统、故事、财产等代代传承，常用被动语态be handed down

examples.en: These traditional crafts are handed down from generation to generation in this village.
examples.zh: 这些传统手工艺在这个村子里代代相传。

hand down.usage: 表示“把……世代相传，传承”，常用于传统、习俗、财产、故事等从一代人传到下一代人

examples.en: These craftsmanship skills have been handed down from generation to generation in the local area.
examples.zh: 这些工艺技能在当地代代相传。

examples.en: The necklace was handed down to her by her grandmother.
examples.zh: 这条项链是她奶奶传给她的。

read of.usage: 固定搭配，指读到、获悉某类信息，相当于read about

examples.en: I read of his outstanding contributions to medical research in the newspaper.
examples.zh: 我在报纸上读到了他在医学研究方面做出的杰出贡献。

from generation to generation.usage: 副词短语，在句中作状语，表示一代接一代地

examples.en: The custom of eating mooncakes on Mid-Autumn Festival has been kept from generation to generation.
examples.zh: 中秋节吃月饼的习俗被一代又一代地保留了下来。

rot away.usage: 动词短语，指完全腐烂、烂掉，强调腐烂的最终结果

examples.en: The fallen leaves on the ground will rot away and become nutrients for the soil.
examples.zh: 地上的落叶会腐烂掉，变成土壤的养分。

without trace.usage: 副词短语，在句中作状语，表示毫无踪迹、无影无踪

examples.en: The plane crashed into the mountain and disappeared without trace.
examples.zh: 飞机撞上山后就消失得无影无踪了。

even now.usage: 副词短语，表强调，意为“即使到现在，即便在如今”

examples.en: Even now, many people in remote mountain areas still have no access to the Internet.
examples.zh: 即使到现在，很多偏远山区的人们依然无法使用互联网。

long ago.usage: 副词短语，指很久以前，常用于一般过去时的句子中

examples.en: Long ago, there lived a kind old man in this small town.
