examples.zh: 很久以前，这个小镇上住着一位善良的老人。

owe sth to sbsth.usage: 表示“把…归功于；欠…某物”，用于说明功劳、成果的来源

examples.en: We owe a lot to the birds and beasts who eat insects.
examples.zh: 我们十分感激那些捕食昆虫的鸟类和兽类。

examples.en: I owe my success to my family's support.
examples.zh: 我把我的成功归功于家人的支持。

do harm to.usage: 表示“对…造成伤害/损害”，harm前可加little/any/the least等修饰词

examples.en: Spiders never do the least harm to us or our belongings.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛从不对我们或我们的财物造成丝毫损害。

examples.en: Smoking does great harm to people's lungs.
examples.zh: 吸烟对人的肺部有很大伤害。

at a glance.usage: 表示“一眼；一看就”，强调识别、判断的速度非常快

examples.en: One can tell the difference almost at a glance.
examples.zh: 人们几乎一眼就能看出两者的区别。

examples.en: He recognized his old friend at a glance in the crowd.
examples.zh: 他在人群里一眼就认出了自己的老朋友。

be engaged in.usage: 表示“忙于；从事于”，侧重指正在参与或忙于某项长期固定的活动

examples.en: How many spiders are engaged in this work on our behalf?
examples.zh: 有多少蜘蛛在为我们做这项工作呢？

examples.en: He has been engaged in environmental protection for 10 years.
examples.zh: 他从事环保工作已经10年了。

on sbs behalf.usage: 表示“代表某人；为了某人的利益”，也可写作on behalf of sb

examples.en: Lawyers can make statements on their clients' behalf.
examples.zh: 律师可以代表客户发表声明。

the morethe more.usage: 用于表示两个事物按比例同步变化，意为“越……就越……”

examples.en: The more difficult it is, the more highly it is regarded.
examples.zh: 路线越难，就越被人们看重。

examples.en: The more you practice, the more fluent your English will be.
examples.zh: 你练习得越多，英语就会越流利。

in the pioneering days.usage: 指某个领域的初创、探索阶段，意为“在开创初期”

examples.en: In the pioneering days however, this was not the case at all.
examples.zh: 然而在登山运动的初创时期，情况完全不是这样。

examples.en: In the pioneering days of the Internet, few people could imagine its popularity today.
examples.zh: 在互联网发展初期，很少有人能想象到它如今的普及程度。

go out of ones way to do sth.phrase: go out of one's way to do sth
go out of ones way to do sth.usage: 意为“特地、格外努力做某事；刻意做某事”

examples.en: They did not go out of their way to court such excitement.
examples.zh: 他们并不是刻意追求这种刺激。

examples.en: The host went out of his way to make every guest feel at home.
examples.zh: 主人费尽心思让每位客人都感觉自在。

wash down.usage: 意为“（就着饮料）把食物送下；冲洗”

examples.en: All washed down with coarse wine.
examples.zh: 所有食物都得就着粗劣的葡萄酒咽下。

examples.en: You need some water to wash down the medicine.
examples.zh: 你需要点水来把药送服下去。

accustomed to.usage: 意为“习惯于……”，to是介词，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: For men accustomed to eating seven-course dinners and sleeping between fine linen sheets at home.
examples.zh: 对于那些习惯了在家吃七道菜的正餐、睡细亚麻床单的人来说。

examples.en: She is accustomed to jogging for half an hour every morning.
examples.zh: 她习惯了每天早上慢跑半小时。

accustomed to.usage: 表示习惯于某事物，to为介词，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Men accustomed to struggling for survival against the elements and Indians were bewildered by politicians.
examples.zh: 那些习惯了与自然和印第安人搏斗求生的人被政客们搞得晕头转向。

examples.en: She is accustomed to working late and getting up early the next day.
examples.zh: 她习惯了熬夜工作，第二天又早起。

accustomed to.unitTitle: William S. Hart and the Early Western Film

second sight.usage: 固定表达，指预见未来的能力，或文中提到的“第二视觉”（不用眼睛看就能感知事物的能力）

examples.en: Some people believe that certain psychics have second sight.
examples.zh: 一些人相信某些灵媒有预知能力。

concern sbsth.usage: 表示“与……相关；涉及”，常用于介绍某个事件、情况的对象

examples.en: The report concerns the problem of air pollution in cities.
examples.zh: 这份报告涉及城市空气污染的问题。

happen to do sth.usage: 表示“碰巧做某事；偶然发生某事”，强调偶然性

examples.en: I happened to meet my former teacher in the supermarket yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在超市碰巧遇到了我以前的老师。

do up.usage: 此处表示“捆；包；整理”，还可表示“扣上；修缮”

examples.en: Please do up these books and send them to the rural school.
examples.zh: 请把这些书捆好，寄给那所乡村学校。

bring sth to the notice of sb.phrase: bring sth to the notice of sb
bring sth to the notice of sb.usage: 表示“使某人注意到某事”，是被动语态常用结构

examples.en: The student's excellent performance brought him to the notice of the professor.
examples.zh: 这个学生的出色表现让教授注意到了他。

a series of.usage: 表示“一系列；一连串”，后接可数名词复数

examples.en: The school will hold a series of activities to celebrate its 100th anniversary.
examples.zh: 学校将举办一系列活动来庆祝建校100周年。

a series of.usage: 表示“一系列；一连串”，后接可数名词复数，整体作主语时谓语动词用单数

examples.en: The school has launched a series of activities to promote traditional culture.
examples.zh: 学校推出了一系列活动来推广传统文化。

the moment that.usage: 引导时间状语从句，表示“一……就……”，相当于as soon as

examples.en: The moment I got home, it began to rain heavily.
examples.zh: 我一到家，就开始下大雨了。

take leave to do sth.usage: 正式用语，用于礼貌地表示自己要做可能稍显冒昧的事，可译为“冒昧做某事，擅自做某事”

examples.en: If there is one -- which I take leave to doubt -- then it is older people who create it, not the young themselves.
examples.zh: 如果确有这样一个问题的话——恕我对此表示怀疑——那也是老年人而非年轻人自己造成的。

examples.en: I take leave to disagree with your view on this project.
examples.zh: 请恕我冒昧，我不赞同你对这个项目的看法。

get down to fundamentals.usage: 表示开始探讨最核心、最根本的问题，get down to 意为“开始认真处理，着手做”

examples.en: Let us get down to fundamentals and agree that the young are after all human beings -- people just like their elders.
examples.zh: 让我们来认真探讨一下根本问题，先承认年轻人毕竟也是人——和他们的长辈一样的人。

examples.en: Instead of arguing about trivial details, we should get down to fundamentals of the plan.
examples.zh: 我们与其争论无关紧要的细节，不如好好探讨这个计划的根本问题。

after all.usage: 常用于提醒对方某个容易被忽略的重要事实或理由，可译为“毕竟，终究”

examples.en: Let us get down to fundamentals and agree that the young are after all human beings -- people just like their elders.
examples.zh: 让我们来认真探讨一下根本问题，先承认年轻人毕竟也是人——和他们的长辈一样的人。

examples.en: You shouldn't scold him too much; after all, he is only a child.
examples.zh: 你别太责怪他了，毕竟他还只是个孩子。

after all.usage: 表示“毕竟；终究”，用于引出解释或说明理由，放在句首或句中

examples.en: After all, all living creatures live by feeding on something else, whether it be plant or animal, dead or alive.
examples.zh: 毕竟，所有生物都靠吃其他东西生存，不管是植物还是动物，死的还是活的。

examples.en: You shouldn't scold him too much; after all, he is only a child.
examples.zh: 你不该太责备他，毕竟他只是个孩子。

after all.unitTitle: The Past Life of the Earth

be engaged in doing sth.usage: 表示忙于做某事、参与某事，是正式表达

examples.en: For one thing, being a problem gives you a certain identity, and that is one of the things the young are busily engaged in seeking.
examples.zh: 首先，成为问题能给你一种特定的身份，而这正是年轻人忙着追求的东西之一。

examples.en: The researchers are engaged in studying the effect of climate change on local ecosystems.
examples.zh: 研究人员正忙于研究气候变化对当地生态系统的影响。

an air of.usage: 用于描述人或事物带有某种气质、氛围，air在此处意为“神态，气质，氛围”

examples.en: They have an air of freedom, and they have not a dreary commitment to mean ambitions or love of comfort.
examples.zh: 他们有一种自由的气质，不会乏味地投身于卑俗的野心或对安逸的追求中。

examples.en: There is an air of mystery around the old castle at the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 山顶上的那座古堡周围有一种神秘的氛围。

social climber.usage: 指试图通过结交上流社会人士来提高自身社会地位的人，含贬义，可译为“趋炎附势的人，想方设法跻身上流社会的人”

examples.en: They are not anxious social climbers, and they have no devotion to material things.
examples.zh: 他们不是急着往上爬的趋炎附势之徒，也不执着于物质事物。

examples.en: Everyone could tell that she was a social climber who only made friends with rich people.
examples.zh: 所有人都能看出来她是个趋炎附势的人，只和有钱人交朋友。

in contrast with.usage: 表示“与……形成对比，和……相比”，用于突出两者之间的差异

examples.en: It's as if they were in some sense cosmic beings in violent and lovely contrast with us suburban creatures.
examples.zh: 从某种意义上说，他们仿佛是宇宙的子民，与我们这些世俗庸人形成了强烈而美好的对比。

examples.en: In contrast with last year's cold winter, this winter is unusually warm.
examples.zh: 和去年寒冷的冬天相比，今年的冬天异常暖和。

turn to sbsth for sth.usage: 表示“向……求助以获得某物”，是常用的固定搭配

examples.en: He may be conceited, ill-mannered, presumptuous or fatuous, but I do not turn for protection to dreary cliches about respect for elders -- as if mere age were a reason for respect.
examples.zh: 他可能自负、无礼、放肆、愚蠢，但我不会用“要尊重长辈”这种陈腐的套话来为自己撑腰——好像仅凭年龄就值得尊重似的。

examples.en: When you meet difficulties in study, you can turn to your teacher for help.
examples.zh: 你在学习上遇到困难时，可以向老师求助。

if only.usage: 用来表示强烈的愿望或非真实的条件，常引导虚拟语气句子，意为“要是……就好了，只要”

examples.en: If only we could arrive there before the storm, we would be safe.
examples.zh: 要是我们能在暴风雨来临前赶到那里，我们就安全了。

examples.en: If only he had told me the truth earlier, I wouldn't have made such a mistake.
examples.zh: 要是他早一点告诉我真相，我就不会犯这样的错误了。

have no inclination to do sth.phrase: have no inclination to do sth.
have no inclination to do sth.usage: 表示“没有做某事的意愿，不想做某事”，表达主观上的不情愿

examples.en: After a whole day of work, I have no inclination to go to the party tonight.
examples.zh: 工作了一整天之后，我今晚不想去参加聚会。

examples.en: He has no inclination to follow others' advice without thinking.
examples.zh: 他不愿意不假思索就听从别人的建议。

do ones utmost to do sth.phrase: do one's utmost to do sth.
do ones utmost to do sth.usage: 固定搭配，表示“尽某人最大努力做某事”，和try one's best意思相近，语气更正式

examples.en: All the medical staff did their utmost to save the injured people in the accident.
examples.zh: 所有医护人员都尽了最大努力抢救事故中的伤者。

examples.en: We will do our utmost to finish the task before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我们会尽最大努力在截止日期前完成任务。

pick up sides.usage: 指在比赛中临时组队，随意选择队员分成两队，没有刻意的安排

examples.en: When we play basketball on weekends, we usually pick up sides randomly.
examples.zh: 我们周末打篮球的时候，通常都是随机组队的。

examples.en: The children picked up sides on the playground to have a football match.
examples.zh: 孩子们在操场上随便组队踢足球比赛。

at any rate.usage: 固定短语，意为“无论如何，至少”，用来对前面的说法进行补充说明或强调

examples.en: I'm not sure whether the plan will work, but at any rate we can have a try.
examples.zh: 我不确定这个计划是否可行，但无论如何我们可以试一试。

examples.en: At any rate, you should finish your homework before watching TV.
examples.zh: 至少你应该先写完作业再看电视。

work oneself into furies.usage: 表示“使自己勃然大怒，陷入愤怒的情绪中”，强调情绪上的失控

examples.en: He always works himself into furies over small things that don't matter at all.
examples.zh: 他总是因为一点无关紧要的小事就大发脾气。

examples.en: There is no need to work yourself into furies just because of his rude words.
examples.zh: 你没必要因为他的粗话就气得暴跳如雷。

turn to.usage: 表示“求助于，查阅，转向”，后可接人、书籍、某个领域等名词

examples.en: To get a full appreciation of what this means we must turn first to some recent human inventions.
examples.zh: 要充分理解这一点的含义，我们必须首先参考人类最近的一些发明。

examples.en: When you meet new words, you can turn to a dictionary.
examples.zh: 遇到生词时你可以查词典。

turn to.usage: 表示“转向，开始从事（新的工作、行业）”，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: He had turned to boat-building on the Norfolk Broads.
examples.zh: 他转而在诺福克湖区从事造船工作。

examples.en: After graduating from art school, she turned to fashion design.
examples.zh: 从艺术学校毕业后，她转而从事服装设计工作。

in the vicinity of.usage: 表示“在……附近，邻近”，为正式用语，后接地点名词

examples.en: If he shouts in the vicinity of a wall or a mountainside, an echo will come back.
examples.zh: 如果人在墙壁或山坡附近大喊，就会传来回声。

examples.en: There are three cafes in the vicinity of the campus.
examples.zh: 校园附近有三家咖啡馆。

reflect from.usage: 表示“从……反射回来”，主语多为声音、光线等，后接反射的载体

examples.en: A sound made by tapping on the hull of a ship will be reflected from the sea bottom.
examples.zh: 敲击船体发出的声音会从海底反射回来。

examples.en: Sunlight reflects from the surface of the lake. 阳光从湖面反射回来。
examples.zh: 阳光从湖面反射回来。

in general use.usage: 表示“普遍使用，通用”，描述某类设备、方法等被广泛应用的状态

examples.en: So was born the echo-sounding apparatus, now in general use in ships.
examples.zh: 回声探测仪就这样诞生了，如今在船舶上被普遍使用。

examples.en: Mobile payment is already in general use across the country.
examples.zh: 移动支付已经在全国范围内普遍使用。

vary according to.usage: 表示“根据……而变化”，主语为被影响的对象，后接影响因素

examples.en: Every solid object will reflect a sound, varying according to the size and nature of the object.
examples.zh: 所有固体都会反射声音，反射情况根据物体的大小和性质而不同。

examples.en: The price of the product varies according to the season.
examples.zh: 这款产品的价格随季节变化。

steer clear of.usage: 表示“避开，绕开”，既可指避开具体的障碍物，也可指避开抽象的人或麻烦

examples.en: They can locate and steer clear of obstacles.
examples.zh: 它们能够定位并避开障碍物。

examples.en: You should steer clear of that person; he is not reliable.
examples.zh: 你应该离那个人远点，他不可靠。

feed on.usage: 表示“以……为食”，主语为动物或生物，后接食物来源

examples.en: They can locate flying insects on which they feed.
examples.zh: 它们还能找到自己捕食的飞虫。

examples.en: Owls feed on small mammals such as mice.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰以老鼠之类的小型哺乳动物为食。

be compared with.usage: 表示“被与……相比”，用于同类事物的类比，主动形式为compare A with B

examples.en: This echo-location in bats is often compared with radar, the principle of which is similar.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠的这种回声定位常被拿来和雷达作比较，二者原理相似。

examples.en: The work of a teacher is often compared with that of a gardener.
examples.zh: 教师的工作常被比作园丁的工作。

put sand in the wheels of.phrase: put sand in the wheels of
put sand in the wheels of.usage: 非正式表达，比喻阻碍、阻挠某件事的顺利进行

examples.en: Strict visa rules put sand in the wheels of international academic exchanges.
examples.zh: 严格的签证规定阻碍了国际学术交流的顺利进行。

meet standards.usage: 表示达到、符合某一标准，中间可接修饰标准的形容词或名词

examples.en: All our products meet the national environmental protection standards.
examples.zh: 我们所有的产品都符合国家环保标准。

hit the market.usage: 指产品上市、进入市场销售，为非正式常用表达

examples.en: The new generation of smartphones will hit the market next month.
examples.zh: 新一代智能手机将于下月上市。

as it happens.usage: 用作插入语，表示“碰巧，恰恰，实际上”，用来引出与话题相关的真实情况

examples.en: As it happens, I have the very book you are looking for in my bag.
examples.zh: 真巧，我包里正好有你在找的那本书。

in principle.usage: 表示“原则上，大体上”，指在基本观点上同意，但细节尚未确定

examples.en: The board has approved the project in principle, but we still need to adjust the budget details.
examples.zh: 董事会原则上批准了这个项目，但我们还需要调整预算细节。

in time for.usage: 表示“及时赶上，刚好来得及”做某事，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: We hurried to the station and arrived just in time for the last train.
examples.zh: 我们匆忙赶到车站，刚好赶上最后一班火车。

be hardpressed to do sth.usage: 表示做某事有很大困难，很难做成某事

examples.en: You would be hard-pressed to find a better coffee shop than this one in the whole city.
examples.zh: 你很难在整个城市里找到比这家更好的咖啡店了。

hammer out.usage: 表示经过反复讨论、艰难谈判后最终制定出（方案、协议等）

examples.en: The two sides spent three days hammering out a compromise acceptable to everyone.
examples.zh: 双方花了三天时间反复磋商，最终制定出了所有人都能接受的妥协方案。

apply to.usage: 表示“适用于，应用于”，后接适用的对象或范围

examples.en: This school rule applies to all students, no matter what grade they are in.
examples.zh: 这条校规适用于所有学生，不管他们读几年级。

apply to.usage: 此处意为“适用于；针对”，主语为规则、情况等，宾语为适用的对象

examples.en: This regulation applies to all employees, regardless of position.
examples.zh: 这条规定适用于所有员工，不分职位高低。

examples.en: The discount only applies to products purchased before the end of the month.
examples.zh: 这个折扣仅适用于月底前购买的产品。

disguised as.usage: 表示“伪装成”，常用作伴随状语，说明主语的状态

examples.en: He disguised himself as a delivery man to get into the building.
examples.zh: 他伪装成快递员进入了那栋大楼。

security precautions.usage: 名词短语，意为“安全防范措施”，可搭配take/adopt等动词使用

examples.en: The airport has strengthened security precautions ahead of the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期来临前，机场加强了安全防范措施。

compared with.usage: 介词短语，意为“与……相比”，常用于句首或句中作比较状语

examples.en: Compared with last year, our sales have increased by 30% this year.
examples.zh: 和去年相比，我们今年的销售额增长了30%。

be fit for.usage: 表示“适合；能胜任”，后接名词或动名词，说明主语的适用性

examples.en: This key is not fit for the front door, you must have taken the wrong one.
examples.zh: 这把钥匙不适合前门，你肯定拿错了。

on the move.usage: 固定表达，意为“在行进中；在移动中；忙个不停”

examples.en: As a sales manager, she is always on the move, visiting different cities every week.
examples.zh: 作为销售经理，她总是忙个不停，每周都要去不同的城市。

thrive on.usage: 动词短语，表示“靠……蓬勃发展，因……而兴旺”，主语通常为企业、组织或人，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Many tech companies thrive on constant innovation.
examples.zh: 许多科技公司靠持续的创新蓬勃发展。

examples.en: He thrives on pressure and always performs best in challenging situations.
examples.zh: 他在压力下状态很好，总是在有挑战的环境中表现最佳。

back to the future.usage: 固定表达，字面意思为“回到未来”，常指事物的发展在新的条件下重现过去的模式或特点

examples.en: The popularity of vinyl records is like a back to the future moment for the music industry.
examples.zh: 黑胶唱片的流行对音乐行业来说就像是“回到未来”的时刻。

examples.en: The new policy takes us back to the future, reviving the small business support schemes from the 1990s.
examples.zh: 新政策让我们仿佛回到了未来，重启了上世纪90年代的小企业扶持计划。

much the way.usage: 连词短语，意为“就像……一样”，用于引导方式状语从句，类比两种相似的行为或情况

examples.en: You can adjust the settings of the software, much the way you customize your phone's home screen.
examples.zh: 你可以调整这个软件的设置，就像你定制手机主屏幕一样。

examples.en: The team works together to solve problems, much the way a family supports each other.
examples.zh: 这个团队协作解决问题，就像一家人互相支持一样。

in droves.usage: 副词短语，意为“成群结队地，大量地”，修饰动词，表示人或事物大规模地出现或行动

examples.en: Tourists come to this coastal city in droves every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天都有大量游客来到这座海滨城市。

examples.en: Residents left the earthquake-stricken area in droves to seek safer shelter.
examples.zh: 居民们成群结队地离开地震灾区，寻找更安全的避难所。

draw on.usage: 动词短语，意为“利用，凭借，依靠”，宾语通常为经验、知识、资源等抽象事物

examples.en: She drew on her childhood experiences to write the novel.
examples.zh: 她凭借自己的童年经历创作了这本小说。

examples.en: The project draws on the latest research in environmental science.
examples.zh: 这个项目利用了环境科学领域的最新研究成果。

pacific rim.usage: 专有名词短语，意为“环太平洋地区”，指环太平洋沿岸的所有国家和地区，常用于经济、贸易语境

examples.en: Trade between Pacific Rim countries has increased significantly over the past decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年间，环太平洋国家之间的贸易额大幅增长。

examples.en: This summit focuses on sustainable development issues in the Pacific Rim.
examples.zh: 本次峰会聚焦环太平洋地区的可持续发展问题。

lock on.usage: 名词短语，意为“垄断，牢牢控制”，常与介词on搭配，表示对某个市场、领域的绝对控制

examples.en: The company has a near lock on the global smartphone processor market.
examples.zh: 这家公司几乎垄断了全球智能手机处理器市场。

examples.en: Local businesses are trying to break the foreign brand's lock on the luxury goods market.
examples.zh: 本土企业正试图打破外国品牌对奢侈品市场的垄断。

be cheated of.usage: 表示“被剥夺了……，被骗走了……”，被动结构强调主体失去了本应获得的事物

examples.en: Many children in the poor area are cheated of the right to education.
examples.zh: 贫困地区的很多孩子被剥夺了受教育的权利。

bit by bit.usage: 副词短语，意为“逐渐地，一点一点地”，等同于gradually，可放在句首或句中修饰动作

examples.en: Bit by bit, he learned how to communicate with others properly.
examples.zh: 他逐渐学会了如何恰当地和他人沟通。

be merged in.usage: 表示“融入……，和……融为一体”，也可写作be merged into，强调个体融入更大的整体

examples.en: The small village was gradually merged in the expanding city.
examples.zh: 这个小村庄逐渐被扩张的城市吞并了。

in the thought that.usage: 表示“想到……”，后接同位语从句说明thought的具体内容，用于描述人的心理活动

examples.en: She smiled in the thought that her family would come to see her soon.
examples.zh: 想到家人很快就要来看她，她露出了微笑。

it seems to me.usage: 插入语，意为“在我看来，我认为”，用于委婉表达个人观点，可放在句首或句中

examples.en: It seems to me that we should put off the meeting until next week.
examples.zh: 在我看来我们应该把会议推迟到下周。

current account.usage: 银行术语，指可随时存取款、用于日常支付的活期存款账户，美语中常用checking account表示相同含义

examples.en: I need to open a current account to pay my monthly bills.
examples.zh: 我需要开一个活期账户来支付我的每月账单。

in favour of.usage: 表示“以……为收款人；有利于；支持”，在金融场景中常指支票的收款方

examples.en: Please draw a cheque in favour of the charity organization.
examples.zh: 请开一张以该慈善机构为收款人的支票。

in favour of.usage: 此处表示“有利于；支持”，用在描述概率的语境中说明某种结果发生的可能性更大

examples.en: The odds are in favour of the home team winning this match.
examples.zh: 主队赢得这场比赛的可能性很大。

in credit.usage: 银行账户用语，表示账户有余额、处于贷方余额状态，与be overdrawn（透支）相对

examples.en: Your account is still in credit, so you don't need to deposit more money right now.
examples.zh: 你的账户还有余额，所以你现在不需要再存钱。

be loaded against.usage: 表示“对……不利；偏向于反对……”，常用来描述规则、制度等不公平地偏向某一方

examples.en: Many workers complain that the existing labour law is loaded against them.
examples.zh: 许多工人抱怨现行的劳动法对他们不利。

in respect of.usage: 正式用语，意为“关于；涉及；就……而言”，用于引出相关的对象或范围

examples.en: The company will compensate you in respect of the losses caused by the delay.
examples.zh: 公司将就延误给你造成的损失进行赔偿。

make no difference.usage: 表示“没有影响；无关紧要”，后可接that从句或疑问词引导的从句说明具体内容

examples.en: It makes no difference how much experience you have - we will all receive the same training.
examples.zh: 你有多少经验都无关紧要，我们都会接受同样的培训。

strike oil.usage: 字面义为钻探到石油，也可引申为突然发财、交好运

examples.en: After three years of exploration, the team finally struck oil in the desert.
examples.zh: 经过三年勘探，团队终于在沙漠中钻探到了石油。

examples.en: He struck oil when his small invention was bought by a big company.
examples.zh: 他的小发明被大公司收购后，他一下子就发了财。

mineral deposit.usage: 固定搭配，指地壳中聚集的矿产资源

examples.en: Geologists have found a rich mineral deposit in the mountain area.
examples.zh: 地质学家在山区发现了一处储量丰富的矿床。

examples.en: The country's economy relies heavily on the exploitation of its mineral deposits.
examples.zh: 该国经济严重依赖其矿产资源的开采。

block and tackle.usage: 固定术语，指滑轮组，用于吊运重物

examples.en: Workers used a block and tackle to lift the heavy machine onto the truck.
examples.zh: 工人们用滑轮组把沉重的机器吊到了卡车上。

examples.en: The oil derrick is equipped with a block and tackle to handle long drill pipes.
examples.zh: 钻井架配备了滑轮组来搬运长钻杆。

be fitted with.usage: 表示“装有、配备有”，主语通常为物品

examples.en: All new cars in this country are fitted with safety belts as standard.
examples.zh: 这个国家所有的新车都标配了安全带。

examples.en: The laboratory is fitted with the latest testing equipment.
examples.zh: 这个实验室配备了最新的检测设备。

every so often.usage: 表示“偶尔、有时”，相当于occasionally，作时间状语

examples.en: Every so often, I go hiking in the hills to relax.
examples.zh: 我偶尔会去山里徒步放松一下。

examples.en: You should check the tire pressure every so often to avoid accidents.
examples.zh: 你应该偶尔检查一下胎压，避免发生事故。

by means of.usage: 正式表达，意为“通过、借助于”，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: The rescue team located the trapped miners by means of a special detector.
examples.zh: 救援队借助一种特殊探测器找到了被困矿工的位置。

examples.en: We can express our feelings by means of body language when we don't speak the same language.
examples.zh: 当我们语言不通时，可以借助肢体语言来表达感受。

by means of.usage: 介词短语，表示“通过…方式，借助…手段”，后面接名词或动名词

examples.en: The load was lifted by means of a crane.
examples.zh: 重物是用起重机吊起来的。

examples.en: We express our thoughts by means of words.
examples.zh: 我们通过语言表达思想。

by means of.usage: 表示通过某种方式、方法或工具达成目的，是较正式的表达

examples.en: We can lift the heavy box by means of a pulley.
examples.zh: 我们可以借助滑轮抬起这个重箱子。

examples.en: The rescue team communicated with each other by means of walkie-talkies.
examples.zh: 救援队通过对讲机互相沟通。

lead off.usage: 此处指“引导流出、引出”，还可表示“开始、开头”

examples.en: Pipes are installed to lead off the excess water from the reservoir.
examples.zh: 安装了管道来引出水库里多余的水。

examples.en: The singer will lead off the festival with a popular song.
examples.zh: 这位歌手将演唱一首流行歌曲，拉开音乐节的序幕。

butterfly effect.usage: 指混沌理论中初始微小变化会导致后续系统巨大连锁反应的效应，可用于描述各领域的连锁影响现象

examples.en: The butterfly effect explains why a small decision today can completely change your life path years later.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶效应解释了为什么今天的一个小决定可能会完全改变你多年后的人生轨迹。

a high degree of accuracy.usage: 用来形容极高的精准度，常和predict、measure、calculate等动词搭配

examples.en: This new instrument can measure the thickness of the material with a high degree of accuracy.
examples.zh: 这台新仪器可以极高精准度地测量材料的厚度。

weather forecast.usage: 表示天气预报，是日常和气象领域的常用搭配

examples.en: According to the weather forecast, there will be a heavy snowstorm this weekend.
examples.zh: 根据天气预报，本周末会有一场强暴风雪。

of the order of.usage: 表示“大约，差不多”，用来描述数量的大致范围，相当于approximately

examples.en: The cost of the project is of the order of one million dollars.
examples.zh: 这个项目的成本大约是100万美元。

spaced apart.usage: 表示“间隔排列”，常和表示距离的词汇搭配，说明物体之间的间距

examples.en: The chairs in the waiting room are spaced two meters apart to keep social distance.
examples.zh: 等候室的椅子间隔两米摆放，以保持社交距离。

all the way to.usage: 表示“一直到”，强调路径或范围的连续性，直到某个终点

examples.en: We walked all the way to the top of the mountain to see the sunrise.
examples.zh: 我们一路走到山顶去看日出。

deviation from the average.usage: 表示“与平均值的偏差”，常用于统计、测量等场景，描述和均值的差异

examples.en: The researcher recorded the deviation from the average temperature for each month last year.
examples.zh: 研究人员记录了去年每个月的气温与平均值的偏差。

and so on.usage: 表示“等等，诸如此类”，用于列举未尽的同类事物

examples.en: You can find all kinds of fruits in the market: apples, bananas, oranges, and so on.
examples.zh: 你在市场里能找到各种水果：苹果、香蕉、橙子等等。

weigh heavily against.usage: 表示“严重不利于；对…有很大负面影响”，主语通常为不利因素，宾语为受影响的事物

examples.en: Lack of funding weighs heavily against the development of small businesses.
examples.zh: 资金短缺严重不利于小企业的发展。

examples.en: His lack of experience weighs heavily against his chance of getting the job.
examples.zh: 他经验不足，这对他获得这份工作的机会非常不利。

in so far as.usage: 连词短语，意为“在…范围内；就…而言”，用于引导状语从句，限定论述的范围

examples.en: In so far as you are a student, you should obey the school rules.
examples.zh: 作为学生，你应该遵守校规。

examples.en: I will help you in so far as I can.
examples.zh: 我会尽我所能帮助你。

engage in.usage: 动词短语，意为“从事；参与”，可用于主动或被动语态be engaged in

examples.en: Many college students engage in part-time jobs during holidays.
examples.zh: 很多大学生假期会从事兼职工作。

examples.en: He is engaged in scientific research on environmental protection.
examples.zh: 他正从事环境保护方面的科学研究。

take out a patent.usage: 固定搭配，意为“取得专利权”，指为发明申请并获得专利保护

examples.en: The company decided to take out a patent for its new invention.
examples.zh: 这家公司决定为它的新发明申请专利。

examples.en: It took them three years to take out a patent on this new energy technology.
examples.zh: 他们花了三年时间才取得这项新能源技术的专利。

to such an extent that.usage: 意为“到如此程度以至于”，用于强调程度，引导结果状语从句

examples.en: The noise from the construction site was loud to such an extent that we couldn't sleep at night.
examples.zh: 工地的噪音大到我们晚上根本睡不着觉。

examples.en: He was absorbed in the book to such an extent that he didn't hear the doorbell.
examples.zh: 他看书太入迷了，以至于都没听到门铃声。

for fear that.usage: 连词短语，意为“生怕；唯恐”，引导目的状语从句，从句常用虚拟语气

examples.en: She locked the door for fear that someone might break in while she was out.
examples.zh: 她锁了门，生怕自己出门的时候有人闯进来。

examples.en: He left an hour early for fear he might miss the train.
examples.zh: 他提前一小时出发，唯恐赶不上火车。

in order that.usage: 引导目的状语从句，意为“为了，以便”，从句中常搭配may、might、can、could等情态动词，可与in order to do结构转换

examples.en: Modern industry runs in order that individuals may earn as much money as possible.
examples.zh: 现代工业的运转是为了让个人能够尽可能多地赚钱。

examples.en: He left home early in order that he could catch the first train to the town.
examples.zh: 他早早出门，以便能赶上开往镇上的第一班火车。

give consideration to.usage: 表示“考虑到，顾及”，正式用语，可替换为take into consideration，to为介词，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Factories do not give consideration to the effects of their artificial mode of existence on workers.
examples.zh: 工厂没有顾及它们强加的人为生存模式对工人造成的影响。

examples.en: When planning the project, we must give full consideration to the needs of local residents.
examples.zh: 规划这个项目时，我们必须充分考虑当地居民的需求。

with no regard for.usage: 表示“不顾，不考虑”，含贬义，指做某事时完全不顾及相关的人或后果，可替换为without regard to

examples.en: The great cities have been built with no regard for us.
examples.zh: 大城市的建造完全没有顾及我们的需求。

examples.en: Some companies pursue profit with no regard for environmental protection.
examples.zh: 一些公司追逐利润，完全不顾环境保护。

be deprived of.usage: 被动结构，意为“被剥夺，失去”，主语通常是人，of后接被剥夺的事物，主动形式为deprive sb of sth

examples.en: City dwellers do not realize that they are deprived of the necessities of life.
examples.zh: 城市居民没有意识到他们被剥夺了生活的必需品。

examples.en: Many children in remote areas were deprived of educational opportunities in the past.
examples.zh: 过去，很多偏远地区的孩子失去了受教育的机会。

be deprived of.usage: 被动结构，表示“被剥夺……；失去……”，后接被夺走的事物

examples.en: They have been deprived of their own trainer.
examples.zh: 他们被夺走了自己的驯象师。

examples.en: Many children in remote areas are deprived of the right to receive education.
examples.zh: 很多偏远地区的孩子被剥夺了受教育的权利。

be torn by.usage: 被动结构，意为“被……扰乱，受……撕裂”，可描述地点受噪音干扰，也可描述国家、组织受冲突影响

examples.en: The city streets are torn by the noise of the taxicabs, lorries and buses.
examples.zh: 城市街道被出租车、卡车和公交车的噪音扰乱。

examples.en: The small country was torn by years of civil war.
examples.zh: 这个小国因多年的内战而四分五裂。

be thronged by.usage: 被动结构，意为“挤满了，被……拥堵”，主语通常为地点，介词by后接人群，也可用be thronged with结构

examples.en: The streets are thronged ceaselessly by great crowds.
examples.zh: 街道上永远挤满了熙熙攘攘的人群。

examples.en: During the Spring Festival, the railway station is thronged by passengers going home.
examples.zh: 春节期间，火车站挤满了返乡的旅客。

with abandon.usage: 表示“肆意地，放纵地”，用来描述行为毫无约束、随心所欲的状态

examples.en: The tourists cheered with abandon when the parade began.
examples.zh: 游行开始时，游客们尽情欢呼。

examples.en: Children were splashing in the water with complete abandon.
examples.zh: 孩子们毫无顾忌地在水里嬉闹泼水。

be susceptible to.usage: 表示“易受…影响，易感染…（疾病）”，to为介词，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: People with weak immune systems are more susceptible to the flu.
examples.zh: 免疫系统较弱的人更容易感染流感。

examples.en: Teenagers are often susceptible to peer pressure.
examples.zh: 青少年往往容易受到同伴压力的影响。

be susceptible to.usage: 固定搭配，表示“易受……影响的；对……敏感的”，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: The elephant is not immediately susceptible to such blandishments.
examples.zh: 大象并不会立刻就吃这套哄骗的把戏。

examples.en: Babies are susceptible to colds when the weather changes suddenly.
examples.zh: 天气骤变的时候，婴儿很容易感冒。

act as.usage: 表示“充当，担任，起…作用”，后接表示身份、功能的名词

examples.en: She agreed to act as our interpreter during the trip.
examples.zh: 她同意在旅行期间充当我们的翻译。

examples.en: The lemon juice acts as a natural preservative for the jam.
examples.zh: 柠檬汁在果酱里起到天然防腐剂的作用。

pass sth on to.usage: 表示“把…传递给，把…传染给”，强调物品、疾病或信息的传递

examples.en: Please pass this message on to all the team members.
examples.zh: 请把这条消息传达给所有团队成员。

examples.en: The virus can be passed on to others through close contact.
examples.zh: 这种病毒可以通过密切接触传染给其他人。

within the confines of.usage: 表示“在…的范围之内，在…的边界内”，confine常用复数形式表示界限、限制

examples.en: All the activities will take place within the confines of the campus.
examples.zh: 所有活动都将在校园范围内进行。

examples.en: He felt trapped within the confines of his boring daily routine.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己被困在枯燥的日常琐事的牢笼里。

the basis of.usage: 表示“…的基础”，常用搭配be the basis of/for sth.

examples.en: Mutual trust is the basis of a good relationship.
examples.zh: 相互信任是良好关系的基础。

examples.en: The research was done on the basis of hundreds of interviews.
examples.zh: 这项研究是在数百次采访的基础上完成的。

out of curiosity.usage: 介词短语，在句中作状语，说明做某事的动机是出于好奇心。

examples.en: I asked the question just out of curiosity, so you don't need to answer it if you don't want to.
examples.zh: 我问这个问题只是出于好奇，所以你不想回答的话可以不用回答。

examples.en: Out of curiosity, he opened the old box that had been stored in the attic for years.
examples.zh: 出于好奇，他打开了那个在阁楼里存放了多年的旧箱子。

credit sb with sth.usage: 动词短语，意为“认为某人有某种特质、能力或做了某事”，也可写作credit sth to sb。

examples.en: We should credit the team with the success of the entire project, not just the leader.
examples.zh: 我们应该把整个项目的成功归功于整个团队，而不仅仅是领导。

examples.en: The old man is credited with saving more than 20 children from drowning in the past 30 years.
examples.zh: 这位老人在过去30年里被认为救了20多名溺水的儿童。

defensive formation.usage: 名词短语，指军队、动物群体等为防御攻击而排列的阵型。

examples.en: The soldiers formed a defensive formation around the camp to guard against possible attacks at night.
examples.zh: 士兵们在营地周围排成防御阵型，以防夜间可能的袭击。

examples.en: When facing the enemy's cavalry, the infantry quickly adjusted to a tight defensive formation.
examples.zh: 面对敌方骑兵时，步兵迅速调整为严密的防御阵型。

bow waves.usage: 名词短语，指船只在航行时船头激起的浪，也叫艏波。

examples.en: Dolphins love to ride the bow waves of speeding ships for fun.
examples.zh: 海豚喜欢在快速行驶的船只的艏波上冲浪玩耍。

examples.en: The bow waves of the large cruise ship splashed onto the nearby small fishing boats.
examples.zh: 大型游轮的艏波溅到了附近的小渔船上。

natural enemies.usage: 名词短语，指生态中天生互为捕食、竞争关系的物种，也可引申指天生敌对的人。

examples.en: Cats and mice are natural enemies, so you'll rarely see them living together peacefully.
examples.zh: 猫和老鼠是天敌，所以你很少能看到它们和平共处。

examples.en: In the business world, the two companies have been natural enemies for decades, competing for the same market share.
examples.zh: 在商业领域，这两家公司几十年来一直是死对头，争夺同一块市场份额。

submit to.usage: 动词短语，意为“屈服于；服从；忍受”，后接名词或动名词作宾语。

examples.en: He refused to submit to the unfair rules set by the new manager.
examples.zh: 他拒绝服从新经理制定的不公平规定。

examples.en: The citizens had to submit to the strict curfew during the emergency period.
examples.zh: 在紧急时期，市民们不得不遵守严格的宵禁规定。

for dear life.usage: 副词短语，在句中作状语，意为“拼命地；竭尽全力地”，形容人在危险或紧急情况下尽最大努力做某事。

examples.en: When the dog chased him, he ran for dear life as fast as he could.
examples.zh: 狗追他的时候，他拼命地跑，能跑多快就跑多快。

examples.en: She held onto the rope for dear life, afraid that she would fall off the cliff.
examples.zh: 她拼命抓住绳子，害怕自己会掉下悬崖。

to a degree.usage: 表示“在某种程度上”，用于说明某事物的适用范围不是绝对的

examples.en: The body's tissues are self-repairing and self-restoring to a degree, and function best when more or less continuously active.
examples.zh: 人体组织在一定程度上有自我修复和自我恢复的能力，在或多或少持续活动时运作得最好。

examples.en: I agree with his argument to a degree, but there are still points I doubt.
examples.zh: 我在一定程度上同意他的论点，但仍有一些地方我持怀疑态度。

be concerned with.usage: 表示“与……有关；涉及”，说明事物的关联对象

examples.en: In fact a basic amount of movement occurs during sleep which is specifically concerned with preventing muscle inactivity.
examples.zh: 事实上，睡眠期间会有少量活动，这些活动正是为了防止肌肉不活动。

examples.en: This research is concerned with the effects of air pollution on human health.
examples.zh: 这项研究涉及空气污染对人类健康的影响。

be concerned with.usage: 表示关注、涉及、以…为主题，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: This research is concerned with the impact of social media on teenagers' mental health.
examples.zh: 这项研究关注社交媒体对青少年心理健康的影响。

were it not for.usage: 虚拟语气结构，意为“要不是，如果没有”，表示与事实相反的假设

examples.en: This might be a plausible hypothesis were it not for two factors.
examples.zh: 要不是有两个因素，这个假说似乎是合理的。

examples.en: Were it not for your help, I would never have finished the project on time.
examples.zh: 要不是你的帮助，我绝不可能按时完成这个项目。

on end.usage: 放在表示时间的名词后，意为“连续地，不断地”

examples.en: If one group of people were disturbed from their eye-movement sleep for several nights on end, and another group were disturbed for an equal period of time but when they were not exhibiting eye-movements.
examples.zh: 如果一组人连续几晚在眼动睡眠阶段被叫醒，另一组人在同样长的时间里被叫醒，但叫醒时间是在他们没有出现眼动的阶段。

examples.en: He worked for 12 hours on end to meet the deadline.
examples.zh: 为了赶截止日期，他连续工作了12个小时。

on end.usage: 表示“直立着；竖着”，也可指“连续地”，修饰动词stand、place等表示物体竖直放置的状态

examples.en: One, for instance, consisted of rods of various lengths and thicknesses which would stand up on end like ninepins.
examples.zh: 例如，有一种装置是由一些长短、粗细不同的木棒组成，就像九柱戏的木棒一样直立着。

examples.en: He placed the box on end in the corner of the room.
examples.zh: 他把箱子竖着放在房间的角落里。

more or less.usage: 意为“几乎，差不多；大概”，表示数量、程度接近某个情况

examples.en: the first group began to show some personality disorders while the others seemed more or less unaffected.
examples.zh: 第一组人开始出现一些性格紊乱的症状，而另一组人几乎没有受到影响。

examples.en: The work is more or less finished, we just need to check the details.
examples.zh: 工作差不多完成了，我们只需要检查一下细节。

live on.usage: 表示以某物为食、靠某物生存

examples.en: They could have caught and lived on prey without using poison.
examples.zh: 它们本可以不用毒液，就捕获猎物并以此为生。

examples.en: Most pandas live on bamboo in the wild.
examples.zh: 野外的大多数大熊猫以竹子为食。

live on.usage: 表示“继续存在，流传下去”，主语可以是人（表示靠…为生）或抽象事物（表示留存）

examples.en: Although the writer has passed away for decades, his works still live on in the hearts of readers.
examples.zh: 尽管这位作家已经去世几十年了，他的作品仍然在读者心中流传。

examples.en: The memory of that historic event will live on for generations to come.
examples.zh: 对那个历史事件的记忆将会代代传承下去。

twoedged weapon.usage: 比喻具有利弊两面性的事物，即双刃剑

examples.en: It would be an assistance to all carnivores though it would be a two-edged weapon when they fought each other.
examples.zh: 这对所有食肉动物都有帮助，不过当它们互相打斗时，这就会是一把双刃剑。

examples.en: Social media is a two-edged weapon: it connects people but also spreads misinformation easily.
examples.zh: 社交媒体是一把双刃剑：它能连接人们，但也很容易传播不实信息。

twoedged weapon.usage: 固定表达，指“双刃剑”，用来形容事物同时有好坏两种作用

examples.en: Social media is a two-edged weapon: it connects people but also spreads misinformation easily.
examples.zh: 社交媒体是一把双刃剑：它连接了人们，但也很容易传播虚假信息。

examples.en: Nuclear technology is a two-edged weapon that can provide clean energy or cause massive destruction.
examples.zh: 核技术是一把双刃剑，既可以提供清洁能源，也可能造成大规模破坏。

by far.usage: 用于形容词或副词比较级、最高级前，强调程度，意为“……得多，显然”

examples.en: Both poisons are unpleasant, but by far the more unpleasant is the blood poison.
examples.zh: 两种毒液都很可怕，但血溶性毒液显然要更伤人。

examples.en: This is by far the best movie I have watched this year.
examples.zh: 这显然是我今年看过的最好的电影。

so to speak.usage: 插入语，用于表达比喻、不太严谨的说法，意为“可以说，打个比方”

examples.en: The blood poison is, so to speak, a newer product from an improved formula.
examples.zh: 可以说，血溶性毒液是配方改良后的新产品。

examples.en: In many ways, the Internet is, so to speak, a new global public space.
examples.zh: 从很多方面来说，互联网可以说是一个全新的全球公共空间。

be that as it may.usage: 让步表达，意为“尽管如此，话虽如此”，用于承认前文观点后转折引出新内容

examples.en: Be that as it may, the nerve poison does its business with man far more quickly than the blood poison.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，神经性毒液作用于人体的速度还是比血溶性毒液快得多。

examples.en: Be that as it may, we still need to consider the potential risks of the plan.
examples.zh: 话虽如此，我们还是需要考虑这个计划的潜在风险。

do its business.usage: 非正式表达，意为“发挥作用，奏效”

examples.en: The nerve poison does its business with man far more quickly than the blood poison.
examples.zh: 神经性毒液对人体产生作用的速度比血溶性毒液快得多。

examples.en: The medicine will do its business in half an hour and you will feel less pain.
examples.zh: 这个药半小时后就会起效，你就不会那么疼了。

nothing but.usage: 用来强调除了提到的事物之外没有其他，相当于only

examples.en: Unlike Gary Cooper and John Wayne he appeared in nothing but Westerns.
examples.zh: 和加里·库珀以及约翰·韦恩不同，他只出演西部片。

examples.en: After the accident, he could remember nothing but his childhood.
examples.zh: 事故发生后，他除了自己的童年什么都记不起来了。

nothing but.unitTitle: William S. Hart and the Early Western Film

be rooted in.usage: 表示事物的根源、基础来源于某处，强调稳固的起源

examples.en: His hero was firmly rooted in his memories and experiences.
examples.zh: 他塑造的英雄角色牢牢扎根于他的记忆和经历之中。

examples.en: The traditional custom is rooted in local culture stretching back thousands of years.
examples.zh: 这个传统习俗扎根于延续数千年的当地文化中。

be rooted in.unitTitle: William S. Hart and the Early Western Film

join hands.usage: 字面意思是“牵手”，常引申为合作、联合、共同达成某一目标

examples.en: Myth and reality did join hands in at least one arena.
examples.zh: 至少在一个领域里神话和现实确实是共存共通的。

examples.en: The two countries will join hands to develop new energy technology.
examples.zh: 两国将携手开发新能源技术。

join hands.unitTitle: William S. Hart and the Early Western Film

in conflict with.usage: 表示与……有冲突、有矛盾，可指人和人之间，也可指人自身的思想矛盾

examples.en: The individual in conflict with himself and his frontier environment.
examples.zh: 与自身以及边疆环境相冲突的个体。

examples.en: His idea is in conflict with the general plan of the team.
examples.zh: 他的想法和团队的整体规划相冲突。

in conflict with.unitTitle: William S. Hart and the Early Western Film

loom large.usage: 表示（问题、忧虑等）显得突出、严重，让人担忧

examples.en: The threat of war loomed large in the country.
examples.zh: 战争的威胁在这个国家显得十分严峻。

examples.en: Exam season is looming large for all the students.
examples.zh: 考试季越来越近，所有学生都压力很大。

compound interest law.usage: 经济学术语，指“复利法则”，文中用来比喻知识增长的滚雪球效应

examples.en: The compound interest law allows small savings to grow significantly over time.
examples.zh: 复利法则能让小额储蓄随着时间推移大幅增长。

examples.en: Language learning follows a kind of compound interest law: the more you learn, the faster you acquire new knowledge.
examples.zh: 语言学习遵循类似复利的规律：你学得越多，吸收新知识的速度就越快。

turn sth to practical account.usage: 表示“将某物付诸实际应用，利用某物”，也可写作put sth to practical use

examples.en: It is important to turn the theoretical knowledge we learn at university to practical account.
examples.zh: 把我们在大学学到的理论知识付诸实际应用很重要。

examples.en: The inventor finally turned his new invention to practical account in the manufacturing industry.
examples.zh: 这位发明家最终将他的新发明应用到了制造业中。

close at hand.usage: 表示“在附近，在手边”，强调距离很近

examples.en: Always keep a first-aid kit close at hand when you go camping.
examples.zh: 去露营的时候要随时把急救包放在手边。

examples.en: The shopping mall is close at hand, so we can go there to buy groceries anytime.
examples.zh: 购物中心就在附近，我们随时可以去那里买日用品。

keep company with.usage: 表示与某人/某物结伴、陪伴，强调同行的状态

examples.en: The dog kept company with the old man every day.
examples.zh: 这只狗每天都陪着这位老人。

yield to.usage: 表示屈服、让步于某种力量、要求或诱惑，后接宾语

examples.en: We should never yield to difficulties no matter how hard they are.
examples.zh: 无论困难多大，我们都不该向它们屈服。

be endowed with.usage: 被动结构，指天生具有某种优秀的能力、品质或特征

examples.en: She is endowed with a beautiful singing voice.
examples.zh: 她天生有一副好歌喉。

in highest measure.usage: 正式表达，意思是“在最大程度上”，用来强调程度极高

examples.en: This new policy has benefited the local people in highest measure.
examples.zh: 这项新政策最大程度地惠及了当地民众。

to and from.usage: 表示往返于两地之间，用来描述来回的动作

examples.en: He commutes to and from the company by subway every day.
examples.zh: 他每天乘地铁往返于公司和家之间。

take omens from.usage: 表示从某事/某物中获取预兆、征兆，多用于和迷信相关的语境

examples.en: In ancient times, people took omens from the movement of stars.
examples.zh: 古代人们会根据星辰的运行来判断预兆。

for long distances.usage: 表示长距离地，用来修饰表示移动、行进的动词

examples.en: Camels can travel for long distances in the desert without drinking water.
examples.zh: 骆驼可以在沙漠中不喝水行进很长距离。

in utter exhaustion.usage: 表示完全筋疲力尽的状态，用来描述人或动物耗尽体力的样子

examples.en: After running the full marathon, he collapsed in utter exhaustion.
examples.zh: 跑完整个马拉松之后，他筋疲力尽地倒下了。

catch a glimpse of.usage: 表示短暂、不经意地瞥见某物，强调看到的时间短、不够清晰

examples.en: I caught a glimpse of the famous singer as she got into the car.
examples.zh: 那位著名歌手上车的时候，我瞥见了她一眼。

examples.en: From the window, we can catch a glimpse of the mountain.
examples.zh: 从窗户我们可以望到山的一角。

be fitted to.usage: 表示适合、适应某用途或情况，强调匹配度

examples.en: This policy is fitted to the needs of local residents.
examples.zh: 这项政策适合当地居民的需求。

examples.en: Traditional tools are not always fitted to modern production needs.
examples.zh: 传统工具并不总能适应现代生产的需求。

point forward to.usage: 指向，预示着某个更高级、更美好的事物，带有展望的含义

examples.en: Every small success in your study points forward to a bigger achievement in the future.
examples.zh: 你学习中每一次小的成功都预示着未来会有更大的成就。

examples.en: The warm breeze in early spring points forward to the coming of a vibrant summer.
examples.zh: 早春温暖的微风预示着充满生机的夏天即将到来。

in a word.usage: 用于总结前文内容，意为“总而言之，简言之”，通常放在句首

examples.en: In a word, you need to practice more if you want to improve your spoken English.
examples.zh: 总而言之，如果你想提高英语口语，就需要多练习。

examples.en: The plan is creative, practical and low-cost. In a word, it's perfect.
examples.zh: 这个计划有创意、可行而且成本低。总而言之，它非常完美。

on the other hand.usage: 用于引出对比的另一方面观点或情况，常和on the one hand搭配使用，也可单独使用

examples.en: Online courses are very convenient. On the other hand, they lack the face-to-face interaction of traditional classes.
examples.zh: 在线课程非常方便。另一方面，它们缺少传统课堂的面对面互动。

plea for.usage: 表示对某事物的恳求、请求，plea为名词，后接介词for引出请求的对象

examples.en: The local residents made a plea for more public green spaces in the community.
examples.zh: 当地居民恳求在社区内建设更多公共绿地。

distinguish cause and effect.usage: 表示区分因果关系，是学术讨论、逻辑分析中的常用表达，也可写作distinguish between cause and effect

examples.en: When studying social phenomena, it is often difficult to distinguish cause and effect clearly.
examples.zh: 研究社会现象时，往往很难清晰地区分因果关系。

be cautious about.usage: 表示对某事持谨慎态度，about后接名词或动名词

examples.en: You should be cautious about believing information from unknown sources on the Internet.
examples.zh: 你要谨慎对待互联网上来源不明的信息，不要轻信。

be reduced to.usage: 表示“沦落到…的境地，陷入某种（糟糕的）状态”，to为介词，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: After losing his job and savings, he was reduced to begging on the street.
examples.zh: 失去工作和积蓄后，他沦落到在街上乞讨的地步。

mental health hazard.usage: 固定搭配，表示“心理健康危害”，用于描述会对人的精神状态造成负面影响的因素

examples.en: Long-term excessive use of social media has been proved to be a mental health hazard for teenagers.
examples.zh: 长期过度使用社交媒体已被证实会对青少年的心理健康造成危害。

not to mention.usage: 表示“更不用说；别提”，用于补充说明前面提到的内容，强调程度更进一步

examples.en: When you think of the innumerable birds that one sees flying about, not to mention the equally numerous small animals like field mice and voles which you do not see, it is very rarely that one comes across a dead body.
examples.zh: 想一想你看到的无数飞来飞去的鸟儿，更别提那些你看不到的同样多的田鼠之类的小动物，人们极少能见到它们的尸体。

examples.en: He can speak French and German, not to mention English.
examples.zh: 他会说法语和德语，更不用说英语了。

not to mention.unitTitle: The Past Life of the Earth

come across.usage: 表示“偶然遇见；无意中发现”，后面接遇见的人或发现的事物，无被动语态

examples.en: It is very rarely that one comes across a dead body, except, of course, on the roads.
examples.zh: 人们极少能见到它们的尸体，当然除了在公路上。

examples.en: I came across this old photo when I was cleaning the drawer.
examples.zh: 我打扫抽屉的时候偶然发现了这张老照片。

come across.unitTitle: The Past Life of the Earth

due to.usage: 表示“由于；因为”，后面接名词或名词短语，说明原因，可位于句首或句中

examples.en: It is almost always due to some very special circumstances that traces of land animals survive.
examples.zh: 陆地动物的遗迹几乎总是由于某些非常特殊的情况才得以保存下来。

examples.en: The sports meeting was put off due to the bad weather.
examples.zh: 由于天气不好，运动会被推迟了。

due to.unitTitle: The Past Life of the Earth

due to.usage: 介词短语，用于引出某事发生的原因，后面接名词或名词性短语

examples.en: The flight delay was due to bad weather.
examples.zh: 航班延误是恶劣天气导致的。

in good condition.usage: 表示“状态良好；保存完好”，用于描述物品、生物遗骸等的保存状态

examples.en: This is what happened to the famous Beresovka mammoth which was found preserved and in good condition.
examples.zh: 著名的别列佐夫卡猛犸象就是这种情况，它被发现时保存完好。

examples.en: The old book published 100 years ago is still in good condition.
examples.zh: 这本100年前出版的旧书现在仍然保存完好。

in good condition.unitTitle: The Past Life of the Earth

be bogged in.usage: 表示“陷入；被困在”，通常指陷入泥浆、沼泽等难以脱身，也可引申为陷入困境

examples.en: The bigger animals like the elephants ventured out on to the apparently firm surface to drink, and were promptly bogged in the tar.
examples.zh: 大象之类的大型动物冒险走到看似坚固的表面喝水，立刻就陷入了沥青中。

examples.en: The car got bogged in the mud after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨过后，汽车陷在了泥里。

be bogged in.unitTitle: The Past Life of the Earth

set in.usage: 表示“（不好的事物）开始；到来”，通常指腐烂、恶劣天气等不好的情况开始并可能持续

examples.en: Only a small fraction of the creatures that die are preserved in this way before decay sets in.
examples.zh: 只有一小部分死亡的生物能在腐烂开始之前以这种方式被保存下来。

examples.en: Winter has set in early this year.
examples.zh: 今年冬天来得早。

set in.unitTitle: The Past Life of the Earth

at the height of.usage: 表示处于某个活动、状态或事业的顶峰、最鼎盛时期

examples.en: He was at the height of his career when he won the Nobel Prize.
examples.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖时，他正处于事业的顶峰。

examples.en: At the height of the summer, the temperature can reach 40℃ here.
examples.zh: 在盛夏时节，这里的温度可达40摄氏度。

be intended to.usage: 表示某事物被设计、计划用于某个特定目的，主语通常是物

examples.en: This program is intended to help people with low income.
examples.zh: 这个项目旨在帮助低收入人群。

examples.en: The book is intended for children aged 5 to 10.
examples.zh: 这本书是为5到10岁的儿童编写的。

play a leading role in.usage: 表示在某个领域、活动中起主导作用、担任重要角色

examples.en: She played a leading role in organizing the event.
examples.zh: 她在组织这次活动中起到了主导作用。

examples.en: China plays a leading role in global climate change cooperation.
examples.zh: 中国在全球气候变化合作中发挥着重要的引领作用。

a riot of.usage: 用于描述大量丰富多彩、种类繁多的事物，尤指颜色

examples.en: The garden is a riot of colour in spring.
examples.zh: 春天的花园里色彩缤纷，万紫千红。

examples.en: The parade was a riot of sound and movement as dancers and musicians passed by.
examples.zh: 当舞者和音乐家经过时，游行队伍充满了喧闹的声响和活跃的身影。

stir ones imagination.usage: 表示激发、唤起某人的想象力

examples.en: Science fiction stories always stir children's imagination about space.
examples.zh: 科幻故事总能激发孩子们对太空的想象力。

examples.en: The mysterious ancient ruins stirred the archaeologists' imagination.
examples.zh: 这些神秘的古代遗迹唤起了考古学家的想象。

in reply to.usage: 表示作为对……的回应、答复

examples.en: He nodded in reply to my question.
examples.zh: 他点了点头，作为对我问题的回应。

examples.en: The company issued a statement in reply to the media's accusations.
examples.zh: 公司发布了一则声明，回应媒体的指控。

seal ones fate.usage: 表示决定了某人或某事物的最终结局（通常是不幸的），无法再改变

examples.en: His careless mistake in the final game sealed the team's fate.
examples.zh: 他在决赛中那个粗心的失误注定了球队的败局。

examples.en: When the company lost its biggest client, its fate was sealed.
examples.zh: 当公司失去了最大的客户时，它的命运就已经注定了。

in the shape of.usage: 表示“以……的形式，呈……的形状”，用来描述事物的呈现形态

examples.en: The company received help in the shape of a government loan.
examples.zh: 这家公司得到了政府贷款形式的帮助。

examples.en: He made a cake in the shape of a heart for his girlfriend's birthday.
examples.zh: 他为女朋友的生日做了一个心形的蛋糕。

only too ready to do sth.phrase: only too ready to do sth
only too ready to do sth.usage: 表示“非常乐意做某事，巴不得做某事”，带有强调愿意的语气

examples.en: He is only too ready to help others when they are in trouble.
examples.zh: 别人有困难时他非常乐意帮忙。

examples.en: The shop assistant was only too ready to show us the latest products.
examples.zh: 店员非常乐意向我们展示最新的产品。

dispose of.usage: 此处表示“应付，打发”，也可表示“处理、丢弃不需要的物品”

examples.en: The manager quickly disposed of the customer's complaint and calmed him down.
examples.zh: 经理迅速处理了顾客的投诉，让他冷静了下来。

examples.en: We need to dispose of all these old newspapers before moving to the new office.
examples.zh: 搬去新办公室之前，我们需要把这些旧报纸都处理掉。

dispose of.usage: /dɪˈspəʊz ɒv/ phrasal verb. 处理，应付；扔掉，丢弃（此处表示快速应付、打发走某人，也可表示处理掉不需要的物品）

put up with.usage: 表示“忍受，容忍”，是常用的动词短语，宾语为令人不快的人或事

examples.en: I can't put up with his constant complaining any more.
examples.zh: 我再也受不了他没完没了的抱怨了。

examples.en: Many residents have to put up with the noise from the construction site nearby.
examples.zh: 很多居民不得不忍受附近建筑工地的噪音。

in all probability.usage: 表示“极有可能，十有八九”，是表示可能性的正式表达

examples.en: In all probability, the meeting will be cancelled because of the bad weather.
examples.zh: 十有八九这次会议会因为恶劣天气取消。

examples.en: If you don't prepare for the exam, in all probability you will fail it.
examples.zh: 如果你不为考试做准备，你很可能会不及格。

be of equal benefit.usage: 表示“有同等好处，同样有益”，属于“be of + 抽象名词”的结构，相当于be equally beneficial

examples.en: This training course is of equal benefit to both new and experienced employees.
examples.zh: 这个培训课程对新员工和老员工都同样有益。

examples.en: Regular exercise is of equal benefit to people of all age groups.
examples.zh: 规律锻炼对所有年龄段的人都有同样的好处。

outpatients department.usage: 医疗场景常用短语，表示“门诊部”，对应住院部的in-patients department

examples.en: The out-patients department of this hospital is open from 8 am to 5 pm every day.
examples.zh: 这家医院的门诊部每天早上8点到下午5点开放。

examples.en: You need to register at the out-patients department first before seeing a doctor.
examples.zh: 看医生之前你需要先在门诊部挂号。

make no demands on sb.usage: 表示“对某人没有要求，不给某人添麻烦”，用来描述某件事不需要对方付出什么

examples.en: This kind of houseplant makes no demands on the owner; it only needs occasional watering.
examples.zh: 这种室内盆栽不需要主人费什么心思，只需要偶尔浇浇水就行。

examples.en: The new software makes very few demands on the computer's hardware.
examples.zh: 这个新软件对电脑硬件的要求非常低。

have difficulty in doing sth.usage: 表示“做某事有困难”，介词in可以省略

examples.en: Ever since, people have had difficulty in deciding whether the craft should be ranged among ships, planes, or land vehicles.
examples.zh: 从那以后，人们一直难以决定这种交通工具到底应该归为船舶、飞机还是陆上车辆。

examples.en: Many beginners have difficulty in pronouncing English words correctly.
examples.zh: 很多初学者在正确发英语单词的音方面有困难。

range among.usage: 表示“把……归入、划分到某一类中”，常用于被动语态

examples.en: People can not decide whether the craft should be ranged among ships, planes, or land vehicles.
examples.zh: 人们无法决定这种载具是否应该被归为船舶、飞机或者陆上车辆。

examples.en: This new type of mobile device is usually ranged among portable computers.
examples.zh: 这种新型移动设备通常被归为便携式电脑一类。

in between.usage: 表示“介于……之间”，可作介词短语或表语，说明两种事物的中间状态

examples.en: For it is something in between a boat and an aircraft.
examples.zh: 因为它是介于船和飞机之间的一种东西。

examples.en: The answer is neither yes nor no, it's somewhere in between.
examples.zh: 答案既不是肯定也不是否定，而是介于两者之间。

a good deal of.usage: 表示“大量的，许多的”，仅用于修饰不可数名词

examples.en: Wave resistance wastes a good deal of a surface ship's power and limits its speed.
examples.zh: 波浪阻力会浪费水面船舶大量的动力，还会限制它的速度。

examples.en: The project took a good deal of time and effort before it was completed.
examples.zh: 这个项目花费了大量时间和精力才完成。

no more than.usage: 表示“仅仅，不超过”，强调数量少或程度低

examples.en: His answer was to lift the vessel out of the water by making it ride on a cushion of air, no more than one or two feet thick.
examples.zh: 他的解决方案是让船只浮在不超过一两英尺厚的气垫上，从而脱离水面。

examples.en: The whole process takes no more than 10 minutes for an experienced worker.
examples.zh: 对于有经验的工人来说，整个过程只需要不超过10分钟。

cause a sensation.usage: 表示“引起轰动，造成轰动效应”，主语通常是新奇的事物或事件

examples.en: The first tests on the Solent in 1959 caused a sensation.
examples.zh: 1959年在索伦特海峡进行的首次测试引起了轰动。

examples.en: The young artist's first exhibition in the city caused a sensation.
examples.zh: 这位年轻艺术家在这座城市的首次展览引起了轰动。

take up.usage: 表示“开始从事，承担（某项工作、服务）”，文中指开始提供常规服务

examples.en: Since that time, various types of hovercraft have appeared and taken up regular service.
examples.zh: 从那时起，各种类型的气垫船出现了，并开始提供常规服务。

examples.en: The new bus route will take up official operation next month.
examples.zh: 这条新的公交路线将于下月开始正式运营。

may well be.usage: 表示“很可能是，完全可以是”，表达带有肯定倾向的推测

examples.en: The railway of the future may well be the 'hovertrain'.
examples.zh: 未来的铁路很可能就是“气垫火车”。

examples.en: This discovery may well be the most important breakthrough in the field this year.
examples.zh: 这一发现很可能是该领域今年最重要的突破。

be confined to.usage: 表示“被局限于；被限制在”，主语通常是认知、活动、范围等事物，to为介词，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Our knowledge of the oceans a hundred years ago was confined to the two-dimensional shape of the sea surface.
examples.zh: 100年前，我们对海洋的认识仅局限于海洋表面的二维形状。

examples.en: Due to the pandemic, our travel was confined to the local area last year.
examples.zh: 受疫情影响，去年我们的旅行范围被限制在本地。

at the disposal of.usage: 表示“由……支配；供……使用”，主语通常是物品、资源、人员等，of后接支配的主体

examples.en: H.M.S. Porcupine was put at the disposal of the Royal Society for several cruises.
examples.zh: “刺猬号”军舰被交由英国皇家学会支配，用于多次航行考察。

examples.en: All the meeting rooms are at the disposal of the organizing committee during the conference.
examples.zh: 会议期间所有会议室都供组委会支配使用。

a burst of.usage: 表示“一阵；突发的”，用于描述短时间内突然爆发的活动、情绪、声音等，后接不可数名词或可数名词单数

examples.en: A burst of activity associated with the laying of submarine cables soon confirmed the Challenger's observation.
examples.zh: 铺设海底电缆带来的一阵密集活动很快证实了“挑战者号”的观测结果。

examples.en: There was a burst of applause when the famous scientist walked onto the stage.
examples.zh: 当那位著名科学家走上舞台时，现场爆发出一阵掌声。

be worthy of.usage: 表示“值得；配得上”，后接名词或动名词，主语通常是事物，说明其具备足够的价值匹配后面的内容

examples.en: The study of the sea-floor was established as a subject worthy of the most qualified physicists and geologists.
examples.zh: 海底研究被确立为一门值得最顶尖的物理学家和地质学家研究的学科。

examples.en: This innovative research is worthy of further investigation and promotion.
examples.zh: 这项创新研究值得进一步调研和推广。

in the course of.usage: 表示“在……过程中；在……期间”，用于引出某个过程的时间段，后接名词

examples.en: The continental slope in the course of a few hundred miles reaches the true ocean floor at 2,500-3,500 fathoms.
examples.zh: 大陆坡在延伸几百英里的过程中，会到达2500至3500英寻深的真正洋底。

examples.en: He collected a lot of precious first-hand data in the course of his field research.
examples.zh: 他在实地考察的过程中收集了很多珍贵的一手数据。

the result of.usage: 表示“……的结果”，用于说明事物产生的原因，后接名词或动名词短语

examples.en: The long tailing-off near the slope's lower reaches is almost certainly the result of material transported out to deep water after being eroded from the continental masses.
examples.zh: 坡脚附近长长的缓坡几乎毫无疑问是大陆块被侵蚀后搬运到深水区的物质沉积形成的结果。

examples.en: The rapid development of the local tourism industry is the result of years of environmental protection efforts.
examples.zh: 当地旅游业的快速发展是多年来环境保护工作的结果。

depend uponon.usage: 表示某事物由另一事物决定或取决于后者

examples.en: The success of the project depends upon the cooperation of all team members.
examples.zh: 这个项目的成功取决于所有团队成员的合作。

examples.en: Your grade will depend on your final exam performance.
examples.zh: 你的成绩将取决于你期末考试的表现。

identify with.usage: 表示与某人/某物产生共鸣，或者将自己等同于某人/某物，理解其感受

examples.en: Many readers identify with the main character of the novel.
examples.zh: 很多读者都和这本小说的主角产生了共鸣。

examples.en: It's hard for children to identify with the worries of adults.
examples.zh: 孩子很难理解成年人的烦恼。

strive to do sth.usage: 表示为了达成某个目标而努力奋斗，强调付出持续的努力

examples.en: Scientists strive to find a cure for this rare disease.
examples.zh: 科学家们努力寻找这种罕见疾病的治疗方法。

examples.en: Every student should strive to improve their learning efficiency.
examples.zh: 每个学生都应该努力提高自己的学习效率。

attain accuracy in.usage: 表示在某个方面达到准确性，多用于描述技能、认知等领域的精准度提升

examples.en: After months of practice, he attained great accuracy in playing the piano.
examples.zh: 经过几个月的练习，他弹钢琴的准度已经非常高了。

examples.en: The weather forecast has attained high accuracy in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来天气预报的准确率已经很高了。

respond to.usage: 表示对……做出反应、回应，也可引申为对某事物有感知、有共鸣

examples.en: The audience responded positively to the speaker's wonderful speech.
examples.zh: 观众对演讲者的精彩演讲反应很积极。

examples.en: A good listener knows how to properly respond to others' feelings.
examples.zh: 好的倾听者知道如何恰当回应他人的情绪。

in contrast.usage: 用于句首或句中，表示前后两种情况形成鲜明对比，可与with/to搭配引出对比的对象

examples.en: In contrast, the new approach is much more efficient and environment-friendly.
examples.zh: 相比之下，新方法要高效、环保得多。

examples.en: His brother is very outgoing, in contrast, he is quiet and likes reading alone.
examples.zh: 他的哥哥十分外向，相比之下，他很安静，喜欢独自读书。

put questions to.usage: 表示向某人/某对象提出疑问、寻求答案，正式书面用法，宾语可以是人或抽象事物

examples.en: Good researchers are those who dare to put questions to established theories.
examples.zh: 优秀的研究者是那些敢于向既定理论提出疑问的人。

examples.en: During the press conference, reporters put a series of questions to the official.
examples.zh: 在新闻发布会上，记者们向这位官员提出了一系列问题。

call for.usage: 表示“需要，要求”，主语通常为某件事、某种情况，宾语为需要的品质、行动、条件等

examples.en: This difficult task calls for patience, creativity and strong team cooperation.
examples.zh: 这项艰巨的任务需要耐心、创造力和强有力的团队协作。

examples.en: The current situation calls for immediate action to prevent the problem from getting worse.
examples.zh: 当前的形势要求我们立即采取行动，防止问题进一步恶化。

be familiar with.usage: 表示“熟悉，了解”，主语为人，宾语为被熟悉的事物，区别于be familiar to（某物为某人所熟知）

examples.en: If you want to work in this field, you must be familiar with the latest industry regulations.
examples.zh: 如果你想在这个领域工作，你必须熟悉最新的行业规定。

examples.en: He has lived in the city for 10 years, so he is very familiar with every street here.
examples.zh: 他在这座城市生活了10年，所以对这里的每一条街都非常熟悉。

in ones own right.usage: 表示“凭借自身的能力、资格”，用于强调某人/某物本身具备的属性，而非依赖他人

examples.en: She is a famous artist in her own right, not just the daughter of a well-known director.
examples.zh: 她本身就是一位著名艺术家，而不仅仅是知名导演的女儿。

examples.en: This small town is a tourist attraction in its own right, with its unique ancient architecture.
examples.zh: 这座小镇凭借其独特的古建筑，本身就是一个旅游景点。

deprive sb of sth.usage: 表示“剥夺某人的某物，使某人丧失某物”，是被动语境下的常用搭配

examples.en: The unfair law deprived many people of their right to vote.
examples.zh: 这项不公平的法律剥夺了许多人的投票权。

examples.en: Lack of sleep deprived him of the energy to finish the task.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足让他丧失了完成任务的精力。

invest in.usage: 既可以指资金上投资某领域，也可以指投入时间、精力等资源到某事物中

examples.en: The government plans to invest more in renewable energy.
examples.zh: 政府计划在可再生能源领域投入更多资金。

examples.en: It is wise to invest in your own professional skills.
examples.zh: 为自己的职业技能投入资源是很明智的。

lay stress on.usage: 表示“强调；重视”，等同于put emphasis on，用于说明关注的重点

examples.en: Many schools lay too much stress on exam results.
examples.zh: 很多学校过分强调考试成绩。

examples.en: The company lays stress on teamwork and innovation.
examples.zh: 这家公司重视团队合作和创新。

be fashioned after.usage: 表示“仿照…制作；模仿…的模式”，指以某事物为范本设计

examples.en: The new library is fashioned after a famous ancient building.
examples.zh: 这座新图书馆是仿照一座著名古建筑设计的。

examples.en: Their education system is fashioned after the French model.
examples.zh: 他们的教育体系是仿照法国模式建立的。

be binding toon.usage: 表示“对…有约束力”，用于说明规则、义务的强制效力

examples.en: The contract is binding on all parties involved.
examples.zh: 这份合同对所有相关方都有约束力。

examples.en: This regulation is binding to every employee.
examples.zh: 这项规定对所有员工都有效力。

be entitled to.usage: 表示“有权享有；有资格获得”，用于说明某人理应拥有某种权利或待遇

examples.en: All citizens are entitled to equal protection under the law.
examples.zh: 所有公民都有权受到法律的平等保护。

examples.en: You are entitled to a 10-day paid annual leave if you work here for one year.
examples.zh: 如果你在这里工作满一年，就有权享受10天的带薪年假。

be confronted with.usage: 表示“面临；面对（困难、问题等）”，强调被动遇到棘手的状况

examples.en: When he graduated, he was confronted with a very competitive job market.
examples.zh: 他毕业时面临着竞争非常激烈的就业市场。

examples.en: Many small businesses are confronted with financial difficulties after the pandemic.
examples.zh: 疫情过后很多小企业都面临着财务困境。

a matter of.usage: 表示“是…的问题；关乎…的事”，用于说明某事物的本质

examples.en: Success in this field is not just a matter of luck.
examples.zh: 在这个领域取得成功不仅仅是运气的问题。

examples.en: Protecting the environment is a matter of great importance for future generations.
examples.zh: 保护环境对后代来说是至关重要的事。

regard as.usage: 表示“把……视作……”，用于表达对人或事物的看法，as后接名词、形容词等

examples.en: Parents regard their children's praise of friends' homes as a slur on their own housework.
examples.zh: 父母把孩子夸赞朋友家视作对自己家务的诋毁。

examples.en: He regards his tutor as the person who has influenced him most in his academic career.
examples.zh: 他把自己的导师视作学术生涯中对他影响最大的人。

accuse sb of sth.usage: 表示“指责/控告某人做了某事”，of后接被指责的具体行为或罪名

examples.en: Parents may even accuse adolescents of disloyalty when they speak highly of their friends' families.
examples.zh: 当青少年夸赞朋友的家庭时，父母甚至可能指责他们不孝顺。

examples.en: The employee was accused of leaking the company's confidential information to competitors.
examples.zh: 这名员工被指控向竞争对手泄露公司机密信息。

bring sth on oneself.usage: 表示“自作自受，自己造成（不好的结果）”，强调不良后果是自身行为导致的

examples.en: Parents seldom realize that their children's secretiveness is something they have brought on themselves.
examples.zh: 父母很少意识到孩子的沉默寡言是他们自己造成的。

examples.en: Don't complain about the punishment - you brought it on yourself by cheating in the exam.
examples.zh: 别抱怨惩罚了——你考试作弊，这是自作自受。

stand up to.usage: 表示“经得起，承受住；勇敢对抗”，文中取“经得起”的含义

examples.en: Children's high ideal of their parents can hardly stand up to a realistic evaluation.
examples.zh: 孩子对父母的崇高想象几乎经不住现实的考量。

examples.en: This kind of waterproof fabric can stand up to the heaviest rainstorm.
examples.zh: 这种防水面料可以经受住最大的暴雨。

drive sb into opposition.usage: 表示“把某人推向对立面，使某人持反对态度”，强调行为导致对方产生对立情绪

examples.en: Parents who resent their children's adolescent reaction will drive the child into opposition.
examples.zh: 抵触孩子青春期反应的父母会把孩子推向自己的对立面。

examples.en: The manager's unreasonable demands drove most of the team into opposition.
examples.zh: 经理不合理的要求让团队大部分人都产生了对立情绪。

face up to.usage: 表示“勇敢面对，正视”，用于指不逃避困难、现实等

examples.en: It is always wiser to face up to reality however painful it may be.
examples.zh: 不管当下有多痛苦，正视现实永远是更明智的选择。

examples.en: You need to face up to the fact that you failed this time and learn from the experience.
examples.zh: 你需要正视这次失败的事实，并从中吸取经验。

to some degree.usage: 表示“在某种程度上”，用于弱化观点的绝对性，说明情况有一定的合理性

examples.en: Disillusionment with parents is to some degree inevitable for most adolescents.
examples.zh: 对大多数青少年来说，对父母的幻想破灭在某种程度上是不可避免的。

examples.en: To some degree, the success of the project depends on the support of local residents.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上，这个项目的成功取决于当地居民的支持。

on the whole.usage: 表示“总体来说，大体上”，用于总结整体情况，忽略个别例外

examples.en: Today's more open attitude between parents and children is on the whole healthier.
examples.zh: 如今父母和孩子之间更开放的相处态度总体来说更健康。

examples.en: On the whole, the performance of the new device meets our expectations.
examples.zh: 总体来说，这个新设备的表现符合我们的预期。

in the form of.usage: 表示“以……的形式”，用于说明事物呈现的具体形态

examples.en: The rocket fuel is easily obtainable from the lunar rocks in the form of liquid oxygen.
examples.zh: 火箭燃料很容易从月球岩石中以液态氧的形式获取。

examples.en: The company will provide help in the form of financial support.
examples.zh: 该公司将以资金支持的形式提供帮助。

lie in.usage: 表示“在于，存在于”，用于说明原因、问题、优势等的所在，主语通常为抽象名词

examples.en: The reason lies in its gravity.
examples.zh: 原因在于它的引力。

examples.en: The key to solving the problem lies in sufficient communication.
examples.zh: 解决这个问题的关键在于充分的沟通。

lie in.usage: 表示“在于；存在于”，主语通常是问题、答案、原因等抽象名词，后接表示原因或内容的名词

examples.en: The key to a solution of that problem lay in an everyday observation.
examples.zh: 解决那个问题的关键在于一个日常观察到的现象。

examples.en: The beauty of the old town lies in its traditional architecture.
examples.zh: 这座古镇的美在于它的传统建筑。

accelerate to.usage: 表示“加速到……（速度）”，后面接具体的速度数值或目标速度

examples.en: It takes much less energy to accelerate to that 1.5mps than it does on Earth.
examples.zh: 加速到每秒1.5英里所需的能量比在地球上少得多。

examples.en: The train accelerated to 300 kilometers per hour within five minutes.
examples.zh: 火车在五分钟内加速到了每小时300公里。

have a fascination for.usage: 表示“对……有极大的吸引力，使……着迷”，主语通常是具有吸引力的事物，宾语是被吸引的人

examples.en: Mars has an extraordinary fascination for would-be voyagers.
examples.zh: 火星对想要成为太空旅行者的人有着非凡的吸引力。

examples.en: Ancient history has a special fascination for this young scholar.
examples.zh: 古代史对这位年轻学者有着特殊的吸引力。

keep sthsb running.usage: 表示维持某事物正常运转、某人正常工作

examples.en: It takes a lot of effort to keep a large company running smoothly.
examples.zh: 维持一家大公司的顺利运转需要付出很多努力。

stay in business.usage: 商务用语，指企业维持运营、不倒闭

examples.en: Many small shops had to cut costs sharply to stay in business during the pandemic.
examples.zh: 疫情期间很多小商店不得不大幅削减成本才能维持经营。

fall within ones sphere.usage: 表示属于某人的职权、责任或兴趣范围

examples.en: Employee training issues fall within the HR manager's sphere of responsibility.
examples.zh: 员工培训问题属于人力资源经理的职责范围。

keep sb in line.usage: 表示约束某人、使某人遵守规则、行为合规

examples.en: The new company rules are designed to keep all employees in line with corporate standards.
examples.zh: 新的公司规定旨在约束所有员工符合企业规范。

meet the expense of.usage: 表示支付、承担某项费用，相当于cover the expense of

examples.en: The local government will meet the expense of building the new community library.
examples.zh: 当地政府将承担新建社区图书馆的费用。

to the extent that.usage: 引导状语从句，表示“在…程度上；就…而言”，用来限定陈述的适用范围

examples.en: To the extent that you practice every day, your English speaking skills will improve quickly.
examples.zh: 只要你每天练习，你的英语口语能力就会快速提升。

in the interests of.usage: 表示“为了…的利益；符合…的利益”，后接人或组织

examples.en: It is in the interests of the whole family to choose a house near good schools.
examples.zh: 选一所靠近好学校的房子符合全家的利益。

civil servant.usage: /ˌsɪvl ˈsɜːvənt/ noun. 公务员；文职人员（指政府部门的非军事雇佣人员，对应集体名词为civil service（行政部门））

undergo a loss of.usage: 表示“经历某种损失、衰退”，用来描述被动承受某种机能、资源等的减少

examples.en: Many old people undergo a gradual loss of hearing as they get older.
examples.zh: 很多老年人随着年龄增长会逐渐经历听力衰退。

the chances are against it.usage: 固定表达，表示“某事发生的可能性很小”，其中it指代上文提到的可能性较低的情况

examples.en: If you don't prepare for the exam, the chances are against your passing it.
examples.zh: 如果你不备考，通过考试的可能性很小。

in accordance with.usage: 表示“依照；根据；与……一致”，用来引出遵循的规则、规律、法律等

examples.en: All the activities are held in accordance with the school's regulations.
examples.zh: 所有活动都是依照学校的规定开展的。

be analogous to.usage: 表示“与……类似；与……相似”，用来比较两个事物有相似的特征或性质

examples.en: The function of a computer's CPU is analogous to the human brain.
examples.zh: 计算机中央处理器的功能和人类大脑类似。

by contrast.usage: 表示“相比之下；与此相反”，用于连接两个形成对比的内容，突出二者的差异

examples.en: The north of the country is dry, while the south, by contrast, is very rainy.
examples.zh: 这个国家的北部很干燥，相比之下，南部则多雨。

wear away.usage: 表示“磨损；侵蚀；逐渐消失”，指物体因摩擦、使用等逐步被损耗

examples.en: The inscription on the old stone has worn away over hundreds of years.
examples.zh: 这块古老石头上的铭文经过数百年已经被磨损了。

all but.usage: 表示“除了……之外都；几乎”，两种常见含义，这里指“除了……之外都”

examples.en: She finished all but the last question on the test paper.
examples.zh: 她做完了试卷上除了最后一题之外的所有题目。

knock sb out.usage: 表示“使某人不省人事；使某人疲惫不堪；击败某人”，文中指疾病严重到使人失去生命

examples.en: The strong punch knocked the boxer out in the first round.
examples.zh: 重重的一拳在第一回合就把拳击手打晕了。

disposal into.usage: 表示“排入；倒入”，特指将废弃物排放到某个地点

examples.en: The local government has banned the disposal of industrial waste into rivers.
examples.zh: 当地政府已经禁止将工业废料排入河流。

regard as.usage: 动词短语，意为“把……视为；认为……是”，可用于被动语态

examples.en: The project is regarded as one of the most successful initiatives this year.
examples.zh: 这个项目被认为是今年最成功的举措之一。

keep to.usage: 动词短语，此处表示“只使用；坚持食用/饮用”，也可表示遵守规则、不偏离路线

examples.en: When you have a stomachache, it's better to keep to light food.
examples.zh: 你胃痛的时候最好只吃清淡的食物。

wellknown brand names.usage: 名词短语，指“知名品牌”，多用于消费场景描述

examples.en: When buying electronics, many people prefer products of well-known brand names.
examples.zh: 购买电子产品时，很多人偏好知名品牌的产品。

in ones presence.usage: 介词短语，意为“当着某人的面；在某人在场的情况下”

examples.en: The contract should be signed in the presence of a witness.
examples.zh: 这份合同应该在证人在场的情况下签署。

on request.usage: 介词短语，表示“一经要求；根据请求”，说明服务可按需提供

examples.en: The hotel provides extra blankets on request.
examples.zh: 酒店可以根据客人要求提供额外的毛毯。

rely upon.usage: 动词短语，意为“依赖；依靠”，等同于rely on，后面可接名词或动名词

examples.en: You can rely upon her to finish the task on time.
examples.zh: 你可以放心让她按时完成这项任务。

beware of.usage: 动词短语，意为“当心；提防”，用于提醒他人注意危险或有害事物

examples.en: Beware of pickpockets when you take the subway during rush hour.
examples.zh: 高峰时段乘坐地铁时要当心扒手。

set pen to paper.usage: 表示开始写作、动笔的固定表达，语体偏正式

examples.en: She had been planning the story for months before she finally set pen to paper.
examples.zh: 她为这个故事构思了好几个月，才终于动笔开始写。

pass for.usage: 表示“被当作；被误认为”，强调事物和实际标准有差距但被当成合格的或真实的

examples.en: In this small town, a simple meal of noodles and eggs passes for a luxury.
examples.zh: 在这个小镇里，一顿简单的鸡蛋面都被当成奢侈的食物。

to my certain knowledge.usage: 插入语，意为“据我所知”，强调说话者对所说内容的真实性十分确定

examples.en: To my certain knowledge, he has never lied to anyone in the team.
examples.zh: 据我所知，他从来没有对团队里的任何人撒过谎。

begin afresh.usage: 表示“重新开始；从头再来”，强调抛开之前的积累或错误重头做起

examples.en: After the failure of his first business, he moved to another city to begin afresh.
examples.zh: 第一次创业失败后，他搬到了另一个城市从头开始。

winkle out.usage: 表示“挖掘出；费尽周折找出”，指付出努力得到隐藏的信息或事物

examples.en: The journalist spent three months trying to winkle out the truth behind the scandal.
examples.zh: 这名记者花了三个月的时间，试图挖出这起丑闻背后的真相。

might as well.usage: 表示“倒不如；不妨”，用于建议做某事，或强调两种情况结果差不多、都没有意义

examples.en: Since the train is delayed for two hours, we might as well go to the café nearby to wait.
examples.zh: 既然火车晚点了两个小时，我们倒不如去附近的咖啡馆等着。

take time off.usage: 表示“抽出时间；暂时放下（手头的事）”，后可接from sth说明停下的事情

examples.en: He decided to take time off from work to spend more time with his sick mother.
examples.zh: 他决定暂时放下工作，花更多时间陪伴生病的母亲。

at its inmost point.usage: 表示“在其最核心处；在最深处”，用于描述事物或情感的本质层面

examples.en: The poem touches the vulnerability at the inmost point of human nature.
examples.zh: 这首诗触及了人性最深处的脆弱。

give the impression of.usage: 表示“给人…的印象”，后可接名词、动名词或that从句

examples.en: Although an ocean wave gives the impression of a wall of water moving in your direction, in actuality waves move through the water leaving the water about where it was.
examples.zh: 尽管海浪给人的印象是一堵水墙朝你移动，但实际上波浪穿过水体，而水本身几乎留在原位。

examples.en: He gives the impression of being a very hardworking person.
examples.zh: 他给人的印象是一个非常勤奋的人。

in actuality.usage: 表示“实际上；事实上”，为书面用语，可替换in fact, actually

examples.en: The team seemed to be in control of the match, but in actuality they were under great pressure.
examples.zh: 这支球队看起来掌控了比赛，但实际上他们承受着巨大的压力。

assume a individuality.usage: 表示“呈现出…的特质/个性”，assume在这里意为“呈现（外观、特质）”

examples.en: For a time it assumes a miraculous individuality that, in the end, is reabsorbed into the great ocean of life.
examples.zh: 有那么一段时间，它呈现出一种不可思议的独特性，而最终又会被重新吸纳入生命的汪洋之中。

examples.en: The city assumes a romantic individuality when the neon lights are on at night.
examples.zh: 夜晚霓虹灯亮起时，这座城市呈现出一种浪漫的独特气质。

restore to.usage: 表示“使…恢复到…状态”，restore为及物动词，后接要恢复的对象，to后接目标状态

examples.en: Gravity is the force that drives them in a continual attempt to restore the ocean surface to a flat plain.
examples.zh: 重力是驱动它们不断尝试将海面恢复为平坦平面的力量。

examples.en: The volunteers helped to restore the old building to its original appearance.
examples.zh: 志愿者们帮忙将这栋老建筑恢复到了它最初的样貌。

transmit on through.usage: 表示“通过…传递下去”，transmit意为“传输、传递”，on强调传递的延续性

examples.en: The sea transmits it on through waves--an ancient, exquisite powerful message.
examples.zh: 海洋通过波浪将这个信息传递下去——这是一个古老、优美而充满力量的信息。

examples.en: The culture is transmitted on through generations of folk artists.
examples.zh: 这种文化通过一代又一代的民间艺人传承了下来。

take sth with a grain of salt.phrase: take sth. with a grain of salt
take sth with a grain of salt.usage: 固定习语，表示对某事半信半疑，不完全相信

examples.en: Such extreme cases must probably be taken with a grain of salt.
examples.zh: 这类极端案例可能不能完全当真。

examples.en: You should take what he says with a grain of salt, he often exaggerates.
examples.zh: 他说的话你得打个折扣听，他经常夸张。

earn ones keep.usage: 习语，意为“挣钱维持生计；值得雇佣”，指通过劳动抵消自己的生活成本

examples.en: It is then almost ready to undertake heavy work and can begin to earn its keep straight away.
examples.zh: 这个年龄的大象差不多已经可以干重活，能立刻开始干活抵偿饲养成本了。

examples.en: Even as a teenager, he did part-time jobs to earn his keep instead of relying on his parents.
examples.zh: 甚至十几岁的时候，他就靠打零工养活自己，不依赖父母。

to the accompaniment of.usage: 介词短语，表示“在……的伴奏下；伴随着……

examples.en: Others rub their hands over his skin to the accompaniment of a monotonous and soothing chant.
examples.zh: 其他人一边摸着它的皮肤，一边唱着单调的、让人安心的歌谣。

examples.en: The performance began to the accompaniment of warm applause.
examples.zh: 演出在热烈的掌声中拉开了序幕。

to and fro.usage: 副词短语，表示“来回地；往复地”，用来描述动作反复在两个点之间移动

examples.en: Now move the hand to and fro and around but not up and down.
examples.zh: 现在把手前后左右晃，但不要上下动。

examples.en: She paced to and fro in the waiting room, worrying about the test result.
examples.zh: 她在候诊室里来回踱步，担心着检查结果。

from side to side.usage: 表示“左右地；从一边到另一边”，用来描述物体在水平方向上的往复运动

examples.en: But as the paper moved from side to side under the pen point, its movement would be recorded in ink upon its surface.
examples.zh: 但是当纸在笔尖下左右移动时，纸的运动就会被墨水记录在纸面上。

examples.en: He shook his head from side to side to show his disagreement.
examples.zh: 他左右摇了摇头表示不同意。

one after the other.usage: 表示“一个接一个地；陆续地”，强调顺序上连续发生，也可写作one after another

examples.en: the graphic record shows three waves arriving one after the other at short intervals.
examples.zh: 图形记录显示三种波间隔很短，相继到达。

examples.en: The students entered the classroom one after the other when the bell rang.
examples.zh: 铃响的时候，学生们一个接一个地走进了教室。

be bound to.usage: 表达对某事发生的确定性推断，语气十分肯定，相当于“一定会，必定会”

examples.en: If you work hard, you are bound to make progress sooner or later.
examples.zh: 如果你努力，迟早一定会取得进步。

examples.en: There are bound to be unexpected difficulties when starting a new project.
examples.zh: 启动新项目时一定会遇到意料之外的困难。

come up against.usage: 表示意外遇到困难、问题、反对等，主语通常是人或组织

examples.en: We came up against a lack of funds when trying to expand the business.
examples.zh: 我们试图拓展业务时遇到了资金短缺的问题。

examples.en: Many new graduates come up against fierce competition in the job market.
examples.zh: 很多应届毕业生在就业市场遇到了激烈的竞争。

let alone.usage: 用于进一步否定或强调更不可能的情况，通常前面是否定句，相当于“更不用说”

examples.en: I can't even afford a cheap bicycle, let alone a car.
examples.zh: 我连便宜的自行车都买不起，更不用说汽车了。

examples.en: He can't speak basic Japanese, let alone read Japanese novels.
examples.zh: 他连基础日语都不会说，更不用说读日语小说了。

as a matter of fact.usage: 用于引出与对方想法不同的实际情况，或强调事实的真相，相当于in fact

examples.en: As a matter of fact, it is the other way around.
examples.zh: 事实上，情况恰恰相反。

examples.en: As a matter of fact, I have already finished the report ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 实际上，我已经提前完成了报告。

have reference to.usage: 表示“与……有关，涉及”，用于说明事物之间的关联

examples.en: His very concepts of the true and the false will still have reference to his particular traditional customs.
examples.zh: 他对是非的判断标准仍然和他所处的特定传统习俗有关。

examples.en: The data collected in this research have reference to the impact of climate change on crop production.
examples.zh: 这项研究收集的数据和气候变化对作物生产的影响有关。

first and foremost.usage: 用于强调最重要的、首要的因素，放在句首或主语后引出核心内容

examples.en: The life history of the individual is first and foremost an accommodation to the patterns and standards traditionally handed down in his community.
examples.zh: 个人的生活史首先就是适应他所在社群世代相传的模式和标准的过程。

examples.en: First and foremost, we need to ensure the safety of all the participants in the activity.
examples.zh: 首要的是，我们需要确保活动所有参与者的安全。

be incumbent upon sb to do sth.phrase: be incumbent upon sb to do sth
be incumbent upon sb to do sth.usage: 正式表达，意为“某人有义务/责任做某事”，强调责任的不可推卸性

examples.en: There is no social problem it is more incumbent upon us to understand than this of the role of custom.
examples.zh: 我们有责任去理解的社会问题中，没有哪个比习俗的作用这个问题更重要了。

examples.en: It is incumbent upon the government to provide basic medical services for all citizens.
examples.zh: 政府有义务为所有公民提供基础医疗服务。

hold sway over.usage: 表示“支配，控制，对……有影响力”，用于描述观点、信仰、势力等对人的思想或行为的控制作用

examples.en: As long as these distinctions between ourselves and the primitive, ourselves and the barbarian, ourselves and the pagan, held sway over people's minds.
examples.zh: 只要我们自己和原始人、自己和野蛮人、自己和异教徒之间的这些区别还支配着人们的思想。

examples.en: Traditional values still hold sway over many people's choices in marriage.
examples.zh: 传统观念仍然影响着很多人的婚姻选择。

substitute a for b.usage: 表示“用A代替B”，说明替换的对象和替代物

examples.en: The major social sciences have substituted the study of one local variation, that of Western civilization, for the study of human beings as a whole.
examples.zh: 主要的社会学科用对一种本地变体（即西方文明）的研究，替代了对整个人类的研究。

examples.en: We can substitute coconut milk for dairy milk in this recipe if you are lactose intolerant.
examples.zh: 如果你乳糖不耐受，我们可以在这个食谱里用椰奶代替牛奶。

set against.usage: 表示“把……和……对立起来，使……和……抗衡”，用于描述两个事物被置于对立的关系中

examples.en: We should not set economic development against environmental protection.
examples.zh: 我们不应该把经济发展和环境保护对立起来。

examples.en: The manager set the performance of the new employee against that of the experienced staff.
examples.zh: 经理把新员工的表现和老员工的表现做对比。

make a poor show of doing sth.phrase: make a poor show of (doing) sth
make a poor show of doing sth.usage: 表示在做某事时表现得很糟糕、笨拙，口语和书面语中都可使用，带有调侃或自嘲的语气

examples.en: I would make a very poor show of disputing the ownership of a cave with a bear.
examples.zh: 要是我和一头熊争夺一个山洞的所有权，我肯定会表现得十分狼狈。

examples.en: He made a poor show of apologizing, so no one was convinced.
examples.zh: 他道歉的样子十分敷衍，所以没有人相信他。

stand alone.usage: 此处表示“孤立无援，只有自己一人（处于某种情况）”，也可指某事物独一无二、无人能及

examples.en: In this I do not think that I stand alone.
examples.zh: 在这一点上，我觉得并非只有我一个人是这样。

examples.en: When it comes to solving complex mathematical problems, he stands alone in his class.
examples.zh: 在解决复杂数学问题这方面，他在班里无人能及。

be conditioned by.usage: 表示“受……的制约、影响”，通常指环境、习俗等外部因素对人的思想、行为产生塑造作用

examples.en: Our environment is chiefly conditioned by the things we believe.
examples.zh: 我们的环境主要由我们所信奉的事物塑造。

examples.en: People's consumption habits are conditioned by their income level.
examples.zh: 人们的消费习惯受其收入水平的制约。

not so much but.usage: 表示“与其说是……不如说是……”，用于否定前者、强调后者，说明某结果的主要原因

examples.en: Yet their present development is wholly different, not so much because of different people even, but because of the different thoughts that exist in the minds of their inhabitants.
examples.zh: 然而它们现在的发展完全不同，与其说是因为人种不同，不如说是因为当地居民头脑中的思想不同。

examples.en: The project failed, not so much because of lack of funding, but because of poor management.
examples.zh: 这个项目失败了，与其说是因为资金不足，不如说是因为管理不善。

know sth full well.usage: 表示“非常清楚，深知”，强调对某事了解得十分透彻，口语和书面语通用

examples.en: The Holy Office knew this full well when it caused heretics to be burned in days gone by.
examples.zh: 宗教法庭对此心知肚明，所以过去才会把异端分子烧死。

examples.en: She knew full well that he was lying, but she didn't point it out on the spot.
examples.zh: 她非常清楚他在撒谎，但并没有当场指出来。

in days gone by.usage: 表示“在过去，从前”，属于书面正式表达，用于指代已经过去的历史时期

examples.en: In days gone by, people had to fetch water from wells every day.
examples.zh: 从前，人们每天都得从井里打水。

to be more accurate.usage: 表示“更准确地说”，用于对前面提到的内容进行补充修正，使表述更严谨

examples.en: We cannot think outside the particular patterns that our brains are conditioned to, or, to be more accurate we can think only a very little way outside.
examples.zh: 我们无法跳出大脑受制约形成的特定思维模式，或者更准确地说，我们只能稍微跳出一点这种模式。

examples.en: The meeting will end next week, to be more accurate, next Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 会议将在下周结束，更准确地说，是下周五下午。

catch hold of.usage: 表示抓住、握住某物，也可引申为掌握、理解某个想法或事物

examples.en: The mind catches hold of something and will not let it go.
examples.zh: 大脑抓住某个念头不肯放开。

examples.en: He caught hold of the rope to keep himself from falling.
examples.zh: 他抓住绳子防止自己摔倒。

of the first importance.usage: 用来描述事物是最重要的、处于第一优先级的

examples.en: The cultivation of a hobby is therefore a policy of the first importance to a public man.
examples.zh: 因此，对于公众人物来说，培养爱好和新的兴趣形式是头等重要的策略。

examples.en: Regular exercise is a matter of the first importance for office workers.
examples.zh: 对于上班族来说，定期锻炼是头等重要的事。

at hand.usage: 表示在手边、即将到来，或者可以随时使用

examples.en: The vivifying fruits are to be at hand when needed.
examples.zh: 在需要的时候，能让人焕发活力的成果就能随时可用。

examples.en: Keep your emergency kit at hand in case of accidents.
examples.zh: 把你的应急包放在手边，以防发生意外。

tired out.usage: 表示极度疲惫、筋疲力尽，通常是因体力或脑力消耗过大导致

examples.en: The manual labourer is tired out with a hard week's sweat and effort.
examples.zh: 体力劳动者经过一周辛苦的流汗劳作后已经筋疲力尽。

examples.en: I was tired out after finishing the 10-kilometer marathon.
examples.zh: 完成10公里马拉松后我筋疲力尽。

lay ones hands on.usage: 表示得到、找到某物，尤指经过努力后获得

examples.en: They can lay their hands on almost every object of desire.
examples.zh: 他们几乎能得到所有想要的东西。

examples.en: I finally laid my hands on the limited edition album I had been looking for.
examples.zh: 我终于找到了我一直想要的那张限量版专辑。

in vain.usage: 表示徒劳、白费功夫，强调行动没有取得预期效果
