examples.en: In vain they rush frantically round from place to place.
examples.zh: 他们疯狂地从一个地方跑到另一个地方，却都是徒劳。

examples.en: All the efforts we made to save the old building were in vain, as it was demolished finally.
examples.zh: 我们为拯救这栋老建筑付出的所有努力都白费了，因为它最终还是被拆除了。

broadly speaking.usage: 常用作插入语，表示一般来说、广义上说，用于引出概括性的观点

examples.en: Broadly speaking, human beings may be divided into three classes.
examples.zh: 广义上说，人类可以分为三类。

examples.en: Broadly speaking, the project has achieved most of its expected goals.
examples.zh: 总体来说，这个项目已经达成了大部分预期目标。

keen appetite for.usage: 表示对某事物有强烈的兴趣、渴望

examples.en: The long hours of work bring a keen appetite for pleasure even in its simplest forms.
examples.zh: 长时间的工作让他们即使对最简单的快乐也有强烈的渴望。

examples.en: Children raised in a reading environment usually have a keen appetite for books.
examples.zh: 在阅读环境中长大的孩子通常对书籍有强烈的兴趣。

banish from.usage: 表示把……从……中驱逐、排除出去，可指具体事物也可指想法、情绪

examples.en: They need the means of banishing work at intervals from their minds.
examples.zh: 他们需要偶尔能把工作从脑海中排除出去的方法。

examples.en: You should banish negative thoughts from your mind before the interview.
examples.zh: 面试前你应该把消极的想法从脑海中赶出去。

far from.usage: 表示“远非，完全不”，用于否定某一说法，后可接形容词、动名词或名词

examples.en: It is far from being the only advantage of reading.
examples.zh: 这完全不是阅读的唯一好处。

go hand in hand.usage: 表示“密切相关，相伴而生”，说明两个事物同时存在、互相关联

examples.en: Poverty and poor health often go hand in hand.
examples.zh: 贫穷和健康不佳往往是相伴而生的。

be wary of.usage: 表示“提防，警惕”，指对可能的风险或问题保持谨慎

examples.en: You should be wary of strangers who ask for personal information.
examples.zh: 你要警惕索要你个人信息的陌生人。

get away from it all.usage: 口语常用表达，指“远离尘嚣，彻底放松”，尤指通过度假逃离日常的压力和繁琐

examples.en: Many people go to the countryside on weekends to get away from it all.
examples.zh: 很多人周末去乡下，彻底逃离城市的喧嚣放松自己。

within ones command.usage: 表示“在某人的掌控之中，可由某人自由支配”

examples.en: With enough savings, you will have more choices within your command.
examples.zh: 有足够的存款，你就能有更多可以自主选择的机会。

go about doing sth.usage: 动词短语，表示着手做、处理某件事，强调做事的方式和过程

examples.en: If you want to apply for this scholarship, you should go about preparing the required documents first.
examples.zh: 如果你想申请这个奖学金，你应该首先着手准备所需的文件。

examples.en: I have no idea how to go about repairing this broken laptop.
examples.zh: 我不知道该怎么着手修理这台坏了的笔记本电脑。

sort out.usage: 动词短语，意为整理好、解决、处理妥当，多用于表示理清复杂的事务或解决问题

examples.en: You need to sort out your travel itinerary before you leave for the trip.
examples.zh: 你出发旅行之前需要整理好你的行程安排。

examples.en: It took me two hours to sort out the messy files on my desk.
examples.zh: 我花了两个小时才整理好我桌上乱糟糟的文件。

be blessed with.usage: 固定搭配，表示有幸拥有、天生具有（某种好的特质、条件等），带有感激的意味

examples.en: She is blessed with a beautiful voice and has won many singing competitions.
examples.zh: 她天生有一副好嗓子，已经赢得了很多歌唱比赛。

examples.en: This small town is blessed with clear lakes and lush mountains, attracting lots of tourists every year.
examples.zh: 这个小镇有幸拥有清澈的湖泊和葱郁的山峦，每年都吸引很多游客。

suffer sleepless nights over sth.usage: 习语，意为为某事焦虑得睡不着觉，强调因担忧某件事而产生巨大的心理压力

examples.en: Many students suffer sleepless nights over their final exam results.
examples.zh: 很多学生因为担心期末考试成绩而焦虑得睡不着觉。

examples.en: He has been suffering sleepless nights over the upcoming important business negotiation.
examples.zh: 他因为即将到来的重要商务谈判而焦虑得夜夜失眠。

set sb up as.usage: 动词短语，此处表示使某人处于（某种不利的境地），也可表示扶持某人创业、使某人担任某个职位

examples.en: If you don't buy insurance for your car, you're setting yourself up as a target for huge losses in case of accidents.
examples.zh: 如果你不给你的车买保险，一旦发生事故你就会面临巨额损失的风险。

examples.en: His parents set him up as the manager of the family business after he graduated from university.
examples.zh: 他大学毕业后，他的父母扶持他当上了家族企业的经理。

hostage to fortune.usage: 固定习语，指可能带来风险的事物、处境，意为“担风险的事；容易受到不利影响的处境”

examples.en: Putting all your savings into a single high-risk stock is a hostage to fortune.
examples.zh: 把你所有的积蓄都投入一只高风险的股票是一件非常冒险的事。

examples.en: Revealing too much personal information online can make you a hostage to fortune.
examples.zh: 在网上透露太多个人信息会让你处于容易受伤害的风险中。

solid financial position.usage: 名词性短语，意为经济状况稳定、财务状况良好，用于描述个人或机构的财务状态健康

examples.en: Only people in a solid financial position can consider buying such an expensive property.
examples.zh: 只有财务状况稳定的人才可以考虑购买这么贵的房产。

examples.en: The company is in a solid financial position after three years of steady growth.
examples.zh: 经过三年的稳定增长，该公司的财务状况十分良好。

spread your risk.usage: 金融领域常用短语，意为分散风险，指通过投资不同品类的资产来降低整体投资的风险

examples.en: When planning investments, the first rule is to spread your risk to avoid losing all your money at once.
examples.zh: 规划投资时，首要原则是分散风险，避免一次性损失你所有的钱。

examples.en: Financial advisors always remind clients to spread their risk instead of focusing on one type of asset.
examples.zh: 理财顾问总是提醒客户要分散风险，不要只盯着一种资产投资。
